title: The University of Melbourne WMT 2026 CreoleMT Submission: A Domain-Balanced Approach to Low-Resource Pacific Creole Machine Translation
summary: For our submission to the WMT26 Creole Language Translation Shared Task, we focus on machine translation (MT) models for Pacific creoles: Tok Pisin, Bislama, and Solomon Pijin, with particular attention to broad domain performance. After pre-training on a large collection of domain-imbalanced data, we continue fine-tuning on a diverse mix of domain-balanced data. We rely on a number of data collection and preparation techniques, including LLM-assisted respelling and alignment, back-translation, and distillation from Gemini for domains originally not present in training data. Evaluated on Bouquet and a novel test set made of spoken language transcripts, our models beat open model baselines by 3+ chrF++ points in all directions with human-original references. Looking ahead, we plan to develop human-translated test sets for Solomon Pijin and Bislama, and to distil our best models into much smaller ones that retain broad domain coverage.

AI.tldr: 该论文为WMT26克里奥尔语翻译共享任务提交，针对太平洋克里奥尔语（Tok Pisin、Bislama、Solomon Pijin）构建机器翻译模型，通过域不平衡预训练与域平衡微调，结合多种数据增强技术，在Bouquet及新构建的口语测试集上以chrF++指标超越开源基线3分以上。
AI.motivation: 太平洋克里奥尔语（Tok Pisin、Bislama、Solomon Pijin）属于低资源语言，现有机器翻译模型在这些语言上表现有限，且缺乏覆盖广泛领域的训练数据与评测资源。作者参加WMT26克里奥尔语翻译共享任务，旨在提升这些语言的广域翻译性能。
AI.method: 采用两阶段训练策略：先在大规模域不平衡数据上预训练，再在域均衡的混合数据上继续微调。数据处理技术包括：LLM辅助的重拼写（respelling）与对齐、回译（back-translation），以及针对训练数据中缺失领域从Gemini进行知识蒸馏。
AI.result: 在Bouquet数据集和基于口语转录构建的新测试集上评估，使用人工原始参考译文时，模型在所有翻译方向上均比开源基线模型高出3个以上chrF++点。
AI.conclusion: 模型在太平洋克里奥尔语翻译任务上取得显著提升，后续工作包括为Solomon Pijin和Bislama构建人工翻译测试集，并将最优模型蒸馏为更小且保持广域覆盖能力的模型。

title: ChatGPT Images 2.5 on Forgery Tasks: Testing Advertised Improvements Against Known Answers
comment: 27 pages, 6 figures, 16 tables
summary: OpenAI released ChatGPT Images 2.5 on 8 September 2026, advertising more precise local edits, better consistency across edits, more faithful reference products and sharper detail. We evaluate these claims on four forgery tasks with answers fixed in advance: receipt-field alteration, repeated editing, product placement and small-print rendering. GPT-Image-2 provides same-week baselines at a cheaper and a more expensive tier. A limited improvement appears in receipt editing. After alignment, OCR detects changes to surrounding text in 31.7% of Flare outputs, against 44.2% for the cheaper baseline. This gain is concentrated on CORD receipts and sensitive to shifts of a pixel or less; the forged value itself is no more often correct. Repeated editing and fine print show no measurable gain. Product codes become more legible mainly because Images 2.5 draws the product larger. Defence outcomes change little: localisation remains weak for both generations. A detector that flags 68.6% of controlled benchmark images flags only 35.9% of images posted online. Advertised improvements therefore transfer unevenly to the tested forgery capabilities, while substantial detection limitations remain.

AI.tldr: 该文在四类伪造任务上评测OpenAI于2026年9月8日发布的ChatGPT Images 2.5，并与GPT-Image-2的两个价档基线对比。结果显示改进仅在小票字段篡改上部分成立且高度脆弱，重复编辑与细字渲染无增益，检测能力依旧受限。
AI.motivation: OpenAI宣称Images 2.5在局部编辑精度、编辑一致性、参考产品保真度和细节锐度上有提升，但这些宣传性声明缺乏在真实伪造场景下的独立、预注册式验证。作者希望检验广告宣称能否真正转化为可被滥用的伪造能力，并评估相应防御（检测与定位）是否同步改善。
AI.method: 采用预先固定答案的四类伪造任务：小票字段篡改、重复编辑、产品植入、小字渲染。以GPT-Image-2的更廉价档与更昂贵档作为同期基线。评估手段包括对齐后的OCR差异检测（衡量周围文本被改动比例）、伪造值正确率、可读性归因分析（字号变化 vs 真实渲染质量），以及伪造检测与定位性能。
AI.result: 小票编辑呈现有限改进：对齐后OCR在31.7%的Flare输出中检出周边文本被改动，廉价基线为44.2%；该增益集中于CORD数据集的小票，且对1像素及以下的位移敏感，而被伪造的数值本身正确率并无提升。重复编辑与小字渲染未见可测增益。产品代码更易辨认主要源于Images 2.5把产品画得更大，而非渲染更精细。防御端变化不大：两代模型定位能力均弱；同一检测器在受控基准图像上可标记68.6%，但在网络实际流传图像上仅标记35.9%。
AI.conclusion: 广告宣称的改进在测试的伪造能力上迁移不均衡：仅在小票字段篡改这一狭窄场景中部分兑现，且脆弱、对像素级扰动敏感；其余任务无实质收益。检测能力仍存在显著局限，且受控基准性能无法代表真实在线场景。

title: An Efficient and Modular Framework for Targeted Harm Mitigation in LLMS
summary: Large Language Models (LLMs) are powerful zero-shot learners but remain prone to misalignment with human preferences, often producing biased, toxic, or otherwise harmful outputs. Existing alignment methods, while effective, are costly and tightly coupled to the model, limiting flexibility and scalability. We propose a modular correction framework that augments pretrained LLMs with Activated LoRA (aLoRA) adapters and a context-aware routing mechanism to eliminate harms from misaligned model responses. Our approach enables expert adapters to activate mid-sequence without invalidating the KV cache, allowing low-latency, targeted correction during generation. Each expert is trained to detect and mitigate specific harms, such as bias or toxicity. A learned router dynamically selects appropriate experts based on the models intermediate outputs. We demonstrate that our system improves alignment on standard safety benchmarks while preserving task performance, offering a lightweight and efficient path toward safer and more controllable LLM deployments.

AI.tldr: 提出一种模块化矫正框架，通过激活式LoRA（aLoRA）专家适配器与上下文感知路由机制，在生成过程中进行低延迟、定向的伤害矫正，在不牺牲任务性能的前提下提升模型对齐安全性。
AI.motivation: 现有LLM虽具备强大的零样本能力，但仍易与人类偏好错位，产生偏见、毒性或有害输出；而现有对齐方法成本高且与模型紧耦合，缺乏灵活性与可扩展性。
AI.method: 在预训练LLM上附加Activated LoRA（aLoRA）适配器与上下文感知路由机制：专家适配器可在序列中间激活而不使KV缓存失效，实现生成过程中的低延迟定向矫正；每个专家针对特定伤害（如偏见、毒性）训练；学习到的路由器依据模型中间输出动态选择合适专家。
AI.result: 在标准安全基准上提升了对齐效果，同时保持任务性能。
AI.conclusion: 该框架为更安全、更可控的LLM部署提供了一条轻量且高效的路径。

title: FaithfulBench: Does AI Counsel Uphold or Undermine the User's Professed Faith?
comment: 35 pages, 12 figures, 12 tables. Open-source corpus, harness and validator at https://github.com/faithfamilytechnologynetwork/multibench; results browser at https://multibrowser-production.up.railway.app
summary: Do AI assistants help believers reason about moral dilemmas consistently with their faith? We present FaithfulBench, the first benchmark to score AI counsel across traditions by how well it adheres to the user's professed faith. Scenarios are drawn from each tradition's most respected texts, with the faithful answer known and applied by the judges as the standard. We test five frontier models under three conditions: the AI does not know the user's tradition; it receives a one-line prompt identifying the user as a practicing adherent; or it receives a companion-counselor guide rooted in the tradition's sources. Two judges score the initial response and whether the model caves or holds when pressured toward the answer the user wants. When the tradition is unstated, models counsel from a secular therapeutic default and every model fails some believers. Naming the faith wins a faithful first answer but not steadfastness; the guide improves both.

AI.tldr: 提出FaithfulBench——首个按“是否符合用户所信奉信仰”来评分的AI宗教咨询基准，测试五个前沿模型在三种条件下的表现。
AI.motivation: 探究AI助手能否帮助信众以与其信仰一致的方式思考道德困境，填补缺少按信仰传统一致性评估AI建议的基准空白。
AI.method: 场景取自各传统最受尊崇的文本，其“符合信仰的答案”已知并由评判者作为标准；测试五个前沿模型在三种条件下作答：不知用户传统、仅给一行身份提示、以及提供植根于该传统source的陪伴-咨询指南；两名评判者分别对初次回答及在用户施压下模型是否让步/坚持进行评分。
AI.result: 传统未说明时，模型默认世俗治疗式建议，所有模型都会在某些信众上失败；点明信仰可提高首答的符合度但不提升坚定性；提供指南则两者均改善。
AI.conclusion: AI咨询默认世俗取向难以满足信众需求，明确信仰身份只能部分改善，嵌入传统来源的指南可同时提升答案符合度与抗压坚定性。

title: LLMersion: A Local-First AI Agent Framework for Low-Cost Home Language Learning toward Educational Equity
comment: 24 pages, 5 figures, 7 tables. v2 adds interface figures and the companion tool LLMersion Narrator. Code: https://github.com/QM378/LLMersion ; Narrator: https://github.com/QM378/llmersion-narrator
summary: Artificial intelligence helps education most where an essential provision has been rationed by cost. For language learners that provision is a teacher's voice, which binds listening, reading, speaking, and writing into one act. Published evidence shows why most learners lack it, from a global shortage of 44 million teachers to heavy household tutoring bills, and why technology has not substituted for it: computer-assisted language learning proved effective but narrow, applications presuppose connectivity 2.6 billion people lack, and One Laptop per Child's randomized evaluation found that hardware without capable software teaches nothing. We distill eight difficulties and four binding constraints, and argue that small open-weight models dissolve the last: a complete four-skill stack now fits a \$200-class laptop and, on community measurements, generates at the pace speech is consumed, for about one US cent of electricity per study hour. We therefore propose LLMersion, a scheme for AI for education that runs entirely at home, over the learner's own documents, with an AI-written, AI-understood, AI-updated codebase anyone can customize; present LLMersion-1, a released open-source prototype (https://github.com/QM378/LLMersion ); and outline the vision of a private learning agent.

AI.tldr: 本文提出LLMersion方案：利用可在200美元级笔记本上运行的小型开放权重模型，构建完全本地化、基于学习者自有文档的四技能语言学习系统，并以约1美分/学时的电力成本解耦教师稀缺与联网限制等约束；已发布开源原型LLMersion-1。
AI.motivation: 语言学习中"教师的声音"这一将听、读、说、写统一为整体行为的关键供给因成本而被配给：全球教师缺口达4400万，家庭辅导支出沉重；既有技术未能替代——计算机辅助语言学习有效但覆盖面窄，应用预设网络连接而26亿人无网，OLPC随机评估表明无合格软件的硬件无教学效果。
AI.method: 提炼八项困难与四项硬约束，论证小型开放权重模型可化解最后一重约束；据此设计LLMersion——完全在家庭环境运行、以学习者自有文档为语料、代码库由AI撰写/AI理解/AI更新且可自由定制的教育用AI方案，并实现开源原型LLMersion-1。
AI.result: 完整的四技能（听、读、说、写）技术栈可装入200美元级笔记本；依社区测量，生成速度与语音消费速度相当，每学时电力成本约1美分。
AI.conclusion: 小型开放权重模型使本地化、低成本、私有的语言学习代理成为可行，LLMersion提供了一条不依赖教师配额与网络连接的AI教育路径，并给出面向"私人学习代理"的愿景。

title: YOLO12-MambaScan: An Efficient Object Detector with High-Frequency Enhancement and State-Space Modeling
summary: The rapid development of unmanned aerial vehicle (UAV) technology has made aerial-image object detection increasingly important for natural-resource monitoring, traffic management, and disaster response. Detecting small objects in aerial images remains difficult because objects occupy very few pixels, high-frequency cues are easily lost, and global context is hard to model in cluttered scenes. Existing detectors often retain insufficient edge, corner, and texture information. We propose \ours, an aerial-image detector built on the YOLO12 architecture. The model combines a triple-path high-frequency enhancement convolution module (TriPathHFConv), receptive-field coordinate-attention convolution (RFCAConv), and a Mamba-based global-context module. On VisDrone, at an input resolution of 960*960, ours achieves 60.0% mAP@50 and 38.6%mAP@50:95, demonstrating a favorable accuracy--efficiency trade-off for small-object detection. The benchmark and dataset protocol follow the VisDrone challenge setup.

AI.tldr: 本文提出基于YOLO12的航拍图像检测器，通过三路径高频增强卷积、感受野坐标注意力卷积与Mamba全局上下文模块提升小目标检测性能，在VisDrone上取得60.0% mAP@50和38.6% mAP@50:95。
AI.motivation: 无人机技术快速发展使航拍图像目标检测在自然资源监测、交通管理和灾害响应中愈发重要。但航拍图像中小目标仅占很少像素，高频线索易丢失，且杂乱场景下全局上下文难以建模，现有检测器保留的边缘、角点和纹理信息不足。
AI.method: 在YOLO12架构基础上构建航拍图像检测器，融合三个关键模块：三路径高频增强卷积模块（TriPathHFConv）、感受野坐标注意力卷积（RFCAConv）以及基于Mamba的全局上下文模块。
AI.result: 在VisDrone数据集、960×960输入分辨率下，模型达到60.0% mAP@50与38.6% mAP@50:95，在小目标检测上展现出良好的精度—效率权衡。
AI.conclusion: 该方法通过高频增强与全局上下文建模有效缓解小目标检测中的信息丢失问题，实现了精度与效率的平衡；基准与数据集协议遵循VisDrone挑战赛设置。

title: Compositional Shift Algebra: Extrapolating Mixed Robot Shifts Without Mixed Finetuning
summary: Robot deployments rarely change one mechanism at a time: cameras, action interfaces, and physical dynamics often shift together. Prior adaptation recipes either finetune a new model for every mix or attempt to select which module to update. We instead learn shift operators on a modular stack z{=}E(o), a{=}g(z,u), z'{=}f(z,a) and compose them. Compositional Shift Algebra (CSA) fits single-factor observation, policy, and dynamics operators from exact-reset probes, then extrapolates held-out mixed shifts by operator composition---without mixed-shift finetuning. On ManiSkill StackCube, residual CSA matches an oracle mixed inverse on held-out mixes (success 1.0 over 10 seeds) while beating best-single / zero-shot / parameter-average baselines by { approx}67 pp. RGB-D vision-in-the-loop composition remains near oracle and far above non-compositional arms; a delay commutator stress shows ordered necessity for policy timesdelay. On a second task (PickCube), residual CSA again reaches compose 1.0 vs. 0.33 non-compositional (n{=}10), and an L1 vision controller without privileged cube/goal poses or grasp flags in the control loop retains compose 0.95 vs. 0.00. Main-track upgrades freeze PushCube (+33 pp), PegInsertion joint8 / pose7 EE (+67 pp each), and thin BC under frozen CSA (+67 pp); deeper BC and fair adapt baselines still need compose (+67 pp each), vision-localized BC needs compose (+56 pp), and delay favors ordered/few-shot deploy. We report Intervention-Gated Adaptation as a negative control.

AI.tldr: 提出组合式移位代数(CSA),通过在模块化栈上学习并组合观测、策略、动力学三类移位算子,无需混合移位微调即可外推到未见过的混合移位场景。
AI.motivation: 机器人部署中相机、动作接口与物理动力学等机制往往同时变化,以往适配方法要么针对每种组合重新微调模型,要么尝试选择更新哪些模块,成本高且难以泛化到未见组合。
AI.method: 在模块化栈 z=E(o), a=g(z,u), z'=f(z,a) 上学习移位算子并加以组合:CSA 通过精确重置探针拟合单因子观测、策略、动力学算子,再以算子复合外推留出的混合移位,不进行混合移位微调;并设置延迟对易子压力测试与 Intervention-Gated Adaptation 负对照。
AI.result: ManiSkill StackCube 上 residual CSA 在留出混合上达到 oracle 混合逆水平(10 种子成功率 1.0),较最佳单因子/零样本/参数平均基线高约 67pp;RGB-D 视觉闭环组合接近 oracle 并远超非组合基线。PickCube 上组合成功率 1.0 对 0.33(非组合,n=10);无特权位姿与控制回路的 L1 视觉控制器组合 0.95 对 0.00。主赛道升级 PushCube +33pp,PegInsertion joint8/pose7 EE 各 +67pp,冻结 CSA 下薄 BC +67pp;更深 BC 与公平适配基线、视觉定位 BC 仍需组合(+67pp、+56pp)。
AI.conclusion: 结果表明模块化移位算子可组合并可外推至未见混合移位,ordered 组合对策略×延迟等情形是必要的;组合性带来一致性增益,但部分深层 BC 与视觉定位场景仍有提升空间,延迟情形更倾向有序/少样本部署。

title: Multimodal Foundation Models Adaptation based on Domain-Aware Relaxed Orthogonal Subspace for Remote Sensing
summary: Pretrained foundation models (FMs) have achieved remarkable success in computer vision, yet their high fine-tuning cost limits practical deployment. Parameter-efficient fine-tuning (PEFT) methods such as Low-Rank Adaptation (LoRA) improve efficiency by constraining updates to a predefined low-rank subspace. However, when applied to remote sensing tasks with substantial domain shifts, the fixed subspace is constructed without observing the downstream activation distribution and can therefore provide a poor coordinate system for adaptation, a phenomenon herein termed subspace mismatch. To address this issue, a unified framework is introduced, termed Domain-aware Relaxed Orthogonal Subspace adaptation (DROS), which reformulates low-rank adaptation as data-conditioned subspace learning and flexible subspace adaptation. Specifically, the weight decomposition is conditioned on second-order activation statistics estimated from the downstream training distribution, so that the initialization reflects the feature geometry actually induced by the remote-sensing data, followed by flexible geometric transformations enabled by a relaxed orthogonal parameterization. Furthermore, the framework is extended to multimodal settings (MM-DROS) by sharing transformation structures across modality-specific subspaces, facilitating efficient cross-modal interaction. Extensive experiments on multiple remote sensing benchmarks demonstrate that DROS achieves state-of-the-art performance, even surpassing full fine-tuning, without additional inference overhead.

AI.tldr: 提出域感知松弛正交子空间适配框架DROS，将低秩适配重构为数据条件化的子空间学习与灵活子空间变换，缓解遥感任务的子空间失配问题，性能超越全量微调且无额外推理开销。
AI.motivation: 预训练基础模型在计算机视觉中表现优异，但微调成本高。LoRA等PEFT方法虽提升效率，却将更新约束在预定义的低秩子空间；在域偏移显著的遥感任务中，该固定子空间未观测下游激活分布，坐标系统不适配，导致"子空间失配"。
AI.method: 提出DROS统一框架，把低秩适配重述为数据条件化的子空间学习与灵活子空间适配：权重分解以从下游训练分布估计的二阶激活统计量为条件，使初始化反映遥感数据实际诱导的特征几何；再通过松弛正交参数化实现灵活的几何变换。并扩展至多模态MM-DROS，在模态特定子空间间共享变换结构以促进跨模态交互。
AI.result: 在多个遥感基准上，DROS取得最先进性能，甚至超过全量微调，且不引入额外推理开销。
AI.conclusion: 以数据条件化子空间初始化加松弛正交变换可有效解决域偏移下的子空间失配，为遥感等强域偏移场景提供高效、可扩展（含多模态）的参数高效微调方案。

title: UniqueShip: Mitigating Data Leakage in Acoustic Ship Classification Benchmark Datasets
comment: 9 pages paper, 4 pages supplementary at the end, accepted/will be published at Oceans 2026. Note that while this is underwater acoustics, we process it using computer vision models and methods (i.e. spectrograms)
summary: Underwater Acoustic Target Recognition (UATR) of ships is well-suited for machine learning, yet its progress is hindered by the lack of large, diverse, and publicly available labeled datasets. In this work, we introduce UniqueShip, a machine learning-ready benchmark dataset for UATR applications sourced from the open Ocean Networks Canada (ONC) repository. Unlike previous datasets, we explicitly control for "data leakage" between the training and evaluation sets to ensure more reliable and generalizable model evaluation that does not encourage the model to memorize individual ships. We demonstrate that typical, random data partitioning in two prominent UATR datasets leads to falsely optimistic test performance, increasing accuracy by 10-48 percentage points compared to our more careful partitioning. Ablations on UniqueShip further show that doubling the number of unique vessels improves accuracy by 2.4-2.6 percentage points, while doubling total audio duration improves only by 0.8-1.3 points, indicating that vessel diversity should drive dataset curation more than total hours. We provide baselines with convolutional and transformer backbones, and analyze how ship metadata correlates with classification performance, finding that individual vessel characteristics predict classification difficulty far better than distance to the hydrophone alone. Overall, UniqueShip contains 2,460 hours of ship-radiated audio from 4,218 unique vessels (3,437 hours including background). We publish the dataset, code, and easy-to-download splits at uniqueshipdata.org to foster further UATR research.

AI.tldr: 本文发布 UniqueShip——一个来自 ONC 开放库、面向水下声学目标识别（UATR）的大规模基准数据集，强调显式控制训练/评估集间的数据泄漏，并揭示随机划分导致的虚高性能及“船舶多样性比总时长更重要”的数据集构建原则。
AI.motivation: UATR 适合机器学习，但缺乏大规模、多样且公开可用的标注数据集；同时既有数据集常用随机划分，导致模型记忆个体船舶、评估虚高、泛化性差。
AI.method: 从 Ocean Networks Canada（ONC）开放库构建机器可用的基准数据集 UniqueShip，显式控制训练与评估集之间的数据泄漏；在既有两个主流 UATR 数据集上对比随机划分与谨慎划分；在 UniqueShip 上做消融（独特船舶数、总音频时长）；提供卷积与 Transformer 基线的评测，并分析船舶元数据与分类性能的相关性。
AI.result: 随机划分相比谨慎划分使准确率虚高 10–48 个百分点；船舶数翻倍带来 2.4–2.6 个百分点提升，总时长翻倍仅 0.8–1.3 个百分点；个体船舶特性比“到水听器距离”更能预测分类难度；UniqueShip 含 4,218 艘独特船舶共 2,460 小时舰船辐射噪声音频（含背景为 3,437 小时）。
AI.conclusion: 数据划分的去泄漏与船舶多样性应成为 UATR 数据集构建的核心原则；数据集、代码与易下载划分已公开于 uniqueshipdata.org，以推动后续研究。

title: FedV-KGQA in Practice: Design Lessons and an Interactive Prototype
comment: Accepted at the ISWC 2026 Posters and Demos Track; to appear in the ISWC 2026 Companion Volume (CEUR-WS)
summary: Knowledge graph question answering usually assumes that one system can reach the whole graph. In practice, facts are often held by organizations that share entity identifiers but own disjoint relation types, so no single party sees a complete reasoning chain. This poster presents the empirical findings of FedV-KGQA on multi-hop question answering over such vertically partitioned graphs. Each silo enriches its local graph and trains a knowledge graph embedding on its own triples. A server then concatenates the silo-specific entity views, anchors the projected question at the topic entity, and ranks candidates by similarity. Raw triples and relation embeddings never leave a silo. Comparing the FedV-KGQA experiments with one another yields three results. First, federated fusion recovers most of the centralized accuracy, while a single silo recovers little. Second, anchoring and enrichment matter more than the choice of embedding model. Third, the cheapest encoder depends on the target accuracy rather than on parameter count. This poster paper contributes that cross-experiment comparison, four design lessons drawn from it, and an interactive prototype that runs real inference and traces the full pipeline, per question, on released checkpoints.

AI.tldr: 本文分析了FedV-KGQA在垂直分区知识图谱上进行多跳问答的实证结果，展示了联邦融合可恢复大部分集中式准确率，并总结了四项设计经验及一个可交互原型。
AI.motivation: 现实中的知识图谱事实常由不同组织持有，它们共享实体标识但拥有不相交的关系类型，因此任何单一参与方都无法看到完整的推理链，传统假设可访问全图的KGQA系统难以适用。
AI.method: 每个数据隔离方（silo）丰富本地图谱并在本地三元组上训练知识图谱嵌入；服务器拼接各 silo 特有的实体视图，将投影后的问题锚定在主题实体上，并依据相似度对候选答案排序；原始三元组与关系嵌入始终保留在本地。
AI.result: 跨实验比较得到三点结果：联邦融合可恢复大部分集中式准确率，而单一 silo 仅能恢复少量准确率；锚定与图谱丰富比嵌入模型的选择更重要；最经济的编码器取决于目标准确率而非参数规模。
AI.conclusion: 本文贡献了跨实验比较、由此提炼的四项设计经验，以及一个可运行真实推理、按问题追踪完整流水线（基于已发布检查点）的交互式原型。

title: MARC: Morphology-Aware Regression of Consensus for Cell Segmentation in Subcellular Spatial Transcriptomics
comment: 8 pages, 4 figures
summary: Accurate cell segmentation remains a major bottleneck in subcellular spatial transcriptomics (SST), in which morphological images and spatially resolved RNA transcripts are used to partition tissues into individual cellular instances. As segmentation serves as the foundation for constructing cell-level representations, boundary errors can lead to incorrect transcript assignments and compromise downstream analyses. However, reliable ground-truth boundaries are unavailable because they must be inferred from incomplete morphological and transcript signals. Furthermore, manual annotation of a large number of cells is time-consuming. Agreement among complementary segmentation methods provides a practical surrogate for identifying well-supported and ambiguous regions, but explicit consensus construction requires executing multiple computationally intensive pipelines. In this study, we propose MARC (Morphology-Aware Regression of Consensus), a framework that predicts a multi-method consensus-support map for SST segmentation. MARC is trained with leave-one-method-out consensus pseudo-targets and a Foreground-Union Consensus Loss that focuses supervision on candidate and consensus foreground. We evaluated MARC on 4,642 held-out tiles from Xenium kidney tissue, achieving a mean Dice score of 0.90, a mean intersection-over-union of 0.82, and a mean cell-level Spearman correlation of 0.79 against explicitly computed cross-method consensus maps. We demonstrate that the predicted consensus maps localise weakly supported regions while preserving consensus-based rankings and identifying low-consensus cells for manual review. These results show that MARC closely approximates explicit cross-method consensus without multi-method inference and therefore has the potential to facilitate robust, consensus-aware evaluation of cell segmentation in large-scale SST studies.

AI.tldr: MARC框架通过预测多方法共识支持图来近似显式跨方法共识，无需运行多套分割流程即可评估SST细胞分割可靠性。
AI.motivation: 在亚细胞空间转录组学（SST）中，细胞分割是关键瓶颈：分割是构建细胞级表示的基础，边界错误会导致转录本分配错误并影响下游分析。然而可靠的ground-truth边界不可得，因为必须从不完整的形态学与转录信号中推断；同时人工标注大量细胞耗时。互补分割方法间的一致性可作为识别可靠区域与模糊区域的实用替代，但显式构建共识需要执行多个计算密集型流程。
AI.method: 提出MARC（Morphology-Aware Regression of Consensus）框架，用于为SST分割预测多方法共识支持图。采用留一方法（leave-one-method-out）共识伪标签进行训练，并使用Foreground-Union Consensus Loss，将监督聚焦于候选前景与共识前景区域。
AI.result: 在Xenium肾脏组织的4,642个留出（held-out）图块上评估，相对显式计算的跨方法共识图，取得平均Dice分数0.90、平均IoU 0.82、平均细胞级Spearman相关0.79。预测的共识图能定位支持度较弱的区域，同时保留基于共识的排序，并识别出低共识细胞以供人工复核。
AI.conclusion: MARC在不进行多方法推理的情况下即可高度近似显式跨方法共识，因而有望促进大规模SST研究中稳健、共识感知的细胞分割评估。

title: LayerRoute: Adaptive Layer-Skipping with LoRA-Preserved Quality for Efficient LLM Inference
summary: We introduce LayerRoute, a parameter-efficient method for adaptive transformer layer-skipping that combines per-layer hard-gated routing (trained via a straight-through estimator) with joint LoRA fine-tuning. LayerRoute augments each of the 24 transformer blocks in Qwen2.5-0.5B-Instruct with a lightweight per-layer router (~21.5K parameters) and LoRA adapters (rank 8, ~1.08M parameters), training both jointly under a gate-regularized language-modeling objective. Across 10 independently-seeded training runs, LayerRoute converges to an identical skip-pattern structure in every run - a consistent set of 9 middle layers (8-16) becomes skip-eligible in all 10 seeds - and delivers genuine, verified wallclock speedup in every run (1.02x-1.06x, mean 1.04x). Quality is preserved or improved in every configuration tested: joint LoRA adaptation yields a perplexity improvement over the unmodified backbone in all 10 seeds (mean delta = -1.16 and -1.11 across the two evaluation splits used). We further verify the router performs genuine, non-trivial per-input computation: gate decisions in skip-eligible layers change the actual skip/run outcome for 87-100% of held-out samples, confirming real input-dependent routing rather than a fixed pruning pattern. LayerRoute trains in under 7 minutes on a single A100 and adds negligible overhead beyond the routing decision itself. We report our full reproducibility methodology, including a systematic diagnostic investigation into what determines the router's per-input decisions, as part of this work.

AI.tldr: LayerRoute：结合逐层硬门控路由（直通估计器训练）与联合LoRA微调的参数高效自适应Transformer层跳过方法，在Qwen2.5-0.5B-Instruct上实现稳定可复现的加速与质量提升。
AI.motivation: 现有层跳过/剪枝方法多为固定模式，缺乏输入依赖的自适应路由，且加速收益与实际wallclock速度往往不匹配；同时希望以参数高效方式保留或提升模型质量。
AI.method: 为Qwen2.5-0.5B-Instruct的24个Transformer块各添加轻量逐层路由器（约21.5K参数）与LoRA适配器（rank 8，约1.08M参数），在门控正则化的语言建模目标下联合训练；路由器采用逐层硬门控并通过直通估计器（straight-through estimator）进行可微训练。
AI.result: 10次独立种子训练均收敛到相同跳过模式结构：中间9层（第8-16层）在所有种子中变为可跳过层；每次运行均取得经核实的实际wallclock加速（1.02x-1.06x，均值1.04x）；质量全部保持或提升，联合LoRA适配在两个评测划分上相对未修改骨干的困惑度平均改善为-1.16和-1.11；门控决策对87-100%的留出样本改变实际跳过/执行结果，验证了真实的输入依赖路由；单张A100上训练时间少于7分钟。
AI.conclusion: LayerRoute证明了参数高效的联合路由与LoRA微调可实现稳定、可复现、输入依赖的自适应层跳过，带来真实wallclock加速且不损失（甚至提升）质量，并附带完整的可复现方法学与路由器决策机制的诊断分析。

title: Not all Negation Cues are Equal: Affixal Negations Yield Better Negation Understanding
comment: Accepted to the EMNLP 2026 Main Conference
summary: Negation remains a longstanding challenge for both language models (LMs) and large language models (LLMs). Prior work mainly focuses on a small set of high-frequency single-word negation cues, such as not and never, with limited exploration of broader negation types and modern LLMs. To address this gap, we construct NegCue, a large-scale dataset containing over 1.8M samples spanning single-word, multi-word, and affixal negation with more than 200 unique cues. We further pre-train both encoder-only LMs and LLMs on NegCue to investigate how different negation types affect negation understanding. Experiments on five downstream benchmarks show that negation types contribute unevenly to performance gains under the same training scale. In particular, affixal negation yields the largest improvements, while the gains from the commonly studied single-word negation remain modest. Moreover, our results demonstrate that further pre-training improves negation understanding for both LMs and LLMs.

AI.tldr: 该研究构建了包含180万样本、覆盖单词/多词/词缀三类否定、200余种线索的大规模数据集NegCue，并对编码器LM与LLM进行预训练，发现不同否定类型对性能提升贡献不均，词缀否定增益最大，单字否定增益有限，且继续预训练能提升两类模型的否定理解能力。
AI.motivation: 否定理解是语言模型（LM）与大语言模型（LLM）长期面临的挑战。已有工作主要集中于not、never等少量高频单字否定线索，对更广泛的否定类型及现代LLM的探讨不足，存在明显研究空白。
AI.method: 构建大规模数据集NegCue，涵盖单词否定、多词否定与词缀否定，包含200余种独特否定线索、超过180万样本；在NegCue上对仅编码器LM和LLM进行预训练，并在五个下游基准上评估不同否定类型对否定理解的影响。
AI.result: 在相同训练规模下，不同否定类型对性能增益的贡献不均衡：词缀否定带来最大提升，而常被研究的单字否定增益较为有限；继续预训练可提升LM与LLM的否定理解能力。
AI.conclusion: 否定类型是影响模型否定理解的关键因素，应重视词缀等被忽视的否定形式；继续预训练是提升LM与LLM否定理解的有效途径，NegCue为系统性研究否定理解提供了大规模资源。

title: SONAR: A Structure-Consistent Neural Operator for Null-Space-Aware Sparse View CT Reconstruction
summary: Sparse-view computed tomography (CT) reduces radiation dose and acquisition time but remains severely ill-posed because incomplete projections poorly constrain null-space information. Existing learning-based methods often estimate this information in high-dimensional image space, conflate physical measurement errors with prediction errors, and depend on fixed discretizations. We propose SONAR, a Structure-Consistent Neural Operator for Null-Space-Aware Reconstruction. Instead of recovering the full null-space component, SONAR predicts a low-dimensional null-space-aware representation from the acquired projections as pseudo-measurements. It separates measurement and pseudo-measurement residuals, lifts them into the image domain through physics operators, and applies independent neural operators to constrain their structural effects, thereby accommodating admissible errors while suppressing unsupported structures. To support cross-discretization reconstruction, an anisotropic U-shaped neural operator models the periodic angular and nonperiodic detector dimensions using direction-dependent continuous supports, while image-domain neural operators re-discretize continuous kernels on target grids. These components form an optimization-inspired unrolled network. Experiments on simulated AAPM and clinical MARS photon-counting CT data demonstrate consistent improvements across seen and unseen view settings and unseen image resolutions. On AAPM dataset, SONAR improves PSNR by 1.87~dB at 62 views and by 7.63~dB under zero-shot transfer to a $512\times512$ grid over the strongest competing methods. SONAR also achieves the best overall performance in all clinical settings evaluated, demonstrating accurate, structurally reliable, and discretization-robust sparse-view CT reconstruction.

AI.tldr: 提出SONAR——一种结构一致性的神经算子，通过预测低维零空间感知表示、分离测量与伪测量残差，并借助各向异性U形神经算子实现跨离散化稀疏视角CT重建。
AI.motivation: 稀疏视角CT虽降低辐射剂量与采集时间，但严重病态，因投影不完整导致零空间信息约束不足。现有学习方法在高维图像空间估计该信息，混淆物理测量误差与预测误差，并依赖固定离散化。
AI.method: SONAR不恢复完整零空间分量，而是从采集投影预测低维零空间感知表示作为伪测量；分离测量残差与伪测量残差，经由物理算子提升至图像域，并用独立神经算子约束其结构效应，以容许可接受误差、抑制无支撑结构。采用各向异性U形神经算子以方向相关的连续支撑建模周期性角度维与非周期性探测器维，图像域神经算子将连续核重离散到目标网格，整体构成优化启发的展开网络。
AI.result: 在模拟AAPM与临床MARS光子计数CT数据上，于已见与未见视角及未见图像分辨率下均取得一致性提升。AAPM上62视角PSNR提升1.87 dB，零样本迁移至512×512网格提升7.63 dB，均优于最强对比方法；在所有评估的临床设置中总体性能最佳。
AI.conclusion: SONAR实现了准确、结构可靠且对离散化鲁棒的稀疏视角CT重建。

title: MomentBA: Second-order Spatial Moments for Anisotropic Correspondence Uncertainty in Differentiable Bundle Adjustment
summary: Most existing visual odometry (VO) systems treat feature correspondences as deterministic measurements or assign uniform uncertainty, ignoring the inherent localization ambiguity of different observations. However, correspondence uncertainty is often anisotropic due to image structures such as edges, repetitive patterns, and motion blur, which can significantly affect geometric optimization. In this work, we propose MomentBA, a geometry-aware bundle adjustment framework that derives anisotropic correspondence uncertainty from second-order spatial moments of local similarity responses. Instead of introducing additional covariance prediction networks, the proposed method directly converts matching response distributions into interpretable covariance estimates and incorporates them into bundle adjustment as correspondence-specific information matrices for uncertainty-aware residual weighting. Furthermore, the proposed formulation is integrated into a differentiable optimization framework, establishing a direct connection between correspondence uncertainty and geometric estimation. Experiments on the EuRoC MAV and TartanAir v1 Hard datasets demonstrate that MomentBA improves monocular visual odometry accuracy compared with existing feature-based and learning-based approaches. The proposed anisotropic covariance model achieves lower rotational errors and more robust trajectory estimation than fixed and isotropic uncertainty models, validating the effectiveness of geometry-induced uncertainty modeling for challenging visual environments.

AI.tldr: MomentBA：一种几何感知的BA框架，从局部相似度响应的二阶空间矩导出各向异性对应不确定性，作为特定于对应的信息矩阵嵌入BA进行不确定性加权，并集成到可微优化中，在EuRoC和TartanAir上提升单目VO精度。
AI.motivation: 现有视觉里程计(VO)把特征对应当作确定性测量或赋予均匀不确定性，忽略了不同观测固有的定位歧义。由于边缘、重复纹理、运动模糊等图像结构，对应不确定性往往呈各向异性，会显著影响几何优化，因此需要显式建模这种几何诱导的不确定性。
AI.method: 提出MomentBA：不引入额外的协方差预测网络，而是直接从局部相似度响应的二阶空间矩中导出各向异性对应不确定性，将匹配响应分布转化为可解释的协方差估计，并作为对应特定的信息矩阵融入光束法平差(BA)，实现不确定性感知的残差加权；同时将该形式化纳入可微优化框架，建立对应不确定性与几何估计之间的直接联系。
AI.result: 在EuRoC MAV和TartanAir v1 Hard数据集上，MomentBA相比现有基于特征和基于学习的方法提升了单目视觉里程计精度；所提出的各向异性协方差模型比固定和各项同性不确定性模型获得更低的旋转误差和更鲁棒的轨迹估计。
AI.conclusion: 各向异性协方差建模能有效利用几何诱导的不确定性，验证了其在挑战性视觉环境下对VO精度与鲁棒性的有效性。

title: Prefix Sharing Is a Sorting Problem
comment: 15 pages. Code: https://github.com/Darrenus/prefix-sharing-is-sorting
summary: LLM serving reuses KV cache by exact prefix match, so when a prompt is assembled from a set of reusable pieces -- retrieved passages, tool definitions, few-shot exemplars -- the order chosen for those pieces determines how much computation can be shared. Every deployed system fixes that order by a single global convention. We prove this is optimal only when requests contain at most two pieces, and asymptotically wrong in general. Our main result is a structure theorem: the minimum prefix-trie cost equals min_H sum_x w(x) t_x(H) over binary hierarchies H on the requests, where t_x(H) is the canonical decomposition size of the set of requests needing chunk x. Choosing chunk orders is therefore equivalent to choosing one hierarchy over requests. The identity yields an O(3^m) exact algorithm, identifies the two-chunk case as minimum vertex cover, and shows that on the leave-one-out family the optimum is the minimum external path length of a binary tree -- the merge-sort recursion -- so a global order pays Theta(n^2) against a true cost of Theta(n log n). Agglomerative clustering by common intersection is a tight 1/2-approximation for the achievable saving. On BM25 retrieval traces over three BEIR corpora the resulting layout reduces prefill by 17-36% against production RAG ordering, and the margin widens with retrieval depth as the theory predicts. Serving requests in the hierarchy's DFS order finally lets a cache holding one request's context attain the unbounded-cache optimum exactly, so cache capacity and reorder window act as substitutes.

AI.tldr: 本文证明LLM服务中全局固定的chunk排序仅在请求含至多两个piece时最优，一般情况下渐近错误；给出最小前缀trie代价等于请求上二元层次H的最小加权代价的结构定理，据此得到O(3^m)精确算法与聚类近似算法，并在BEIR检索轨迹上将prefill降低17-36%。
AI.motivation: LLM服务通过精确前缀匹配复用KV cache，当prompt由可复用piece（检索段落、工具定义、few-shot样例）拼装时，piece的排列顺序决定了可共享的计算量。现有部署系统用单一全局约定固定顺序，作者要检验该做法是否最优。
AI.method: 证明全局固定顺序仅在请求含至多两个piece时最优，一般情形渐近错误。核心是结构定理：最小前缀trie代价等于min_H sum_x w(x) t_x(H)，其中H为请求上的二元层次，t_x(H)为需要chunk x的请求集合的规范分解大小；从而chunk排序等价于在请求上选一个层次。由此给出O(3^m)精确算法，将两chunk情形识别为最小顶点覆盖，并用公共交集上的凝聚聚类作为紧的1/2近似。
AI.result: 在leave-one-out族上最优值为二元树最小外部路径长度（即归并排序递归），全局顺序付出Theta(n^2)而真实代价为Theta(n log n)。在三个BEIR语料库的BM25检索轨迹上，所得布局相较生产RAG排序将prefill减少17-36%，且随检索深度增加差距扩大，与理论一致。按层次DFS顺序服务请求，可使仅缓存单个请求上下文的cache恰好达到无界cache最优，故cache容量与重排窗口互为替代。
AI.conclusion: 全局固定chunk顺序一般非最优且代价可达Theta(n^2)量级；通过将chunk排序建模为请求上的二元层次选择，可获得精确与近似算法，并在实际检索轨迹上显著降低prefill，同时揭示cache容量与重排窗口的可替代关系。

title: Rank-Consistent Set Reasoning for Co-Salient Object Detection
summary: Co-salient object detection (Co-SOD) requires a model to find foreground regions that are salient in individual images and supported by the image group. We present \emph{Rank-Consistent Set Reasoning} (RCSR), a supervised dense-prediction framework that models a group as an unordered set rather than as a sequence of images or a semantic label. The core idea is to rank how strongly each spatial region agrees with a small collection of learned group slots at every image scale, and to aggregate these ranks with a robust trimmed statistic. This suppresses accidental pairwise matches and prevents one atypical group member from dominating the shared representation. A set encoder builds group slots directly from multi-scale visual features, while a rank-consistency gate measures whether the ordering of candidate regions is stable across group members. The gated slots are decoded jointly with per-image features to produce co-saliency maps. The model contains no natural-language branch, no open-vocabulary detector, and no external segmentation model. We further introduce a group permutation objective and hard-distractor augmentation so that the model learns the properties of a set-level target rather than memorizing image order or isolated visual saliency. We formulate an evaluation protocol for CoCA, CoSal2015, and CoSOD3k, together with tests of group-size robustness, distractor rejection, order invariance, and cross-dataset transfer.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 Rank-Consistent Set Reasoning (RCSR) 框架，将图像组建模为无序集合，通过多尺度组槽排序与稳健截尾统计实现协同显著性目标检测，无需语言分支、开放词汇检测器或外部分割模型。
AI.motivation: 协同显著性目标检测（Co-SOD）需要模型同时识别单图显著的前景区域与组内共同支持的区域。现有方法常将图像组建模为序列或依赖语义标签、语言分支、开放词汇检测器及外部分割模型，易受偶然的成对匹配影响，且单个异常组员可能主导共享表示。
AI.method: 提出 RCSR，一种监督式密集预测框架：将组视为无序集合。在每个图像尺度上，对每个空间区域与少量学习得到的组槽（group slots）的一致性强度进行排序，并用稳健截尾统计（trimmed statistic）聚合这些排序。集合编码器直接从多尺度视觉特征构建组槽；排序一致性门（rank-consistency gate）衡量候选区域排序在组员间的稳定性；门控后的组槽与单图特征联合解码生成协同显著性图。引入组置换目标（group permutation objective）与困难干扰物增强（hard-distractor augmentation）以学习集合级目标属性。
AI.result: 在 CoCA、CoSal2015 和 CoSOD3k 上制定了评估协议，并进行组大小鲁棒性、干扰物抑制、顺序不变性与跨数据集迁移测试。
AI.conclusion: RCSR 通过无序集合建模、排序一致性门控与稳健截尾聚合，有效抑制偶然成对匹配和异常组员主导问题，且不依赖自然语言分支、开放词汇检测器或外部分割模型，具备组大小鲁棒性和顺序不变性等集合级泛化能力。

title: When Edit Localization Amplifies Relative Selection Bias: Gradient Geometry, Target Mismatch, and Importance Weighting
comment: 21 pages, 5 figures
summary: Human corrections identify editable spans, but the examples receiving corrections may come from a selective feedback channel. We analyze this interaction at a fixed model checkpoint by decomposing a localized gradient into edited and retained untouched components. Squared relative selection bias is a ratio of quadratics whose derivative has the sign of an explicit quadratic polynomial. Localization can increase, decrease, or nonmonotonically change this diagnostic; its direction depends on component biases and geometry. Oracle importance weighting recovers the population mean for each fixed localization objective, but these objectives have different targets. Against one common full-gradient target, we derive the finite-sample mean-squared error, an analytic optimal retention coefficient, and a fixed-clipping extension. Exact finite-population calculations and 10,000 Monte Carlo repetitions per sample size verify the identities and counterexamples. Public human-post-edit experiments use two translation directions and pretrained models, with declared synthetic selection. An English-German extension differentiates 73.89 million native parameters. In all three declared settings, hard localization has higher relative bias but lower absolute bias than full retention. Untouched-component biases are nonzero and selected component means have negative inner products, so the general criterion applies where the simple unbiased/aligned explanation fails. Output-bias diagnostics show the same endpoint ordering of relative bias across both directions, with one interior maximum. Mechanisms reuse each language's records and include a mixture; they are not independent replications. The evidence separates relative amplification from absolute gradient error and establishes estimation properties, without inferring translation-quality gains or identifying actual complaint propensities.

AI.motivation: 人工修正只标注可编辑片段，但接受修正的样本可能来自选择性反馈通道；需要厘清“局部化”对相对选择偏差与绝对梯度误差的不同作用，避免把相对放大误读为绝对误差。
