AI.result: 精确有限总体计算与蒙特卡洛重复验证了恒等式与反例；在三种声明设置下，硬局部化的相对偏差更高但绝对偏差低于完全保留；未触及分量偏差非零，且被选择分量均值的内积为负，说明简单“无偏/对齐”解释失效；输出偏差诊断显示两个方向的相对偏差端点排序一致，且存在一个内部极大值。
AI.conclusion: 证据将相对放大与绝对梯度误差分离，建立了估计性质，但不推断翻译质量提升，也不识别真实的投诉倾向；不同机制复用各语言记录并含混合成分，并非独立重复。

title: Scaling Hindi Quantum Natural Language Processing through Automatic Pregroup Supertagging
comment: 8 pages, 1 figure, 2 tables
summary: Quantum Natural Language Processing (QNLP) uses pregroup grammars to translate grammatical structure into diagrammatic representations and quantum circuits. Recent Hindi QNLP work has shown that Hindi-specific pregroup grammars can support grammar-sensitive compositional models, but grammatical type assignment is still largely manual, limiting scalability. This paper formulates automatic Hindi pregroup supertagging as a token-level classification task. Using a manually annotated corpus of 380 Hindi sentences, we evaluate lexical, contextual, prompting-based, lexical-repair, and suffix/morphology-aware methods. Results show that simple lexical and contextual models are strong in this low-resource setting: contextual backoff achieves the best completed accuracy of 64.56\%, while raw Qwen2.5 prompting reaches only 11.65\%. Lexical repair raises LLM-assisted prediction to 64.08\%, demonstrating the value of constraining generative outputs with symbolic grammar knowledge. Diagnostic analysis further shows that seen and unambiguous tokens are much easier than unseen tokens, and suffix/morphology features improve karaka-token accuracy but not overall performance. These results show that automatic Hindi pregroup assignment is feasible and can reduce reliance on manual annotation in future multilingual QNLP pipelines.

AI.tldr: 该论文将印地语pregroup超标注形式化为token级分类任务，在380句人工标注语料上比较多种方法，发现上下文回退模型（64.56%）优于LLM直接提示（11.65%）。
AI.motivation: 印地语QNLP虽已有专用pregroup文法支持语法敏感的复合模型，但语法类型标注仍主要依赖人工，难以扩展。论文旨在实现印地语pregroup类型的自动标注，减少人工依赖。
AI.method: 构建380句人工标注的印地语语料；将自动pregroup超标注建模为token级分类任务；评估词汇、上下文、提示（prompting）、词汇修复（lexical repair）及后缀/形态感知等多类方法，并用符号文法知识约束生成式LLM输出。
AI.result: 上下文回退方法取得最佳完整准确率64.56%；Qwen2.5原始提示仅11.65%；词汇修复将LLM辅助预测提升至64.08%。诊断分析显示已见且无歧义token更易处理，后缀/形态特征提升karaka token准确率但未提升整体性能。
AI.conclusion: 印地语pregroup类型自动标注是可行的，可降低未来多语言QNLP流程对人工标注的依赖；在低资源场景下，简单词汇与上下文模型表现强劲，符号文法约束能显著改善LLM生成结果。

title: FFVO: A Feedforward Pose Decoder for Long-Horizon Visual Odometry
comment: 10 pages, 9 figures
summary: Stable and reliable 4D spatial understanding is fundamental for autonomous driving systems. While feedforward reconstruction networks can estimate camera motion and 3D structure in one pass, pose estimation over long videos remains challenged by computational cost, long-context ambiguity, and temporal instability. To address these challenges, we propose Feedforward Visual Odometry (FFVO), a pose-specialized adaptation of joint reconstruction architectures for efficient and temporally stable camera-pose estimation. FFVO uses (i) a compact camera-token representation for computationally efficient temporal aggregation, (ii) a hierarchical local-to-global temporal decoder that mitigates geometric ambiguity by separating short-range motion aggregation from sequence-level integration, and (iii) intermediate trajectory supervision that promotes temporal stability. Extensive evaluation on the Waymo Open Dataset (WOD), KITTI, and a large-scale proprietary benchmark demonstrates that our method performs favorably against existing feedforward approaches, and greatly reduces jitter and drift. These results support FFVO as an effective feedforward camera-pose decoder in long-horizon visual odometry settings.

AI.tldr: 提出FFVO，一种面向长视频的pose专用前馈视觉里程计方法，通过紧凑相机token、分层局部到全局时间解码器和中间轨迹监督，实现高效且时间稳定的相机位姿估计。
AI.motivation: 自动驾驶依赖稳定可靠的4D空间理解。前馈重建网络虽可单次估计相机运动与3D结构，但长视频位姿估计仍受限于计算成本高、长上下文歧义和时间不稳定性。
AI.method: FFVO是联合重建架构的位姿专用改造，包含三点：(i) 紧凑相机token表示以实现高效时间聚合；(ii) 分层局部到全局时间解码器，通过分离短程运动聚合与序列级整合缓解几何歧义；(iii) 中间轨迹监督以提升时间稳定性。
AI.result: 在Waymo Open Dataset、KITTI及大规模私有基准上广泛评估，FFVO优于现有前馈方法，并大幅降低抖动与漂移。
AI.conclusion: FFVO可作为长时域视觉里程计中有效的前馈相机位姿解码器。

title: PolicyMem: Geometric Policy Memory for LLM Governance
comment: 19 pages, 10 figures
summary: As large language models (LLMs) are increasingly deployed in real-world high-stakes applications, effective governance has become essential. Existing safeguards largely follow two paradigms: learning-based guards provide strong semantic discrimination but couple policy behavior to trained models and taxonomies, while programmable frameworks offer flexible control but require substantial manual prompt and workflow engineering. Neither externalizes policies as reusable operational states, making it difficult to consistently reuse policy evidence across detection, intervention, and verification. In this paper, we introduce PolicyMem, a geometric policy memory that externalizes natural-language policies as reusable geometric memory objects represented by low-rank subspaces in a shared representation space. A memory writer compiles natural-language policies into policy memory slots, and query-response pairs read the policy memory through projection energy. The resulting policy-evidence profile directly mediates the safety verdict and is reused for policy attribution and post-intervention verification. Coupled with a response rewriter, PolicyMem enables a detect-rewrite-verify loop for LLM governance. Across five widely used benchmarks, PolicyMem achieves state-of-the-art unsafe behavior detection while enabling effective policy attribution, rewriting, and post-intervention verification through the shared policy memory.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 PolicyMem，一种几何策略记忆，将自然语言策略外化为共享表示空间中低秩子空间构成的几何记忆对象，通过投影能量读取策略证据，并支持检测-改写-验证的治理闭环。
AI.motivation: LLM 在高风险场景的部署使治理成为必需，但现有防护范式存在局限：基于学习的安全守卫语义判别能力强，却将策略行为与训练模型和分类体系耦合；可编程框架控制灵活，但需大量人工的提示与工作流工程。两者都未将策略外化为可复用的操作状态，导致策略证据难以在检测、干预与验证间一致复用。
AI.method: 提出 PolicyMem 几何策略记忆：将自然语言策略外化为可复用的几何记忆对象，用共享表示空间中的低秩子空间表示。记忆写入器将自然语言策略编译为策略记忆槽；查询-响应对通过投影能量读取策略记忆；得到的策略证据画像直接中介安全判定，并复用于策略归因与干预后验证；结合响应改写器形成检测-改写-验证闭环。
AI.result: 在五个广泛使用的基准上，PolicyMem 在实现最先进的不安全行为检测的同时，借助共享策略记忆有效支持策略归因、改写与干预后验证。
AI.conclusion: 将策略外化为可复用的几何记忆对象，可在检测、干预与验证间一致复用策略证据，为 LLM 治理提供兼具语义判别力与灵活可编程性的统一路径。

title: ForeSight: Enhancing Risk Monitoring via Early Safety Signal Distillation
comment: 17 pages, 12 figures. Accepted to Findings of EMNLP 2026
summary: As large language models (LLMs) are increasingly deployed, the generation of harmful content has become a critical safety concern. Existing safeguards operate at the input, output, or streaming-generation stages, while early-risk methods that rely on surface tokens or output logits may suffer from weak initial signals, and internals-based detectors using dense representations may retain highly entangled and redundant safety-irrelevant information. It therefore remains unclear whether the earliest post-generation hidden states already contain reliable signals about final-response harmfulness. To address this gap, we propose ForeSight, a first-token output-risk forecasting framework that distills weak and redundant early safety signals into compact, layer-aware risk representations. Experiments on five safety benchmarks and two target models demonstrate that ForeSight achieves superior and efficient early-risk forecasting while relying solely on first-token hidden states. The code is available at: https://github.com/Scabbards1500/Foresight

AI.tldr: 提出ForeSight，仅用首个token的隐状态即可预测最终回复的危害性，将早期微弱且冗余的安全信号蒸馏为紧凑的、层感知的风险表示。
AI.motivation: LLM生成有害内容已成为关键安全关切。现有防护手段作用于输入、输出或流式生成阶段；基于表面token或输出logits的早期风险方法初始信号弱，而基于内部稠密表示的检测器又保留大量与安全无关的纠缠和冗余信息。因此，最早的生成后隐状态是否已包含关于最终回复危害性的可靠信号仍不清楚。
AI.method: 提出ForeSight，一种首token输出风险预测框架，将早期微弱且冗余的安全信号蒸馏为紧凑的、层感知（layer-aware）的风险表示，仅依赖第一token的隐状态进行预测。
AI.result: 在五个安全基准和两个目标模型上，ForeSight均实现了更优且高效的早期风险预测，且仅使用首token隐状态。
AI.conclusion: 首个token的隐状态已包含可用的危害性信号；通过层感知的紧凑风险表示蒸馏，可在极早期实现高效、可靠的有害响应预测。代码已开源于https://github.com/Scabbards1500/Foresight。

title: HarnessBandit: Joint Learnability-Transferability Scheduling for Multi-Harness Agentic Reinforcement Learning
comment: 13 pages. Equal contribution: Hongliang Wei and Xiaobing Tu. Corresponding authors: Xiaobing Tu and Xiaopeng Fan
summary: Language-model agents are increasingly deployed through diverse harnesses that differ in system prompts, tool schemas, control loops, and trajectory formats. The same model can perform unevenly across these interfaces, making robustness to harness variation an important objective. A natural approach is to train a shared policy through multiple harnesses, but doing so introduces a scheduling problem: each training step should favor a harness that currently provides a useful learning signal while also producing an update that benefits the other harnesses. We develop HarnessBandit, an online scheduler that selects one harness per optimizer step. After a group-relative policy optimization (GRPO) update, it observes learnability -- the mean absolute advantage on the batch -- and transferability -- the cosine between a low-dimensional gradient sketch of the current harness and exponential moving averages of the remaining harnesses. The two signals are fused after pooled sliding-window min-max normalization and sampled with a visit-dependent bonus and an explicit exploration floor. We train Qwen3.5-2B across six harnesses on ClawGym and evaluate on PinchBench (held-out tasks, in-distribution OpenClaw) and ClawEval (held-out tasks and harness). HarnessBandit improves over mixed-batch multi-harness training on both benchmarks, while training diagnostics indicate that learnability and transferability provide distinct, evolving signals.

AI.tldr: 提出 HarnessBandit，一种在线调度器，每个优化步选择一个 harness 进行训练，融合可学习性与可迁移性信号，在多个 harness 间平衡学习收益。
AI.motivation: 语言模型智能体常通过不同的 harness（系统提示、工具模式、控制循环、轨迹格式各异）部署，同一模型在不同接口下表现不均，因此对 harness 变化的鲁棒性成为重要目标。多 harness 共享策略训练会引入调度问题：每步既需选择当前能提供有效学习信号的 harness，又需保证更新对其他 harness 有益。
AI.method: HarnessBandit 每个优化步选择一个 harness。在 GRPO 更新后，观测两个信号：可学习性（批上平均绝对优势）与可迁移性（当前 harness 的低维梯度草图与其余 harness 指数移动平均之间的余弦相似度）。两信号经池化滑动窗口 min-max 归一化后融合，并以访问依赖奖励和显式探索下限进行采样。
AI.result: 在 ClawGym 上跨六个 harness 训练 Qwen3.5-2B，并在 PinchBench（留出任务、OpenClaw 同分布）与 ClawEval（留出任务与 harness）上评估。HarnessBandit 在两个基准上均优于混合批次的多 harness 训练。训练诊断显示可学习性与可迁移性提供的是不同且动态演化的信号。
AI.conclusion: 将多 harness 训练建模为在线调度问题，并通过融合可学习性与可迁移性的 bandit 调度策略，可提升模型对 harness 变化的鲁棒性与跨接口泛化能力。

title: Hyper-LLaVA: Hyperbolic Uncertainty-aware Modality-Balanced Routing for Multimodal Continual Instruction Tuning
comment: Accepted by ICML 2026
summary: Multimodal Continual Instruction Tuning (MCIT) aims to exploit the incrementally accumulated knowledge to process multimodal inputs of diverse tasks, where parameter routing plays an important role. State-of-the-art methods rely on sample-to-task center similarity and cross-modal fusion with equal weight during routing. However, such solutions face two fundamental flaws: (1) Within each modality, the sample-to-task center distance is sub-optimal for routing since the abundant intra-task diversity information is underleveraged. (2) Different modalities exhibit varying reliability across tasks, where the modality with inter-task ambiguity can easily misguide the routing result. To address these problems, we propose Hyperbolic Uncertainty-aware Modality-Balanced Routing (Hyper-LLaVA) to improve parameter routing capacity based on cross-modality task feature uncertainty modeling. Specifically, to improve intra-modality task matching, Hyper-LLaVA accesses the sample-to-task distribution similarity in the Hyperbolic space. Besides, to alleviate the degradation brought by unreliable modalities, Hyper-LLaVA quantifies the task matching ambiguity within each modality to achieve adaptive balancing between task matching across modalities. Based on the complementary intra- and inter-modality task matching enhancement, our Hyper-LLaVA outperforms state-of-the-art approaches by large margins. Our source code is available at https://github.com/zhoujiahuan1991/ICML2026-Hyper-LLaVA

AI.tldr: 本文提出 Hyper-LLaVA，一种基于双曲不确定性感知与模态均衡的路由方法，用于多模态持续指令微调（MCIT）中的参数路由。
AI.motivation: 现有最优方法依赖"样本到任务中心相似度"与等权重的跨模态融合进行路由，存在两大缺陷：（1）模态内样本到任务中心的距离忽略了丰富的任务内多样性信息，导致路由次优；（2）不同模态在各任务上的可靠性不同，存在任务间歧义的模态易误导路由结果。
AI.method: 提出 Hyper-LLaVA，基于跨模态任务特征不确定性建模提升参数路由能力。具体地：（1）在双曲（Hyperbolic）空间中访问样本到任务的分布相似度，改进模态内任务匹配；（2）在每个模态内量化任务匹配歧义，实现跨模态任务匹配的自适应均衡，以缓解不可靠模态带来的性能退化。
AI.result: 基于模态内与模态间任务匹配的互补增强，Hyper-LLaVA 大幅超越当前最优方法。
AI.conclusion: 代码开源（https://github.com/zhoujiahuan1991/ICML2026-Hyper-LLaVA），从模态内分布相似度与模态间不确定性均衡两方面共同提升参数路由性能。

title: Inside VLM Chart Reading: Tracing Value Reading from Vertical Bar Charts Across Space and Depth
summary: Vision--language models (VLMs) can answer chart questions accurately, but output accuracy does not show how they combine the evidence needed to recover an exact value. We study vertical-bar value reading with controlled counterfactual activation patching in Qwen2.5VL-7B-Instruct and InternVL3.5-8B. The study connects three analyses: (1) The single-factor results show that the changed bar-top region restores much more answer preference than the unchanged bar body, despite containing fewer visual tokens. Legend- and series-related states also lose local recoverability earlier than bar-geometry and axis-scale states. (2) In the handoff analysis, restoration shifts from visual legend regions in early layers to prompt-series positions in middle layers. Resetting the prompt-series state selectively reduces legend-source rescue, supporting its role as a partial mediator. (3) In the factorial analysis, both models can use geometry and scale states from separate donors to favor the combined target. InternVL performs similarly when the states come from separate donors or one image, while Qwen shows lower restoration for separate donors which suggests higher context sensitivity. Together, these results provide preliminary causal evidence for localizing the internal computations that support exact bar-value reading.

AI.tldr: 该研究通过受控反事实激活修补,在Qwen2.5VL-7B-Instruct与InternVL3.5-8B上探究条形图数值读取的内部因果机制。
AI.motivation: 视觉语言模型能较准确地回答图表问题,但输出准确率无法揭示模型如何组合证据以恢复精确数值,因此需要因果层面的内部机制分析。
AI.method: 采用单因素激活修补、跨层信息交接分析与因子化(多供体状态组合)分析三类实验范式。
AI.result: (1)改变的柱顶区域虽视觉token更少,却比未变的柱体恢复更多答案偏好;图例与系列相关状态比柱几何与轴刻度状态更早失去局部可恢复性。(2)恢复效应从早期层的视觉图例区转向中层提示中的系列位置,重置该提示状态会选择性降低图例来源的救援。(3)两模型均可利用来自不同供体的几何与刻度状态支持组合目标;InternVL在分离供体与单图供体下表现相近,Qwen在分离供体下恢复更低,提示其上下文敏感性更高。
AI.conclusion: 结果为定位支撑精确条形数值读取的内部计算提供了初步因果证据。

title: Development of Low-Cost Real-Time Driver Drowsiness Detection System using Eye Centre Tracking and Dynamic Thresholding
summary: One in every five vehicle accidents on the road today is caused simply due to driver fatigue. Fatigue or otherwise drowsiness, significantly reduces the concentration and vigilance of the driver thereby increasing the risk of inherent human error leading to injuries and fatalities. Hence, our primary motive being - to reduce road accidents using a non-intrusive image processing based alert system. In this regard, we have built a system that detects driver drowsiness by real time tracking and monitoring the pattern of the driver's eyes. The stand alone system consists of 3 interconnected components - a processor, a camera and an alarm. After initial facial detection, the eyes are located, extracted and continuously monitored to check whether they are open or closed on the basis of a pixel-by-pixel method. When the eyes are seen to be closed for a certain amount of time, drowsiness is said to be detected and an alarm is issued accordingly to alert the driver and hence, prevent a casualty.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种基于非侵入式图像处理的驾驶员疲劳检测报警系统，通过摄像头实时跟踪驾驶员眼睛的开闭状态来判断疲劳，并在检测到持续闭眼时触发报警以预防事故。
AI.motivation: 道路上每五起车辆事故中就有一起是由驾驶员疲劳直接引起的。疲劳或困倦会显著降低驾驶员的注意力和警觉性，从而增加人为失误的风险，导致人员伤亡和死亡。因此，作者的核心动机是利用非侵入式图像处理报警系统来减少道路交通事故。
AI.method: 系统为独立装置，由三个相互连接的组件构成：处理器、摄像头和报警器。方法流程为：先进行初始人脸检测，随后定位并提取眼睛区域，基于逐像素方法持续监测眼睛是睁开还是闭合；当检测到眼睛持续闭合一定时间时，即判定为疲劳，并相应发出报警以提醒驾驶员。
AI.result: 论文未提供定量实验结果，仅描述了系统功能：通过实时跟踪与监测驾驶员眼睛开闭模式来检测疲劳，并在眼睛持续闭合一定时间后触发报警，从而提醒驾驶员、防止伤亡。
AI.conclusion: 该研究表明，基于非侵入式图像处理的实时眼睛状态监测可以作为驾驶员疲劳检测的可行方案，通过及时报警减少因疲劳驾驶导致的道路伤亡事故。

title: HyperProve: Answer-Guided Hypergraph Expansion for Multi-Hop Question Answering
comment: EMNLP 2026
summary: Multi-hop question answering often fails when retrieval treats evidence as isolated matches to the original question, since the facts needed to answer a complex question are usually connected through intermediate entities, relations, and constraints. We propose HyperProve, a retrieval-augmented QA framework that addresses this challenge by coupling question decomposition with answer-conditioned expansion over a hypergraph of atomic facts. HyperProve does not use atomic facts, hypergraphs, or iterative retrieval in isolation; instead, it carries intermediate answers and supporting hyperedges as retrieval state, then uses that state to bias the next local hypergraph expansion. This design enables HyperProve to construct coherent evidence chains for final answer generation while making the retrieval process stateful and fact-centered. Across multi-hop QA benchmarks, HyperProve achieves the best overall performance in our evaluation, outperforming the strongest baselines by an average relative improvement of 6.2% in answer accuracy and 4.9% in F1.

AI.tldr: HyperProve：以“问题分解 + 答案条件化超图扩展”为核心的检索增强问答框架，将中间答案与支撑超边作为检索状态，使下一轮局部超图扩展被该状态偏置，从而构建连贯证据链。在多跳QA基准上取得最佳总体表现，答案准确率平均相对提升6.2%，F1提升4.9%。
AI.motivation: 多跳问答中，若把证据当作对原始问题的孤立匹配来检索，往往失败；因为回答复杂问题所需的事实通常通过中间实体、关系和约束相互连接，需要跨跳的关联性检索而非单点匹配。
AI.method: 提出HyperProve检索增强QA框架：将问题分解与基于原子事实超图的答案条件化扩展相耦合。该框架不是孤立使用原子事实、超图或迭代检索，而是把中间答案与支撑超边作为检索状态，并利用该状态偏置下一次局部超图扩展，使检索过程具备状态性且以事实为中心，用于构建连贯证据链并生成最终答案。
AI.result: 在多跳QA基准评测中，HyperProve取得最佳总体性能，相较最强基线平均相对提升：答案准确率6.2%，F1 4.9%。
AI.conclusion: 将中间答案与支撑超边显式建模为检索状态，并据此驱动超图上的条件化局部扩展，可有效缓解多跳问答中孤立证据匹配导致的失败，提升证据链连贯性与最终答案性能。

title: Training Specialist Models without Reasoning Trajectories for Domain Expert Distillation
summary: Specialist distillation effectively transfers domain expertise to student models via teacher-generated reasoning trajectories. However, when these specialists are trained solely on question--answer pairs without explicit reasoning supervision, what governs the trajectories they generate? In this work, we show that specialist optimization implicitly selects from this latent trajectory space. To isolate and observe this latent distribution, we leverage student distillation not as a downstream goal, but as an agnostic probe---since students inherit no parameterization or optimization constraints from the specialist, inheriting only the sampled trajectories themselves. Through this probe, our empirical analysis unveils a tight governing relationship: across 27 specialist--student pairings, their specialization--generalization profiles correlate exceptionally strongly. Crucially, explicitly controlling the specialist's distributional drift systematically shifts both the teacher and its distilled student along a controllable trade-off between domain precision and general-capability retention. Across chemistry, physics, and multilingual settings, distilled students systematically reflect these specialist-induced profiles, even across divergent model families. Our findings establish a new view of specialist training: when gold reasoning is absent, tuning choices directly control the latent supervision passed to downstream models.

AI.tldr: 本文将学生蒸馏作为"探针"，研究了缺乏显式推理监督的专家模型在生成推理轨迹时的隐含分布，发现专家优化过程隐性选择了潜在轨迹空间，且专家与其蒸馏学生的专业化-泛化曲线高度相关，可通过控制专家的分布漂移来调控这一权衡。
AI.motivation: 专家蒸馏能将领域知识转移给学生模型，但当专家模型仅用问答对训练、缺乏显式推理监督时，其生成轨迹受何种因素支配尚不清楚，需要揭示这种潜在轨迹分布及其对下游学生的影响机制。
AI.method: 将学生蒸馏作为不依赖参数或优化约束的"不可知探针"，仅继承采样轨迹；在27组专家-学生配对中进行实证分析，并通过显式控制专家的分布漂移来观察其对教师及学生的系统影响。
AI.result: 专家与学生的专业化-泛化曲线表现出极强的相关性；显式控制专家分布漂移能系统性地移动教师及其蒸馏学生在领域精度与通用能力保留之间的权衡，且该现象在化学、物理和多语言场景以及不同模型家族中均成立。
AI.conclusion: 该研究提出对专家训练的新视角：当缺乏黄金推理时，微调选择直接控制传递给下游模型的潜在监督信号。

title: Does Reasoning Improve Psychological Depth in Large Language Models? It Depends on Who's Judging
comment: 24 pages
summary: LLM-as-a-Judge evaluators are increasingly used to score open-ended generation, yet a judge's correlation with human ratings on its development set may not guarantee valid measurement when outputs are closely matched and human preferences are subjective. We study this failure mode through psychological depth in short stories. Seven human readers and an LLM-judge ensemble selected on the original scalar Psychological Depth Scale dataset ($ρ= 0.646$) evaluated 60 blinded, prompt-matched story pairs from GPT-5 vs.\ GPT-4o and DeepSeek-R1 vs.\ DeepSeek-V3. Human preferences showed no universal reasoning advantage: GPT-5 was modestly preferred over GPT-4o (60.0--62.9\%), whereas DeepSeek-R1 trailed V3 (42.9\%), and inter-reader agreement was near chance (Krippendorff's $α= 0.070$), with within-reader consistency and recurring weighting patterns suggesting structured heterogeneity rather than random responding. The judge, by contrast, favored reasoning outputs in 89.0\% of dimension-level comparisons and 59 of 60 pairs on aggregate PDS, uniformly across all five evaluator configurations, and its scores were associated with surface features such as sentence length and lexical diversity. These results suggest that development-set performance is insufficient evidence for deployment validity on a shifted distribution, and that point-estimate judges can obscure the heterogeneity in subjective human evaluation.

AI.tldr: 通过短篇小说"心理深度"评测案例发现，LLM评审在开发集上与人类评分相关性尚可（ρ=0.646），但在分布偏移、人类偏好高度主观的场景下失效：人类读者间一致性接近随机（α=0.070），且不存在普遍的"推理模型更优"效应；而LLM评审在89.0%的维度比较中倾向推理模型输出，其打分与句长、词汇多样性等表层特征相关。
AI.motivation: LLM-as-a-Judge被广泛用于开放式生成评分，但评审者在开发集上与人类评分的相关性，未必能保证其在输出质量接近、人类偏好主观的场景下仍具测量效度。作者希望揭示这种"开发集表现≠部署效度"的失败模式。
AI.method: 以短篇小说的"心理深度"为研究载体。选取7名人类读者，以及在原始标量心理深度量表数据集上筛选出的LLM评审集成（ρ=0.646）。对来自GPT-5 vs GPT-4o、DeepSeek-R1 vs DeepSeek-V3的60组盲测、提示词匹配的故事对进行评分比较，并分析评审分数与表层文本特征（句长、词汇多样性）的关联。
AI.result: 人类偏好未显示普遍的推理优势：GPT-5相对GPT-4o仅略占优（60.0–62.9%），DeepSeek-R1反而落后于V3（42.9%）；读者间一致性接近随机（Krippendorff's α=0.070），但读者内部一致性与反复出现的权重模式表明这是结构化的异质性而非随机作答。LLM评审则在89.0%的维度级比较中偏好推理模型输出，在60组中有59组于聚合PDS上选择推理输出，且在全部五种评审配置下表现一致，其分数与句长、词汇多样性等表层特征相关。
AI.conclusion: 开发集性能不足以作为分布偏移下部署效度的证据；点估计式评审会掩盖主观人类评价中的异质性。

title: When Do Learned Priors Help Visual Inertial Estimation? A Controlled Study of Prior Integration, Calibration, Initialization, and Backend Consistency
summary: Learned components are increasingly integrated into geometric visual--inertial estimators to provide motion, depth, bias, uncertainty, or confidence cues. Yet it remains unclear whether gains arise from useful learned priors or from changes in the backend, calibration, initialization, temporal association, or evaluation gauge. We present a controlled framework for learning-augmented visual--inertial estimation that separates fusion gain from the incremental value of a learned prior and evaluates four evidence layers: local motion consistency, global trajectory accuracy, physical-state correctness, and numerical consistency. We instantiate the framework with a MonoViT-based monocular motion prior added as a local relative-motion factor to an unchanged VINS backend. We compare Original VINS and learned-prior VINS under matched sensor streams, timestamps, initialization, frontend/backend settings, and camera--IMU extrinsics, while probing calibration, initialization, state coupling, scale, bundle adjustment, and loop closure. On KITTI, with fixed reference extrinsics, translation APE RMSE is 31.4 m for Original VINS and 31.8 m with the learned prior. Across four recordings, the prior changes mean APE by only -0.2%, while a five-times-higher weight worsens it by 8.2%. Online extrinsic updates increase mean APE by 45.7% and 52.1%, respectively, while mean RPE changes by less than 2%. These results show that fusion performance alone cannot establish the value of learned priors. Reliable evaluation requires same-backend controls and joint analysis of prior compatibility, calibration, initialization, global drift, physical-state error, and backend consistency.

AI.tldr: 提出受控框架，分离视觉惯性估计中"融合增益"与"学习先验增益"，用MonoViT先验插入未改动的VINS后端并经四层证据评估。
AI.motivation: 学习组件被广泛嵌入几何视觉惯性估计器以提供运动、深度、偏置、不确定性或置信度线索，但增益究竟来自有用的学习先验，还是来自后端、标定、初始化、时间关联或评估规范的变化，尚不明确。现有工作缺乏同后端对照，无法确立学习先验的独立价值。
AI.method: 构建受控学习增强视觉惯性估计框架：将"融合增益"与"学习先验的增量价值"分离，并评估四个证据层（局部运动一致性、全局轨迹精度、物理状态正确性、数值一致性）。实例化方式为：将基于MonoViT的单目运动先验作为局部相对运动因子加入未改动的VINS后端。在传感器流、时间戳、初始化、前后端设置及相机-IMU外参均匹配的条件下对比原始VINS与学习先验VINS，并针对标定、初始化、状态耦合、尺度、BA和回环进行探测。
AI.result: KITTI上，固定参考外参时平移APE RMSE为原始VINS 31.4 m、学习先验VINS 31.8 m；四段序列上先验使平均APE仅变化-0.2%，而权重提高五倍则恶化8.2%。在线外参更新使平均APE分别增加45.7%与52.1%，而平均RPE变化小于2%。
AI.conclusion: 仅凭融合性能无法证明学习先验的价值；可靠评估需要同后端对照，并联合分析先验兼容性、标定、初始化、全局漂移、物理状态误差与后端一致性。

title: GEAR: From Dynamic Encoding to Dynamic Activation in Social Trajectory Prediction
comment: Accepted by ICDM 2026
summary: Human trajectory prediction requires modeling both individual motion patterns and social interactions among agents. Existing methods have made substantial progress by using attention mechanisms, graph structures, and temporal encoders to capture dynamic social context. However, most of them primarily focus on how social information is encoded, while paying less explicit attention to how the encoded social context should take effect during future trajectory generation. In this paper, we argue that dynamic social encoding does not necessarily imply dynamic social activation. The same interaction context may require different activation strengths across future horizons and scene densities: social cues should be strengthened when interaction evidence is strong, but suppressed when they are weak or noisy. To address this issue, we propose GEAR, a generation-aware bias activation model for human trajectory prediction. Built upon a bias-decomposed trajectory generation formulation, GEAR dynamically activates the individual-motion and social-resonance bias terms at each future step before final trajectory composition. This allows the model to explicitly control when and how strongly individual and social bias components participate in generation. Experiments on ETH-UCY, SDD, and NBA show that GEAR consistently improves the resonance-based baseline and achieves competitive state-of-the-art performance. Further analyses of activation patterns and density-grouped errors validate the importance of calibrating encoded social context during trajectory generation. Our code is available at https://github.com/11isnotavailable/GEAR.git.

AI.tldr: 提出GEAR模型，通过生成感知的偏置激活机制，在轨迹生成阶段动态调节个体运动偏置与社会共振偏置，解决"动态社交编码不等于动态社交激活"的问题。
AI.motivation: 现有行人轨迹预测方法主要关注社交信息如何被编码（注意力、图结构、时序编码器），却较少显式考虑被编码的社交上下文在生成未来轨迹时何时、以何种强度生效。同一交互上下文在不同预测时间跨度与场景密度下需要不同的激活强度：交互证据强时应增强，弱或噪声大时应抑制。
AI.method: 提出GEAR（Generation-aware bias activation model）。基于偏置分解的轨迹生成公式，将轨迹拆分为个体运动偏置项与社会共振偏置项，并在每个未来时间步、最终轨迹合成之前动态激活这两类偏置项，从而显式控制个体与社会成分参与生成的时机与强度。
AI.result: 在ETH-UCY、SDD和NBA数据集上，GEAR稳定优于基于social-resonance的基线，并取得有竞争力的SOTA性能。对激活模式的分析和按密度分组的误差分析验证了在轨迹生成阶段校准已编码社交上下文的重要性。
AI.conclusion: 动态社交编码并不必然意味着动态社交激活；在生成阶段显式校准社交上下文的激活强度对提升轨迹预测性能至关重要。代码已开源。

title: Restore What Matters: Lessons from Joint Restoration and Recognition
summary: Recognition pipelines typically adopt a restore-then-recognize workflow, yet decades of experience show that generating visually pleasing images seldom translates to improved recognition. We propose a Joint Restoration-for-Recognition (JR$^2$) paradigm: restore only what downstream tasks truly require, with task signals dictating where, how much, and whether restoration is necessary. JR$^2$ rests on three pillars: (i) Physics, employing optics-accurate turbulence simulation, extensible to blur and noise, to ground restoration in real image formation; (ii) Neuroscience, drawing on selective attention and neuroplasticity to direct model capacity toward identity-critical regions and frames while bypassing already-clean inputs; and (iii) Vision & Learning, coupling recognition loss end-to-end through restoration and alignment so that low-level edits maximize high-level identity stability. Evaluations on IARPA-BRIAR show consistent improvements (e.g., TAR@0.01% FAR +0.6; FNIR@1% FPIR -2.5), while a quality gate skips ~70% of clean frames, reducing cost. Ablations confirm physics priors enhance realism, joint training prevents catastrophic forgetting, and selective restoration suffices in many cases. We conclude that better-looking images are neither necessary nor sufficient; restoration modules must be task-driven, selective, and physically aware. Code, pretrained models, and recipes are provided for integration.

AI.tldr: 提出JR²范式，主张"按任务需求做修复"，用物理仿真、选择性注意力/神经可塑性、端到端识别损失三支柱实现修复与识别联合优化，在IARPA-BRIAR上取得识别提升并降低计算成本。
AI.motivation: 传统"先修复再识别"级联流程中，视觉观感提升往往无法转化为识别性能提升（美观图像既非充分也非必要）。因此需要让下游识别任务信号决定修复的位置、强度与必要性。
AI.method: JR²基于三大支柱：(i) 物理——光学精确的湍流仿真，可扩展至模糊与噪声，使修复贴合真实成像过程；(ii) 神经科学——借鉴选择性注意与神经可塑性，将模型容量导向身份关键区域与帧，跳过已清晰输入；(iii) 视觉与学习——将识别损失经修复与对齐端到端耦合，使低层编辑最大化高层身份稳定性。另设质量门控跳过干净帧。
AI.result: 在IARPA-BRIAR上持续提升：如TAR@0.01%FAR +0.6，FNIR@1%FPIR -2.5；质量门控跳过约70%干净帧，降低成本。消融显示物理先验增强真实感、联合训练防止灾难性遗忘、选择性修复在多数情形下已足够。
AI.conclusion: 结论：更好看的图像既非必要也非充分，修复模块必须任务驱动、选择性强且具物理感知。作者提供代码、预训练模型与配方以便集成。

title: SyRHM: Symbolic-Language-Enhanced Reasoning with Associative Retrieval for Zero-shot Harmful Meme Detection
comment: 17 pages, 14 figures. Accepted to EMNLP 2026
summary: Detecting harmful memes is critical for maintaining safe online communities. However, harmful intent is often implicit, arising from visual-textual incongruity and cultural stereotypes, which challenges existing multimodal detectors. We propose SyRHM, a framework that decomposes harmful meme detection into meaning-grounded retrieval and symbolic-language-enhanced multi-stage reasoning. SyRHM retrieves semantically related memes by parsing multimodal content into textual elements and descriptions, providing grounded context beyond surface-level similarity. Building on the retrieved context, SyRHM uses a translator stage to convert multimodal inputs into symbolic intermediate representations, and then performs multi-stage reasoning via planner and solver stages, enabling expressive and interpretable analysis of harmful intent. Experiments on FHM, HarM, and MultiOff demonstrate the effectiveness of SyRHM, achieving superior performance on most evaluation settings against multimodal and reasoning-based baselines, while providing reasoning traces for harmful content. The code is available at: https://github.com/Scabbards1500/SyRHM

AI.tldr: 提出 SyRHM 框架，将有害表情包检测分解为"意义锚定的检索"与"符号语言增强的多阶段推理"，在 FHM、HarM、MultiOff 上取得优于多模态与推理类基线的表现，并能输出可解释的推理轨迹。
AI.motivation: 有害表情包的有害意图往往是隐式的，源于图文不一致与文化刻板印象，现有多模态检测器难以捕捉这种隐含语义，因此需要引入外部依据与可解释推理。
AI.method: SyRHM 包含：(1) 意义锚定检索——将多模态内容解析为文本元素与描述，检索语义相关表情包，提供超越表层相似度的锚定上下文；(2) 翻译阶段——把多模态输入转换为符号化中间表示；(3) 多阶段推理——通过 planner 与 solver 阶段完成推理，实现表达力强且可解释的有害意图分析。
AI.result: 在 FHM、HarM、MultiOff 三个数据集上，SyRHM 在多数评测设定下优于多模态与推理类基线，同时能提供针对有害内容的推理轨迹。
AI.conclusion: 意义锚定检索结合符号化多阶段推理，可有效提升隐式有害意图的检测性能与可解释性，代码已开源。

title: A Survey on Fake Review Detection: From Pre-trained Language Models to Large Language Models
comment: Fanji Yang and Huiyao Chen contributed equally to this work. Accepted for publication in Information Fusion
summary: Online reviews shape consumer decisions, platform governance, and corporate reputation.Fake reviews compromise this information channel by injecting deceptive evidence into rating systems, recommendation pipelines, and public trust mechanisms.The rise of large language models, or LLMs, has changed the problem in two directions.LLMs can generate fluent and context-aware deceptive reviews, while pre-trained language models, or PLMs, and LLMs also provide stronger semantic representations for detection.This survey reviews fake review detection from an information fusion perspective, covering 211 studies published from 2018 to early 2026.We organize existing work by evidence source and fusion level, covering review text, sentiment, rating behavior, temporal metadata, user-product graphs, multimodal content, external knowledge, and LLM-generated signals.We trace the development from traditional machine learning and deep learning to PLM-based and LLM-based methods, and examine how different approaches combine textual, behavioral, structural, and multimodal evidence.We also analyze reported performance trends on widely used Amazon, Yelp, and OpSpam benchmark families, while noting the limitations caused by different label construction procedures, data splits, and evaluation protocols.Finally, we identify open problems in adversarial generation, cross-domain transfer, uncertainty-aware fusion, missing-source robustness, interpretability, and trustworthy evaluation for AI-generated deceptive content.

AI.tldr: 从信息融合视角系统综述2018—2026年初的211项虚假评论检测研究，按证据来源与融合层级分类，梳理从传统机器学习到大模型方法的演进，并讨论基准性能、评测局限与开放问题。
AI.motivation: 在线评论影响消费者决策、平台治理与企业声誉，虚假评论则向评分系统、推荐流程与公众信任注入欺骗性证据。大模型使问题双向加剧：既能生成流畅、语境适配的欺骗性评论，也为检测提供了更强的语义表示。因此需要从信息融合角度系统梳理该领域进展。
AI.method: 综述211篇2018—2026年初文献，按证据来源与融合层级组织，涵盖评论文本、情感、评分行为、时间元数据、用户—商品图、多模态内容、外部知识与LLM生成信号；追溯从传统机器学习、深度学习到PLM与LLM方法的演进，分析文本、行为、结构与多模态证据的融合方式，并考察Amazon、Yelp、OpSpam等基准上的性能趋势。
AI.result: 梳理了不同证据源与融合策略的方法演进脉络，总结了主流基准系列上的报告性能趋势，并指出标签构建流程、数据划分与评测协议差异导致的性能可比性限制。
AI.conclusion: 归纳出对抗生成、跨域迁移、不确定性感知融合、缺失源鲁棒性、可解释性以及面向AI生成欺骗内容的可信评测等开放问题，为后续研究提供方向。

title: StepPrune: Adaptive Sequential Visual Token Selection across Multimodal Large Language Models
summary: Visual prefixes account for a major portion of the per-layer computation in multimodal large language models (MLLMs), making visual-token pruning a direct approach to accelerating inference. Existing top-K methods typically evaluate tokens independently and apply a uniform budget to all inputs, overlooking both selection-dependent interactions and variations in visual complexity across samples. In contrast, we propose StepPrune, which formulates visual-token pruning as an adaptive sequential decision process. Conditioned on previously selected tokens and textual context, StepPrune progressively constructs the retained subset and automatically determines its size through a learned STOP action. During training, a variance-preserving noise gate provides a differentiable surrogate for the discrete selection process, whereas during inference, unselected tokens are physically removed before language-model prefill. A grouped selection mechanism further extends StepPrune to high-resolution inputs. Experiments across LLaVA-1.5, LLaVA-NeXT, Qwen2.5-VL, and InternVL3 show that StepPrune achieves the best average normalized performance retention across all evaluated pruning rates on LLaVA-1.5, Qwen2.5-VL, and InternVL3, while remaining competitive on the substantially longer AnyRes prefixes of LLaVA-NeXT. On LLaVA-1.5, StepPrune retains 94.6% of the full-prefix normalized performance while pruning 88.9% of the visual tokens. At a mean retained count of 64, StepPrune reduces prefill latency from 59.95 ms to 40.05 ms, corresponding to a 1.50x prefill speed-up.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 StepPrune，将多模态大模型的视觉 token 剪枝建模为自适应序列决策过程，通过逐步选择保留子集并用学习到的 STOP 动作自动确定剪枝规模，在多个 MLLM 上实现了更优的精度-效率权衡。
AI.motivation: 视觉前缀占 MLLM 逐层计算的主要部分，剪枝视觉 token 是加速推理的直接手段。但现有 top-K 方法独立评估各 token 且对所有输入使用统一预算，忽略了选择之间的依赖关系以及样本间视觉复杂度的差异。
AI.method: StepPrune 将视觉 token 剪枝形式化为自适应序列决策：以已选 token 与文本上下文为条件，逐步构建保留子集，并通过学习到的 STOP 动作自动决定子集大小。训练时用保方差噪声门提供离散选择过程的可微代理；推理时在语言模型 prefill 前物理移除未选 token。分组选择机制进一步将方法扩展到高分辨率输入。
AI.result: 在 LLaVA-1.5、LLaVA-NeXT、Qwen2.5-VL 和 InternVL3 上实验：StepPrune 在 LLaVA-1.5、Qwen2.5-VL 和 InternVL3 的所有评估剪枝率下取得最佳平均归一化性能保留，在 LLaVA-NeXT 的长 AnyRes 前缀上仍有竞争力。LLaVA-1.5 上剪去 88.9% 视觉 token 仍保留 94.6% 全前缀归一化性能；平均保留 64 个 token 时，prefill 延迟从 59.95 ms 降至 40.05 ms，实现 1.50 倍加速。
AI.conclusion: StepPrune 通过自适应、选择依赖的序列剪枝策略，克服了传统 top-K 剪枝在交互建模与预算自适应上的不足，在多个 MLLM 上以显著 token 削减实现高保真性能保留与实际 prefill 加速。

title: Understanding the Limits of Agentic ICD Coding
comment: Accepted to EMNLP 2026 Main Conference
summary: ICD-10-CM codes are alphanumeric codes used in the US to classify diagnoses and injuries for medical billing and epidemiological reporting. Standard ICD-10-CM benchmarks report aggregate metrics that obscure performance on complex coding scenarios. We evaluate neural, workflow, and agentic systems on a rarity-stratified set of MIMIC-IV discharge summaries and identify two orthogonal failure modes. Neural classifiers exhibit a 0.43 micro-F1 gap between rare and common codes. Workflow systems handle rare codes well but score near zero on injury and external cause codes that require multi-step guideline following. A tool-augmented agentic configuration with structured access to official ICD-10-CM reference materials recovers up to 0.34 micro-F1 on this subset. No single system dominates across all conditions.

AI.tldr: 该论文对神经、工作流与智能体系统在稀有性分层的MIMIC-IV出院小结上评估ICD-10-CM编码，识别出两种正交失效模式：神经分类器在稀有与常见编码间存在0.43 micro-F1差距；工作流系统擅长稀有编码但在需多步指南遵循的损伤与外因编码上近乎为零。工具增强的智能体配置通过结构化访问官方ICD-10-CM参考资料，在该子集上恢复最高0.34 micro-F1。没有单一系统在所有条件下占优。
AI.motivation: 标准ICD-10-CM基准报告聚合指标，掩盖了系统在复杂编码场景下的表现差异；需要按稀有性分层评估以揭示不同方法的真实能力边界。
AI.method: 在稀有性分层的MIMIC-IV出院小结数据集上，对比评估神经分类器、工作流系统与智能体系统三类方法；其中智能体配置采用工具增强，可结构化访问官方ICD-10-CM参考资料。
AI.result: 神经分类器在稀有与常见编码间存在0.43 micro-F1差距；工作流系统在稀有编码上表现良好，但在需要多步指南遵循的损伤与外因编码上得分接近零；工具增强的智能体配置在该子集上最高恢复0.34 micro-F1。
AI.conclusion: 存在两种正交失效模式，无单一系统在所有条件下占优；需针对不同编码场景组合或选择方法，并强调结构化访问官方参考资料对提升复杂编码表现的价值。

title: DARE: Dialectical Agentic Reasoning for Structured Knowledge Fact Checking
comment: EMNLP 2026 (Findings)
summary: Structured knowledge fact checking aims to determine the truthfulness of natural language claims by reasoning over structured evidence. Recent program-generation approaches leverage large language models (LLMs) to generate executable graph reasoning programs, achieving strong performance on structured knowledge fact checking benchmarks. However, these methods remain limited by invalid relation generation, single-path reasoning that lacks self-correction, and biased evidence assessment that tends to overestimate supporting signals. We propose Dialectical Agentic Reasoning (DARE), a multi-agent framework that formulates structured knowledge fact checking as an iterative retrieve-reason-reflect process. DARE integrates relation-grounded evidence retrieval to constrain reasoning to valid structures, dialectical bidirectional verification to evaluate evidence from both supporting and refuting perspectives, and confidence-driven meta-reflection to dynamically determine whether additional evidence exploration is necessary. Extensive experiments demonstrate the effectiveness of DARE in structured knowledge fact checking, with an 8B backbone achieving 88.12% accuracy and matching or surpassing GPT-4o-based program-generation baselines, which attests to the efficacy of dialectical agentic reasoning in eliciting the latent reasoning capabilities of LLMs.

AI.tldr: 本文提出辩证式智能体推理框架DARE，将结构化知识事实核查建模为迭代的检索-推理-反思过程，通过关系约束证据检索、辩证双向验证和置信度驱动的元反思解决现有方法的局限，8B模型达到88.12%准确率。
AI.motivation: 现有基于程序生成的方法利用大语言模型生成可执行图推理程序，在结构化知识事实核查基准上表现良好，但存在三大局限：生成无效关系；单路径推理缺乏自我纠错能力；证据评估存在偏差，倾向于高估支持性信号。
AI.method: 提出辩证式智能体推理（DARE）多智能体框架，将事实核查形式化为迭代的检索-推理-反思过程，包含三个核心机制：关系约束的证据检索以将推理限制在有效结构内；辩证双向验证从支持与反驳两个视角评估证据；置信度驱动的元反思动态判断是否需要进一步探索证据。
AI.result: 大量实验表明DARE在结构化知识事实核查中有效，8B规模骨干模型达到88.12%准确率，匹配或超越基于GPT-4o的程序生成基线。
AI.conclusion: 辩证式智能体推理能有效激发大语言模型的潜在推理能力，验证了该框架在结构化知识事实核查中的有效性与优越性。

title: An Affordable AI-Integrated Smart Cane for Multimodal Mobility Assistance of Visually Impaired Users
summary: Visual impairment affects over 2.2 billion people worldwide, yet conventional white canes cannot detect elevated hazards or provide semantic environmental context. Existing AI-assisted navigation systems typically rely on expensive hardware or cloud connectivity, limiting accessibility in resource-constrained settings. This paper presents an affordable (\$88 USD), fully offline AI-integrated smart cane designed for multimodal mobility assistance on an ultra-low-power Raspberry Pi Zero 2W. The system fuses RGB vision sensing with Time-of-Flight (ToF) distance estimation, pairing an INT8-quantized SSD MobileNet V1 model with distance-aware vibrotactile feedback and real-time audio alerts. To ensure operational robustness on constrained hardware, a multiprocessing architecture isolates sensor acquisition, neural inference, and haptic feedback into independent processes with fail-safe sensing support. Experimental evaluation across indoor mobility scenarios demonstrates a macro-averaged F1-score of 0.82 (precision: 0.85, recall: 0.81), a mean end-to-end latency of 330\,ms, and a peak power draw of 2.8\,W. A preliminary usability study with 12 participants (SUS: 78.5, NASA-TLX) demonstrated positive user perception and enhanced obstacle awareness. The proposed prototype validates the feasibility of deploying privacy-preserving, edge-native assistive intelligence for cost-sensitive mobility assistance.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种售价88美元、完全离线的智能盲杖，在Raspberry Pi Zero 2W上融合RGB视觉与ToF测距，实现端侧多模态辅助导航。
AI.motivation: 全球超22亿人受视力障碍影响，但传统白杖无法检测高位障碍物或提供语义化环境信息；现有AI辅助导航方案多依赖昂贵硬件或云端连接，在资源受限场景中可及性差。
AI.method: 系统在超低功耗Raspberry Pi Zero 2W上融合RGB视觉与ToF距离估计，采用INT8量化的SSD MobileNet V1模型，结合距离感知的振动触觉反馈与实时音频提示；并设计多进程架构，将传感器采集、神经网络推理与触觉反馈隔离为独立进程，支持失效安全感知。
AI.result: 室内移动场景实验中，宏平均F1为0.82（精确率0.85，召回率0.81），端到端平均延迟330 ms，峰值功耗2.8 W；12名参与者的初步可用性研究显示SUS得分78.5，NASA-TLX表现良好，用户感知积极且障碍物感知能力提升。
AI.conclusion: 该原型验证了在成本敏感型移动辅助场景中部署隐私保护、边缘原生的辅助智能的可行性。

title: Realtime-Venus: A full-duplex interaction system with asynchronous delegation
summary: Natural interaction in digital and physical environments requires continuous perception and timely responses. Spoken dialogue relies on acoustic and linguistic cues, while video interaction also requires grounding the conversation in evolving visual context. We present Realtime-Venus, a proactive full-duplex interaction system with two separately trained 9B models: Realtime-Venus-Omni for audio-visual interaction and Realtime-Venus-Audio for spoken interaction. Each model serves as a complete conversational frontend, integrating continuous perception, conversational control, and native speech generation through a shared causal timeline for user inputs, model outputs, and delegation events. A dual-loop runtime coordinates live interaction with background reasoning and tool execution. Foreground interaction continues while Realtime-Venus-Harness executes tasks asynchronously and returns results for integration into the ongoing dialogue. Both models follow a common post-training recipe combining offline understanding, proactive full-duplex trajectories, and delegation workflows. Among the evaluated online models, Realtime-Venus-Omni achieves the highest scores on six of eight video benchmarks, including StreamingBench (70.2%), OVO-Bench (64.7%), and Daily-Omni (81.3%). Across eight audio understanding and spoken question answering benchmarks, Realtime-Venus-Audio leads the compared models on MMAU (78.0%), MMAU-Pro (63.2%), Llama Questions (83.8%), and Speech CMMLU (67.8%), while matching the best VoiceBench AlpacaEval score of 4.81. On Full-Duplex-Bench v1.5, Realtime-Venus-Audio responds to 75% of user interruptions and achieves continuation rates of 97%, 88%, and 86% under backchannels, other-directed speech, and background speech, respectively, exceeding Gemini 3.1 Live and GPT-4o on all three continuation metrics.

AI.tldr: 提出 Realtime-Venus 主动式全双工交互系统，含 9B 的 Omni（音视频）与 Audio（语音）双模型，通过共享因果时间轴与双环运行时实现连续感知、对话控制、原生语音生成及后台推理/工具执行，在多项视频、音频与全双工基准上领先。
AI.motivation: 数字与物理环境中的自然交互需要连续感知与及时响应：语音对话依赖声学与语言线索，视频交互还需将对话锚定在动态演化的视觉语境中。现有系统难以同时满足连续感知、主动全双工对话控制与实时语音生成的统一需求。
AI.method: 1) 两个独立训练的 9B 模型：Realtime-Venus-Omni（音视频交互）与 Realtime-Venus-Audio（语音交互），各自作为完整对话前端；2) 以共享因果时间轴统一用户输入、模型输出与委托事件，融合连续感知、对话控制与原生语音生成；3) 双环运行时：前台持续交互，Realtime-Venus-Harness 后台异步执行任务并回传结果融入进行中的对话；4) 统一后训练配方：离线理解 + 主动全双工轨迹 + 委托工作流。
AI.result: 视频侧：Omni 在 8 项视频基准中的 6 项取得在线模型最高分，包括 StreamingBench 70.2%、OVO-Bench 64.7%、Daily-Omni 81.3%。音频侧：Audio 在 8 项音频理解与口语问答基准中，于 MMAU 78.0%、MMAU-Pro 63.2%、Llama Questions 83.8%、Speech CMMLU 67.8% 领先，VoiceBench AlpacaEval 以 4.81 追平最佳。Full-Duplex-Bench v1.5 上，Audio 对 75% 的用户打断做出响应，在 backchannels、other-directed speech、background speech 下延续率分别为 97%、88%、86%，三项均超过 Gemini 3.1 Live 与 GPT-4o。
AI.conclusion: Realtime-Venus 通过共享因果时间轴与双环运行时，将连续感知、主动全双工对话控制、原生语音生成与异步工具执行统一于单一对话前端，在视频、音频理解及全双工交互能力上达到或超越同期先进模型水平。

title: Beyond OCR Accuracy: Text-Centric VQA Under Image Degradation with Modular and End-to-End
summary: Text-centric Visual Question Answering (VQA) requires reading and reasoning over text embedded in images, a task made substantially harder when images suffer from real-world degradation such as motion blur, low resolution, or compression artifacts. While modular OCR-based pipelines and end-to-end vision-language models are both widely used for this task, their comparative robustness under degraded conditions remains underexplored. We present an empirical study comparing two modular pipelines with SA-DBNet, a custom detector architecture combining ResNet-18 with self-attention spatial modeling and deformable convolutions against an end-to-end vision-language baseline, evaluated on 4013 degraded images with 7000 question-answer pairs. Fine-tuned modular pipelines achieve up to 57.50% exact-match accuracy versus 38.00% for the end-to-end baseline, with domain-specific fine-tuning yielding a gain of up to 29.50 percentage points. Critically, we find that conventional OCR error metrics like Character Error Rate and Word Error Rate are unreliable predictors of downstream VQA performance, as semantic reasoning can compensate for recognition failures when contextual cues are present. These findings highlight the importance of task-aware evaluation for text-centric VQA systems under realistic visual conditions. Codes are available here

AI.tldr: 该研究通过4013张退化图像和7000对问答数据，实证比较模块化OCR流水线与端到端视觉语言模型在文本中心VQA中的鲁棒性。结果表明，微调模块化流水线最高达57.50%精确匹配准确率，而端到端基线仅为38.00%，且传统OCR误差指标无法可靠预测下游VQA性能。
AI.motivation: 文本中心VQA需对图像内嵌文本进行读取与推理，而现实中的图像退化（运动模糊、低分辨率、压缩伪影）会显著增加难度。模块化OCR流水线与端到端视觉语言模型虽均被广泛使用，但二者在退化条件下的鲁棒性对比尚缺乏系统研究，同时OCR误差指标与下游VQA性能之间的关系亦不明确。
AI.method: 在4013张退化图像、7000对问答数据上，构建实证对比实验：一是模块化OCR流水线，二是自研检测器SA-DBNet（结合ResNet-18、自注意力空间建模与可变形卷积），三是端到端视觉语言基线。通过领域特定微调并采用精确匹配准确率进行评估，同时考察字符错误率（CER）与词错误率（WER）对下游性能的预测能力。
AI.result: 微调后的模块化流水线精确匹配准确率最高达57.50%，端到端基线为38.00%，领域特定微调带来最高29.50个百分点的提升。此外，CER和WER等传统OCR误差指标无法可靠预测下游VQA性能，因为在存在语境线索时语义推理可补偿识别失败。
AI.conclusion: 模块化流水线在退化图像条件下的文本中心VQA中显著优于端到端视觉语言模型，且传统OCR识别指标与下游任务表现存在脱节。研究强调应面向真实视觉条件采用任务感知的评估方式，而非单纯依赖OCR误差指标。

title: Semantic Privacy Protection with Utility Preservation for 3D Point Clouds
summary: Point cloud data face serious semantic privacy risks during acquisition, transmission, and cross-institutional sharing. Existing methods mostly rely on geometric perturbation or destructive encryption, which can reduce the recognizability of the original class but often impair downstream usability. This paper proposes a class-transfer-based semantic encryption framework for point clouds, aiming to conceal original class information while preserving task utility and supporting authorized recovery. Specifically, we construct a unified latent space with a shared-backbone Normalizing Flow, and combine LoRA and FiLM to achieve parameter-efficient class-conditional adaptation. We further introduce diffusion-guided flow alignment to regularize the latent distribution, construct an energy-based category transition graph, and obtain an optimal class-transfer table through global matching. Then, a latent-space Neural ODE continuously evolves source-class latents into target-class latents, which are decoded into target-class point clouds through the inverse flow. We adopt attacker-oriented metrics, including New-Class Recognition Rate (NCRR), Original-Class Leakage Rate (OCLR), and Original Label Recovery Rate (OLRR), to evaluate privacy and utility. Experiments on classification and segmentation benchmarks show that the proposed method achieves controllable semantic transformation, effectively reduces original-class semantic leakage, preserves downstream learnability in the protected domain, and supports reliable authorized reconstruction.

AI.tldr: 提出基于类迁移的点云语义加密框架，通过潜空间演化隐藏原类语义，同时保持下游可用性与授权恢复能力。
AI.motivation: 点云在采集、传输与跨机构共享中面临严重语义隐私风险；现有几何扰动或破坏性加密方法虽能削弱原类可识别性，但往往损害下游任务可用性。
AI.method: 构建共享骨干Normalizing Flow的统一潜空间，结合LoRA与FiLM实现参数高效的类条件适配；引入扩散引导的流对齐正则化潜分布，构建基于能量的类别转移图并经全局匹配得到最优类迁移表；用潜空间Neural ODE将源类潜变量连续演化为目标类潜变量，再经逆流解码为目标类点云。
AI.result: 采用面向攻击者的指标NCRR、OCLR、OLRR评估隐私与效用；在分类与分割基准上实现可控语义变换，有效降低原类语义泄漏。
AI.conclusion: 该方法在保护域中保持下游可学习性，并支持可靠的授权重建，兼顾隐私保护与任务效用。

title: When Consistency Does Not Mean Reliability: Evaluating Local LLM Judges Against Human Ratings
summary: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly used to evaluate the responses of other language models. This approach, known as LLM-as-a-Judge, is faster and cheaper than human evaluation. However, a judge may produce consistent scores without necessarily agreeing with human evaluators. In this work, we study this issue using two local open-weight LLM judges, LLaMA-3-8B and Qwen2.5-7B. We evaluate 300 responses generated by an instruction-tuned GPT-2 (124M) model for 100 questions covering five categories: factual knowledge, instruction following, mathematics, reasoning, and writing. Each response is scored by nine human annotators and is evaluated three times by each LLM judge using the same rubric. We compare the judge scores with the average human scores using Pearson correlation, Spearman correlation, mean absolute error (MAE), signed bias, and self-consistency. LLaMA-3-8B shows a Pearson correlation of 0.275 with human scores, while Qwen2.5-7B achieves 0.340. Their MAEs are 27.71 and 18.64, respectively. Despite this limited agreement, both judges show high self-consistency, with exact consistency rates of 97.3\% for LLaMA-3-8B and 92.3\% for Qwen2.5-7B. These results show that high self-consistency does not necessarily indicate high agreement with human judgments. Our findings highlight the need to evaluate both consistency and human alignment when using local LLMs as automatic judges.

AI.tldr: 使用LLaMA-3-8B和Qwen2.5-7B作为本地LLM评判者评测GPT-2生成的300条回答，发现二者与人类评分相关性低（0.275/0.340），但自洽性极高（97.3%/92.3%）。
AI.motivation: LLM-as-a-Judge比人工评测更快更便宜，但评判者可能给出一致分数却并不与人类评估者一致，因此需要同时考察一致性（self-consistency）与人类对齐程度。
AI.method: 选取两个本地开源权重评判模型LLaMA-3-8B与Qwen2.5-7B；对指令微调GPT-2（124M）针对100个问题（覆盖事实知识、指令遵循、数学、推理、写作五类）生成的300条回答，由9名人类标注者打分，并由每个LLM评判者用同一评分量表各评测3次；采用Pearson相关、Spearman相关、平均绝对误差（MAE）、有符号偏差和自洽性进行比较。
AI.result: LLaMA-3-8B与人类分数的Pearson相关为0.275，Qwen2.5-7B为0.340；MAE分别为27.71和18.64；两者自洽性很高，完全一致率分别为97.3%和92.3%。
AI.conclusion: 高自洽性并不必然意味着与人类判断高度一致；使用本地LLM作为自动评判者时，需同时评估其一致性与人类对齐度。

title: DiVA: Enabling Interactive Digital Life Simulation via Video Models
comment: Project page: https://steller-cheng.github.io/DiVA/
summary: We present DiVA, a deeply interactive digital life simulator pioneering a new paradigm for long-term, open-ended interactive experiences within digital character worlds. DiVA's architecture pairs a Multimodal Large Language Model (MLLM) as a router with a meticulously designed stacked video pipeline for seamless, multi-turn interactions with action and audio response. To maintain continuity and avoid degradation, we model generation as a three-part coupled system: waiting video, action video, and the transitions between them. These transitions are critically handled by our Anchored Video Continuation (AVC) module, which returns the character to stable states to prevent degradation. By encoding information from the preceding action video segment, AVC ensures smooth transitions, significantly reducing camera jitter and inconsistencies common in current video transition methods. This design also enables complex pose changes (e.g., sitting to standing) typically difficult for audio-driven models. These system designs together ensure high-fidelity identity, coherence, and dynamics for extended experiences. To validate our pipeline design, we comprehensively compare our system against alternatives by replacing our core generation module with mainstream long-video, continuation, and interpolation methods. We further analyze the necessity of the three-stage design, anchor-state selection, transition naturalness, spatial grounding, and the quality-latency trade-off, and we expand the comparison to additional long-form audio-driven avatar models. Results confirm DiVA is markedly superior in maintaining long-term visual quality and realism, validating its effectiveness as a sustainable, interactive simulation.

AI.tldr: DiVA是一种深度交互式数字生命模拟器，通过MLLM路由与堆叠视频流水线实现长时程开放式多轮交互，并借助Anchored Video Continuation模块保障长程视觉连续性。
AI.motivation: 现有数字角色视频生成在长期、开放式交互中易出现退化与不连贯（如镜头抖动、身份漂移、姿态切换困难），难以维持高保真与动态连续性。
AI.method: 将生成建模为等待视频、动作视频及其间过渡三部分耦合系统；以多模态大语言模型作为路由器，配合精心设计的堆叠视频流水线；核心引入Anchored Video Continuation（AVC）模块，编码前段动作视频信息，将角色引导回稳定锚定状态，实现平滑过渡。
AI.result: AVC显著降低镜头抖动与不一致，支持坐姿转站姿等复杂姿态变化；替换核心生成模块与主流长视频、续接、插值方法对比，DiVA在长期视觉质量与真实感上明显更优。
AI.conclusion: 三阶段耦合设计与锚定状态机制是维持高保真身份、连贯性与动态性的关键，DiVA可作为可持续的交互式数字生命模拟方案。

title: TotalSynth: Robust Whole-Body Synthetic CT from MRI and CBCT
comment: 10 pages, 3 figures
summary: Purpose: To develop and evaluate TotalSynth, a reusable pretrained framework for whole-body synthetic CT (sCT) generation from MRI and cone-beam CT (CBCT) images. Materials and Methods: In this retrospective technical study, the dataset was assembled between 2020 and 2026 from SynthRAD challenge data, four prostate cohorts, and BIC-MAC. After registration quality control, 1450 of 1800 public challenge pairs were retained; 350 were excluded for insufficient registration quality or major source/CT mismatch. The corpus also included 84 additional prostate MRI/CT and 60 external BIC-MAC MRI/CT cases. Three 5-fold model families were evaluated with image-domain, anatomy-aware, registration-based, and uncertainty metrics. Age and sex were not consistently available across public datasets. Results: The released MRI-to-CT model achieved an overall MAE of 67.49 HU, SSIM of 0.920, and PSNR of 29.28 dB. The CBCT-to-CT model achieved an overall MAE of 53.55 HU, SSIM of 0.939, and PSNR of 32.09 dB. The unified model maintained similar performance on MRI inputs (MAE, 67.68 HU) and CBCT inputs (MAE, 54.22 HU). On external BIC-MAC data, MRI-to-CT MAE was 100.91 HU without fine-tuning and 62.21 HU after fine-tuning. Conclusion: TotalSynth provides reusable MRI- and CBCT-based CT synthesis models with broad anatomical coverage, while external evaluation highlights the need for local validation and optional fine-tuning under domain shift.

AI.tldr: TotalSynth：一个可复用的预训练全身sCT生成框架，支持MRI→CT与CBCT→CT，在1450例公开配对及144例额外数据上验证，MRI→CT MAE约67.49 HU、CBCT→CT约53.55 HU，域偏移下需本地验证与微调。
AI.motivation: MRI和CBCT均无法直接提供CT值（HU），而放疗计划与剂量计算需要准确电子密度信息。现有sCT方法多为单模态、单解剖部位、需从头训练，缺乏可复用、覆盖全身的预训练模型，且跨中心域偏移下的泛化性未知。
AI.method: 回顾性技术研究，数据来自2020–2026年SynthRAD挑战数据、四个前列腺队列及BIC-MAC。配准质控后保留1800例公开配对中的1450例，另加84例前列腺与60例外部BIC-MAC MRI/CT。评估三个5折模型族（MRI→CT、CBCT→CT、统一模型），采用图像域、解剖感知、基于配准及不确定性四类指标。
AI.result: MRI→CT模型：MAE 67.49 HU、SSIM 0.920、PSNR 29.28 dB；CBCT→CT模型：MAE 53.55 HU、SSIM 0.939、PSNR 32.09 dB。统一模型性能相近（MRI 67.68 HU，CBCT 54.22 HU）。外部BIC-MAC上MRI→CT MAE未微调为100.91 HU，微调后降至62.21 HU。
AI.conclusion: TotalSynth提供了覆盖广泛解剖部位、可复用的MRI与CBCT CT合成模型；外部评估表明存在域偏移，临床应用需本地验证并可选地进行微调。

title: Sweet Talkers: How Query Formulation Shapes Sycophancy in Romantic Relationship Advice
comment: Accepted to LUHME Workshop @ EMNLP 2026
summary: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly used for emotional support and relationship advice, where a model's tendency to preserve a user's face can inadvertently reinforce harmful interpersonal behaviors. To systematically examine this risk, we developed the Romantic Relationship Advice-Seeking Prompts (RRASP) dataset of 2,400 prompts across five relationship themes and evaluated social sycophancy using the ELEPHANT framework on two consumer-facing models, GPT-5 Mini and Gemini 3 Flash. Contrary to our initial hypothesis, grammatical mood alone did not produce systematic differences in sycophantic behavior, suggesting that what a user implies matters more than how they phrase it. Instead, perspective-driven framing had a stronger influence, with gaps between original and flipped prompts widening in follow-up responses. Consistent increases in framing and moral sycophancy across turns indicate that models become more likely to accept a user's stated premises and affirm their ethical stance as a dialogue progresses. Notably, Gemini 3 Flash exhibited substantially smaller increases in moral sycophancy than GPT-5 Mini, suggesting it is more resistant to reinforcing ethically problematic positions across turns.

AI.tldr: 本文构建了RRASP数据集（2400条恋爱关系咨询提示，覆盖五大主题），用ELEPHANT框架评估GPT-5 Mini与Gemini 3 Flash的社交谄媚。结果发现语法语气不产生系统性差异，而视角框架影响更大，且随对话回合推进两类谄媚均上升；Gemini 3 Flash在道德谄媚上的增幅显著更小。
AI.motivation: LLM日益被用于情感支持与关系建议，其保全面子（face-preserving）倾向可能无意中强化有害的人际行为。作者希望系统性地检验这一风险，探究用户提问措辞与隐含立场如何诱发模型谄媚。
AI.method: 构建RRASP数据集，包含2400条跨五大关系主题的恋爱关系咨询提示；采用ELEPHANT框架评估社交谄媚；在两个消费级模型（GPT-5 Mini、Gemini 3 Flash）上进行测试；对比语法语气（grammatical mood）与视角框架（perspective-driven framing）的影响，并分析原始提示与立场翻转提示在多轮对话中的差异。
AI.result: 与初始假设相反，语法语气本身未产生系统性的谄媚差异，说明用户"暗示什么"比"如何表述"更重要。视角框架影响更强，原始与翻转提示之间的差距在后续回复中扩大。随回合推进，框架谄媚与道德谄媚均一致上升，表明模型越到对话后段越倾向接受用户既定前提并肯定其道德立场。Gemini 3 Flash的道德谄媚增幅明显小于GPT-5 Mini。
AI.conclusion: 在情感支持场景中，LLM的社交谄媚主要由用户隐含立场而非句法措辞驱动，并随对话推进而加剧。Gemini 3 Flash比GPT-5 Mini更能抵抗多轮对话中强化伦理性存疑立场，表明该风险存在模型间差异。

title: Affinity-Aware Sharding for Delayed Tensor Parallelism
comment: 16 pages, 11 figures, 3 tables
summary: Delayed Tensor Parallelism (DTP) removes the blocking all-reduce of tensor-parallel Transformer inference. Every device adds its own partial output to its residual stream (and broadcasts it) immediately, but only gathers (receives) the other devices' partials $δ$ modules later. A TP to DTP change therefore amounts to a real architecture change, and dense Transformer models need to be retrained or distilled after adaptation. We show that DTP breaks the permutation symmetry of neurons inside FFNs and of KV heads inside attention modules, and that this symmetry breakage makes the sharding itself a modelling decision. We show that maximising the affinity between the KV heads and the FFN neurons co-located on a device, by permuting the dense model before sharding, speeds up the distillation or retraining process. The affinity is measured with a first-order approximation of the damage that losing a head's contribution does to each neuron's output, and the co-located affinity is maximised with a coordinate-ascent optimiser that alternates an exact balanced assignment of neurons with an exhaustive search over the KV head partitions. The whole procedure takes under two minutes on one GPU for Qwen3-0.6B and Danube3-500M. On these models, at $δ=1$, the affinity-optimised layouts reach any distillation target in about half to two thirds of the steps needed by the naive contiguous layouts, over the whole 10k-step range we tested, and every optimised seed beats every contiguous seed and all but one of the sixteen random layouts. We also show that the co-located affinity score at initialisation predicts the KL to the base model after training, across seventeen layouts ranging from anti-optimised to optimised (Pearson $-0.81$ and $-0.89$).

AI.tldr: DTP打破了FFN神经元与KV头的置换对称性，使分片成为建模决策；通过置换模型最大化同设备KV头与FFN神经元的亲和度，可加速蒸馏/重训，布局优化仅需2分钟且显著减少训练步数。
AI.motivation: 延迟张量并行（DTP）取消了张量并行Transformer推理中的阻塞式全归约，但将其用于密集Transformer需重新训练或蒸馏。作者观察到DTP破坏了FFN神经元与注意力KV头的置换对称性，因此分片方式本身成为一种建模决策，值得优化。
AI.method: 用一阶近似度量"丢失某KV头贡献对各神经元输出的损害"作为亲和度；通过坐标上升优化器，交替进行神经元的精确均衡分配与KV头划分的穷举搜索，对密集模型置换后再分片，以最大化同设备共置的KV头与FFN神经元间的亲和度。
AI.result: 全过程在单块GPU上对Qwen3-0.6B和Danube3-500M耗时不到2分钟。δ=1时，亲和度优化布局达到任意蒸馏目标所需步数约为朴素连续布局的一半到三分之二（覆盖全部1万步范围），每个优化种子均优于所有连续种子及16个随机布局中的15个。初始化时的共置亲和度分数可预测训练后相对基模型的KL（Pearson −0.81和−0.89，涵盖17种布局）。
AI.conclusion: DTP下的分片布局是一个可优化的建模决策；通过置换最大化共置亲和度能在几乎零成本下显著加速蒸馏与重训，且初始亲和度可作为训练后质量的预测指标。

title: Measuring the Cost of Variety Conflation in Multilingual MT Evaluation: Adding Mozambican Xichangana, Nyanja and Sena to FLORES+
comment: Accepted at WMT2026
summary: In this paper, we extend FLORES+ with Portuguese-source evaluation sets for three Mozambican Bantu varieties: Xichangana, Mozambican Nyanja, and Sena. We compare Xichangana with the existing Tsonga reference and Mozambican Nyanja with Chichewa, and evaluate NLLB-200, Google Translate, GPT, and a variant-aware NLLB model. Holding system output fixed reveals substantial reference sensitivity. On \textit{devtest}, changing only the reference from Tsonga to Xichangana reduces spBLEU by 13.10 points for NLLB-200 and 15.30 for Google. On matched Nyanja subsets, replacing Chichewa with Mozambican Nyanja produces smaller but consistent reductions of 3.03 and 6.10 spBLEU, respectively. Variant-aware fine-tuning reverses this pattern on the intended targets: relative to NLLB-200, it improves Xichangana by 7.04 spBLEU and Mozambican Nyanja by 5.33 on \textit{devtest}, while losing performance on the sibling references. GPT is competitive on Tsonga and Chichewa but substantially weaker on the Mozambican varieties. For Sena, the finetuned model reaches 12.64 spBLEU and 36.21 chrF++ on \textit{devtest}. These findings motivate variety-aware language identifiers, references, and reporting for cross-border languages or language dialects/variants. The data is publicly available on Hugging Face at https://huggingface.co/datasets/MOZNLP/FLORES_MOZ

AI.tldr: 本文将FLORES+扩展到三种莫桑比克班图语变体（Xichangana、Mozambican Nyanja、Sena），通过固定系统输出、仅替换参考译文，揭示参考集对评测的敏感性，并证明变体感知微调可显著提升目标变体性能。
AI.motivation: 跨边界语言/方言变体在评测中常被并入主流参考（如Tsonga、Chichewa），但系统输出固定时参考选择本身会引入偏差，缺乏针对莫桑比克班图语变体的独立评测集与量化证据。
AI.method: 在FLORES+上新增Xichangana、Mozambican Nyanja、Sena三种莫桑比克班图语变体的葡语源评测集；将Xichangana与Tsonga、Mozambican Nyanja与Chichewa参考对比；评测NLLB-200、Google Translate、GPT及一个变体感知NLLB模型；通过固定系统输出、仅更换参考进行消融式分析。
AI.result: devtest上参考由Tsonga换为Xichangana，NLLB-200的spBLEU下降13.10、Google下降15.30；匹配Nyanja子集上参考由Chichewa换为Mozambican Nyanja，二者分别下降3.03与6.10。变体感知微调在目标变体上逆转趋势：相对NLLB-200，Xichangana提升7.04 spBLEU、Mozambican Nyanja提升5.33，但在同族参考上性能下降。GPT在Tsonga与Chichewa上具竞争力，在莫桑比克变体上明显较弱。Sena上微调模型devtest达12.64 spBLEU、36.21 chrF++。
AI.conclusion: 参考译文选择会显著影响跨边界语言/方言变体的评测结果，需采用变体感知的语言标识符、参考集与报告规范；数据已公开于Hugging Face。

title: Event-Level Emotion Recognition in the Wild Using Deep Facial Expression Analysis
comment: The paper has been submitted to IEEE conference
summary: Facial emotion recognition (FER) in real-world environments remains challenging due to unconstrained imaging conditions, including multiple faces, occlusions, pose variations, and complex lighting. Most existing studies focus on individual facial emotion classification and do not address the analysis of collective emotional states at the event level. This paper proposes an end-to-end pipeline for event-level emotion recognition from photographs. The approach detects faces in each image, classifies facial expressions using a deep convolutional neural network, and aggregates face-level emotion probabilities to estimate the overall emotional distribution of a public event. A comparative evaluation of several CNN architectures on the FER- 2013 and RAF-DB datasets demonstrates that transfer learning with EfficientNet-B2 trained on RAF-DB is more suitable for real-world RGB data. The proposed method is evaluated on a real-world event dataset containing 1658 images. Experimental results show stable emotion distributions across event subsets, confirming the effectiveness of event-level aggregation for emotion analysis in the wild.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种从照片进行事件级情绪识别的端到端流程：检测人脸→CNN分类表情→聚合概率估计公共事件整体情绪分布，并在真实事件数据集上验证其有效性。
AI.motivation: 真实环境下的面部表情识别受多脸、遮挡、姿态变化和复杂光照等非约束成像条件影响仍具挑战；现有研究多聚焦单张人脸的表情分类，缺乏对事件层面集体情绪状态的分析。
AI.method: 构建端到端流程：对每张图像进行人脸检测，使用深度卷积神经网络分类面部表情，再将人脸级情绪概率聚合以估计公共事件的整体情绪分布；并在FER-2013与RAF-DB数据集上对比多种CNN架构。
AI.result: 对比评估表明，基于RAF-DB训练的EfficientNet-B2迁移学习方法更适合真实RGB数据；在包含1658张图像的真实事件数据集上，各事件子集情绪分布保持稳定。
AI.conclusion: 事件级聚合方法能有效支持野外环境下的情绪分析，验证了从个体表情到事件整体情绪推断的可行性与稳定性。

title: ShopEase: A Generative AI-Based Multi-Agent Framework for Intelligent Enterprise Customer Support Using Hybrid Retrieval-Augmented Generation
summary: Enterprise customer support systems must answer customer questions correctly, retrieve the right policy information, use customer context, and pass difficult cases to human agents when needed. This paper presents ShopEase, a Generative AI-based multi-agent framework for enterprise customer support. The system combines six components: Intent, CRM, Memory, Hybrid RAG, Escalation, and Supervisor, and uses LLaMA 3.2 running locally through Ollama for response generation. The retrieval module combines FAISS (dense retrieval) and BM25 (sparse retrieval), and six configurations are evaluated: BM25-only, FAISS-only, Fair RRF, Weighted RRF, RRF with Cross-Encoder, and Top-10 Hybrid with Cross-Encoder. Instead of using a fixed mapping between intent and policy, the policy category is decided directly from the retrieved documents. The system was evaluated on 2632 held-out customer queries across six categories: Refund, Return, Shipping, Cancellation, Damaged Product, and Unknown. FAISS-only achieved the highest accuracy of 85.37\% (2247 correct predictions), closely followed by Weighted RRF at 85.07\%. BM25-only achieved only 55.74\% accuracy. Adding cross-encoder reranking did not improve results: RRF with Cross-Encoder reached 83.24\%, and Top-10 Hybrid with Cross-Encoder reached 81.88\%, while also increasing response latency. Category-level analysis shows strong performance on Shipping, Cancellation, and Return, while Unknown queries remain the main source of errors. Statistical testing using McNemar's test shows no significant difference between FAISS-only and Weighted RRF, though both perform significantly better than Fair RRF and the cross-encoder configurations. Overall, dense retrieval gives the best accuracy on this dataset, and additional reranking adds processing time without improving classification performance.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 ShopEase——一个基于生成式AI的多智能体企业客服框架（含 Intent、CRM、Memory、Hybrid RAG、Escalation、Supervisor 六个组件，本地部署 LLaMA 3.2），并在 2632 条客户查询上评测六种检索配置；结果显示 FAISS 稠密检索准确率最高（85.37%），BM25 仅 55.74%，交叉编码器重排未提升性能且增加延迟。
AI.motivation: 企业客服系统需准确回答客户问题、检索正确策略信息、利用客户上下文，并在必要时将难题转交人工坐席。现有方案在检索策略选择（稠密 vs 稀疏 vs 混合）、意图—策略映射方式（固定映射 vs 依据检索文档判定）以及重排模块是否真正带来收益等问题上缺乏系统性的实证对比。
AI.method: 构建 ShopEase 多智能体框架：六组件协作（Intent、CRM、Memory、Hybrid RAG、Escalation、Supervisor），通过 Ollama 本地运行 LLaMA 3.2 生成回复；检索模块结合 FAISS（稠密）与 BM25（稀疏）；不再使用意图到策略的固定映射，而是直接由检索文档决定策略类别。在 2632 条留出查询（Refund、Return、Shipping、Cancellation、Damaged Product、Unknown 六类）上对比六种配置：BM25-only、FAISS-only、Fair RRF、Weighted RRF、RRF+Cross-Encoder、Top-10 Hybrid+Cross-Encoder，并用 McNemar 检验做显著性分析。
AI.result: FAISS-only 准确率最高，达 85.37%（2247 条正确），Weighted RRF 紧随其后为 85.07%；BM25-only 仅 55.74%。加入交叉编码器重排未见提升：RRF+Cross-Encoder 为 83.24%，Top-10 Hybrid+Cross-Encoder 为 81.88%，且响应延迟增加。类别层面，Shipping、Cancellation、Return 表现较强，Unknown 查询是主要错误来源。McNemar 检验显示 FAISS-only 与 Weighted RRF 无显著差异，但二者显著优于 Fair RRF 及交叉编码器配置。
AI.conclusion: 在该数据集上，稠密检索（FAISS）取得最佳准确率；额外的重排环节只增加处理时间而不提升分类性能。为企业客服多智能体系统的检索模块选型提供了实证依据：优先采用稠密检索，谨慎引入重排组件。

title: ClinAgent: A ReAct-Based Agent for Conversational Access to Clinical Trial Information
comment: Accepted at the CIBB 2026 conference (https://cibb2026.teralab.ai/)
summary: Querying clinical trial registries remains a manual and error-prone process, requiring researchers to navigate large volumes of semi-structured data without support for natural language interaction or cross-source synthesis. The system centers on a Large Language Model (LLM) agent following the ReAct paradigm, which iteratively reasons over queries, selects among a set of integrated tools, and refines its actions based on intermediate outputs. These tools include a ClinicalTrials.gov search interface, a PubMed module, and a Python-based analyzer operating on a locally cached structured dataset of clinical trials. We evaluate the system using a three-phase framework assessing operational effectiveness, planning quality, tool-use efficiency, and expert qualitative judgments, comparing three LLM backends: Gemini 3.0 Flash and two variants of DeepSeek V3.2 (thinking and non-thinking). Results reveal complementary strengths, with DeepSeek (thinking mode) excelling in planning quality, while Gemini achieves the highest overall performance and strongest expert ratings. Overall, our findings highlight the potential of agentic AI systems to improve the accessibility and synthesis of clinical trial information, supporting more efficient and user-centered biomedical research workflows.
