title: Physically Typed and Geometry-Aware Representations for Earth Foundation Models
comment: 18 pages
summary: Earth-observation (EO) foundation models have become exceptionally effective at learning se mantic, high-dimensional geospatial embeddings, while modern weather and climate models have demonstrated that Earth-specific geometry, spherical operators, meshes, and hybrid physical solvers can materially improve prediction. Yet these two advances are not equivalent. A conventional latent embedding has no inherent physical transformation law, whereas scalar fields, tangent polar-vector fields, axial/pseudovector quantities, covectors, and higher-order tensors transform differently under rotations, reflections, and changes of local coordinate frame. This proposal asks whether a general purpose Earth foundation model should preserve those distinctions explicitly, or whether standard embeddings plus augmentation already learn everything that matters. The central contribution is therefore not a more complicated architecture by assumption, but a staged falsification program. A compute-conscious ERA5 dry run first compares conventional, augmentation-matched, typed equivariant, and Hodge/Helmholtz variants under spatial, temporal, orientation, and low-data shifts. Only if explicit geometric typing yields reproducible improvements does the program advance toward a multimodal Earth foundation model in which semantic embeddings coexist with physically typed fields. The proposed gap is narrower and more defensible than claiming that current models ignore geometry entirely: several systems already respect spherical domain geometry, and emerging work explicitly learns scalar/vector fields on spheres. The unresolved question is whether foundation-scale, multimodal, parity-aware field typing produces practical gains beyond those existing approaches.

AI.tldr: 该提案提出一个"分阶段证伪"研究计划，检验地球基础模型是否应显式保留物理场的几何类型（标量、极矢量、轴矢量、余矢量、高阶张量），还是标准嵌入加数据增强已足够。先在ERA5上用四类变体做低算力对比实验，只有显式几何分型带来可复现提升时才推进到多模态地球基础模型。
AI.motivation: 地球观测基础模型擅长学习语义化高维地理空间嵌入，天气气候模型已证明球面几何算子、网格与混合物理求解器能实质提升预测。但二者并不等价：常规潜嵌入没有内禀的物理变换律，而标量场、切向极矢量场、轴矢量/赝矢量、余矢量及高阶张量在旋转、反射和局部坐标架变换下行为各异。因此核心疑问是：通用地球基础模型应显式保留这些区别，还是标准嵌入加增强已学到全部关键信息。作者强调所提空白比"现有模型完全忽略几何"更窄也更可辩护——已有系统尊重球面域几何，也有工作显式学习球面上的标量/矢量场；未解问题是基础模型规模、多模态、宇称感知的场分型能否带来超越现有方法的实际收益。
AI.method: 方法上不是假设性地堆叠更复杂架构，而是设计分阶段证伪程序。第一步为算力可控的ERA5干跑，对比四类变体：常规嵌入、增强匹配的嵌入、类型化等变模型、Hodge/Helmholtz分解变体；评测覆盖空间、时间、朝向与低数据量四类分布偏移。仅当显式几何分型产生可复现改进时，才进入第二阶段，构建多模态地球基础模型，使语义嵌入与物理分型场共存。
AI.result: 摘要未报告具体实验结果，目前为研究提案：核心产出是实验设计与判定标准（在四类偏移下比较四种变体），并将"是否推进到多模态基础模型"作为由第一阶段结果决定的条件性下一步。
AI.conclusion: 结论是研究议程而非定论：应通过分阶段证伪来厘清"显式物理场分型"相对"标准嵌入加增强"的实际价值，把更宏大的多模态地球基础模型建立在可复现的几何收益之上，而非架构复杂度的先验假设。

title: Bangla Sentence Function Classification: Corpus Development, Model Benchmarking, and Interpretability
comment: Accepted at 2026 IEEE 5th International Conference on Robotics, Automation, Artificial-Intelligence and Internet-of-Things (RAAICON)
summary: Automatic sentence function identification is important for many downstream natural language processing (NLP) applications such as dialogue systems, text-to-speech synthesis, and machine translation. However, benchmark resources for Bangla sentence function classification remain limited. To mitigate this gap, this paper introduces a corpus of 10,000 Bangla sentences, manually annotated into four functional categories, namely declarative, interrogative, imperative, and exclamatory. The corpus is nearly balanced across the four classes, with high annotation reliability reflected by a Fleiss\' Kappa of 0.82. Furthermore, we evaluate multiple feature representations, including Bag-of-Words (BoW), TF-IDF, and Word2Vec, with several classical machine learning classifiers. In addition, two heterogeneous ensemble models, namely Single-Level Ensemble (SLE) and Double-Level Ensemble (DLE), are utilized to improve classification performance. Experimental results show that TF-IDF consistently outperforms Word2Vec, likely due to its ability to emphasize discriminative lexical cues associated with sentence functions, particularly given the relatively small corpus used to train Word2Vec. The DLE model with TF-IDF features achieves the best performance with accuracy and macro-F1 of 0.95, demonstrating the effectiveness of sparse lexical representations and heterogeneous ensemble learning for this task. Further cross-validation confirms the robustness of the approach, while LIME-based interpretability provides insights into model predictions. The developed corpus and model benchmarking establish strong baselines for Bangla sentence function classification.

AI.tldr: 本文构建了10,000句孟加拉语句子功能标注语料库（陈述、疑问、祈使、感叹四类），并系统评测多种特征表示与分类模型，其中TF-IDF结合双层异质集成模型取得最佳性能（准确率与macro-F1均为0.95）。
AI.motivation: 句子功能自动识别对对话系统、语音合成与机器翻译等下游NLP任务十分重要，但孟加拉语的句子功能分类基准资源仍然匮乏，亟需构建标注语料并建立性能基线。
AI.method: 人工标注10,000句孟加拉语句子为四类功能（陈述、疑问、祈使、感叹），语料近似类别均衡，标注一致性Fleiss' Kappa为0.82；采用BoW、TF-IDF、Word2Vec等特征表示，结合多种经典机器学习分类器，并引入单层（SLE）与双层（DLE）异质集成模型提升性能；通过交叉验证与LIME可解释性分析验证模型。
AI.result: TF-IDF稳定优于Word2Vec，原因在于其更能突出与句子功能相关的判别性词汇线索（且Word2Vec训练语料规模较小）；TF-IDF特征下的DLE模型表现最佳，准确率与macro-F1均达0.95；交叉验证证实方法稳健，LIME分析提供了模型预测的可解释性依据。
AI.conclusion: 该研究为孟加拉语句子功能分类提供了公开语料库与模型基准，验证了稀疏词汇表示与异质集成学习在该任务上的有效性，并为后续研究建立了强有力的性能基线。

title: SHIFT-M3: Pre-fusion Alignment-based Consistency Screening for Multimodal ECG Record Integrity
comment: This paper has been accepted and presented at MLHC 2026. Please cite from the official proceedings
summary: Multimodal clinical AI typically assumes that the waveform, report, metadata, and downstream predictions attached to a record belong to the same patient. In practice, linkage failures can silently assemble individually plausible but cross-patient components, creating a safety problem that standard predictive models are not designed to detect. We study this problem as multimodal record integrity triage: given an assembled record, should its modalities be trusted to belong together? We introduce SHIFT-M3, a lightweight text-based pre-fusion screen that measures alignment-based consistency between two separately produced ECG text views: an LLM-generated interpretation and a clinical report summary. On 784,680 MEETI ECG records, SHIFT-M3 achieves 97.6% TPR@5% FPR for full text-view swaps (AUROC 0.996), 90.3% for partial swaps (AUROC 0.974), and 97.7% for label-matched hard negatives (AUROC 0.996) with only 573,569 parameters. Compared with same-dataset lexical baselines, the gains are largest on partial swaps and hard negatives, suggesting that the model is learning more than surface overlap. We also introduce the CMST (Conflict-type Multimodal Stress Test) evaluation taxonomy, a three-seed stability study, a loss ablation, a temporal-tolerance sweep, and a shared-token masking control. The main remaining failure mode is longitudinal ambiguity: at the default operating point, same-patient cross-visit pairs still produce 87.0% Type-II false positives.

AI.tldr: 提出SHIFT-M3轻量级文本预融合筛查器，通过比较LLM生成解读与临床报告摘要的一致性来判断多模态记录是否属于同一患者；在MEETI 784,680条ECG记录上实现97.6% TPR@5% FPR（全量文本替换）、90.3%（部分替换）与97.7%（标签匹配硬负例），参数仅573,569；主要失败模式为纵向歧义，同患者跨访视对仍有87.0%的II类假阳性。
AI.motivation: 多模态临床AI通常默认波形、报告、元数据与下游预测同属同一患者，但实际中链接失败会静默拼装出"单模态看似合理、跨患者混杂"的记录，构成标准预测模型无法检测的安全隐患。论文将此问题形式化为多模态记录完整性分诊：给定拼装记录，判断其各模态是否应被信任属于同一患者。
AI.method: 提出SHIFT-M3，一种基于文本的预融合筛查器，在两个独立生成的ECG文本视图（LLM生成解读与临床报告摘要）之间度量基于对齐的一致性。配套构建CMST（冲突类型多模态压力测试）评测分类体系，并进行三随机种子稳定性研究、损失函数消融、时间容差扫描以及共享token掩码对照实验。
AI.result: 在784,680条MEETI ECG记录上：全量文本视图替换达97.6% TPR@5% FPR（AUROC 0.996），部分替换90.3%（AUROC 0.974），标签匹配硬负例97.7%（AUROC 0.996），参数量仅573,569。与同数据集词汇基线相比，增益在部分替换与硬负例上最大，表明模型学到的不只是表层重叠。主要失败模式为纵向歧义：默认工作点下同患者跨访视对仍产生87.0%的II类假阳性。
AI.conclusion: SHIFT-M3以极小参数量有效完成多模态记录完整性分诊，在多种冲突类型下显著优于词汇基线，说明基于对齐的一致性建模可捕捉超越表层重叠的信号；但同患者跨访视的纵向歧义仍是未解难题，需在后续工作中专门处理。

title: URCHIN: A Horizontal Spiking Language Model for Data-Constrained Pretraining
comment: 12 pages, 2 figures, 6 tables. Accepted to the BabyLM Challenge 2026 (BabyLM Workshop, EMNLP 2026)
summary: The BabyLM challenge measures how much language a model can learn from developmentally-plausible, child-scale data rather than internet-scale corpora, yet prior language models forgo the biological constraints of the neural circuitry that acquires human language: spiking neurons separated into excitatory and inhibitory populations wired by a recurrent lateral connectome. This paper presents URCHIN (Unified Recurrent Connectome with Horizontal Integrate-and-fire Neurons), which applies the Parallelized Hierarchical Connectome Spiking State-space Model (PHCSSM) to language modeling: leaky integrate-and-fire neurons coupled by a Dale's-law lateral connectome resolve each token through a multi-transmission loop that recirculates activity to a fixed point. The instantiation is deliberately minimal: a single horizontal layer of 128 neurons, no attention, and 4.23M parameters. Two implementations share one set of weights and produce identical benchmark scores, so URCHIN is trained once and deployed either way with no conversion step: a parallel state-space model (SSM) scan that is GPU-efficient for training, or an event-driven recurrent spiking neural network (RSNN) with constant-cost inference for CPU or neuromorphic edge deployment. Across all three BabyLM tracks (Strict-100M, Strict-Small, and Multilingual), URCHIN offers a biologically plausible, efficient, and directly deployable reference point.

AI.tldr: 本文提出URCHIN，将层级脉冲状态空间模型（PHCSSM）用于语言建模：以128个漏泄积分-发放神经元构成的单一水平层、Dale定律侧向连接组、无注意力机制、4.23M参数，在BabyLM三个赛道（Strict-100M、Strict-Small、Multilingual）上提供生物合理且可直接部署的基线。
AI.motivation: BabyLM挑战关注模型能否从符合发育规律、儿童规模的数据中习得语言，但已有语言模型忽略了习得人类语言的神经回路所具备的生物学约束：由兴奋性与抑制性神经元群体构成、并由循环侧向连接组相连的脉冲神经元。
AI.method: 采用PHCSSM（并行分层连接组脉冲状态空间模型），用Dale定律侧向连接组耦合的漏泄积分-发放神经元，通过多次传输循环将活动迭代至不动点来解析每个token。模型极简：单层128个水平神经元、无注意力、4.23M参数。两套实现共享同一组权重且基准分数一致，无需转换：训练用GPU高效的并行状态空间模型（SSM）扫描，部署可用事件驱动、恒定推理成本的循环脉冲神经网络（RSNN），面向CPU或神经形态边缘设备。
AI.result: 两种实现共享权重、产生完全相同的基准得分，实现训练一次、双路径部署；在BabyLM的Strict-100M、Strict-Small和Multilingual全部三个赛道上给出了参考结果。
AI.conclusion: URCHIN为BabyLM提供了兼具生物合理性、高效性与可直接部署性的参考基线，展示了将受生物约束的脉冲回路用于儿童规模语言建模的可行性。

title: SkyAnchor: Updating Metric-scale Aerial 3D Gaussian Scenes from Unposed Ground-View Sequences
summary: We study how to update a pre-built aerial scene with a newly captured, unposed ground-view sequence. The aerial scene already contains a reliable metric Structure-from-Motion (SfM) reconstruction and a pre-trained 3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS) model, whereas the ground-view sequence is collected later to add street-level appearance but has unknown camera poses and global scale. Registering this sequence to the aerial SfM reconstruction is challenging because single-image cross-view localization is brittle and long trajectories are prone to drift. To address these challenges, we present SkyAnchor, which treats the existing aerial scene as a fixed scaffold for ground-view registration and scene update instead of jointly reconstructing aerial and ground imagery from scratch. It first localizes short groups of consecutive ground frames against geometrically verified aerial support, producing sparse anchor poses. It then recovers the full ground trajectory with anchor-constrained submaps, fixing the front and rear anchor poses during incremental registration and bundle adjustment. Finally, it inserts filtered ground Gaussians while preserving the aerial view, followed by lightweight joint refinement. Experiments on seven real aerial--ground scenes show accurate metric ground trajectories and updated 3D Gaussian scenes with strong aerial- and ground-view rendering quality.

AI.tldr: 提出SkyAnchor，以预建航拍SfM与3DGS场景为固定支架，将无位姿地面序列配准并融合，实现航拍-地面联合的场景更新。
AI.motivation: 新采集的地面视角序列可补充街景外观，但其相机位姿与全局尺度未知；单图跨视角定位脆弱，长轨迹易漂移；且从零联合重建航拍与地面影像代价高。因此需要一种利用已有航拍场景作为先验的地面配准与更新方法。
AI.method: SkyAnchor将已有航拍场景视作固定支架：首先对连续地面帧的短片段在几何验证的航拍支撑下进行定位，得到稀疏锚点位姿；随后以锚点约束子图恢复完整地面轨迹，在增量配准与光束法平差中固定前后锚点位姿；最后插入经过滤的地面高斯并保持航拍视角，进行轻量联合优化。
AI.result: 在七个真实航拍-地面场景上，方法获得了准确的度量地面轨迹，更新的3D高斯场景在航拍与地面视角下均具备较强渲染质量。
AI.conclusion: 以已有航拍重建作为锚定支架，可有效解决无位姿地面序列的跨视角配准与尺度问题，实现高质量的场景更新。

title: Phorecaster365: A Human-Supervised Reference Architecture for Hybrid Pharmaceutical Sales Forecasting and Planning Decision Support
comment: 23 pages, 4 figures, 7 tables, including supplementary appendices
summary: Pharmaceutical sales forecasts inform planning across products, regions, and distribution channels, yet their interpretation depends on inventory availability, transaction semantics, product lifecycle, and the information available when each forecast is issued. A model prediction alone does not preserve these conditions or establish whether a forecast is suitable for operational use. We present Phorecaster365, a human-supervised reference architecture that connects enterprise resource planning data to reviewable pharmaceutical sales forecasts. The architecture separates source ingestion, product-region series construction, temporally valid feature generation, statistical and machine-learning modeling, ensemble formation, uncertainty assessment, planner review, and lifecycle governance. Its central intermediate representation is a forecast context package that preserves the source snapshot, forecast target, temporal cutoff, available covariates, data-quality state, and hierarchy version. A corresponding forecast evidence package links predictions to model and calibration versions, exceptions, human adjustments, and publication history. Development experience with a synthetic panel of 10,950 daily records across 30 product-region series informs the design. Historical experiment summaries are retained only as descriptive evidence of development because their evaluation does not establish independent predictive validity. We specify a rolling-origin evaluation protocol, baseline and ablation requirements, uncertainty and robustness assessments, and a staged pathway from synthetic testing to use in governed planning. The contribution is an implementation-neutral system design and validation framework; the report does not establish real-world forecasting accuracy, comparative superiority, or operational benefit.

AI.tldr: 本文提出Phorecaster365——一个人工监督的药品销售预测参考架构，通过"预测上下文包"和"预测证据包"两种中间表示，将ERP数据与可审查的预测流程衔接，并给出滚动原点评估协议与从合成测试到受治理规划的验证框架；论文不主张真实预测精度或运营收益。
AI.motivation: 药品销售预测服务于产品、区域和分销渠道的规划，但其解读依赖库存可得性、交易语义、产品生命周期及发布预测时可得的信息；单纯模型预测既不能保留这些条件，也无法判断预测是否适用于运营。因此需要一种能保留预测条件与可核查性的系统设计。
AI.method: 提出Phorecaster365人工监督参考架构，将流程分为源数据摄取、产品-区域序列构建、时间有效特征生成、统计与机器学习建模、集成、不确定性评估、计划员复核、生命周期治理；以"预测上下文包"（源快照、预测目标、时间截断、可用协变量、数据质量状态、层级版本）和"预测证据包"（预测与模型/校准版本、异常、人工调整、发布历史的关联）为核心中间表示；采用含30个产品-区域序列、10,950条日度记录的合成面板作为开发经验。
AI.result: 开发经验来自合成面板（30个产品-区域序列、10,950条日度记录）；历史实验结果仅作为开发过程的描述性证据保留，因其评估不能确立独立的预测有效性；研究给出滚动原点评估协议、基线与消融要求、不确定性与稳健性评估，以及从合成测试到受治理规划的分阶段路径。
AI.conclusion: 贡献在于一套实现中立的系统设计与验证框架；本报告不确立真实世界预测精度、比较优越性或运营收益。

title: North Small Translate: Advanced Cost-Effective Translation (Cohere CAT+)
summary: We present North Small Translate, an open-weight, LLM-based machine translation (MT) model with instruction-following capabilities built on the same foundation as Cohere's Command A Plus, a mixture-of-experts architecture with 25 billion active parameters out of 218 billion total parameters. North Small Translate is trained using difficulty sampling to obtain challenging documents and a five-step training protocol combining supervised fine-tuning, direct preference optimization, and online reinforcement learning. We prioritized throughput through a non-reasoning base model and supplemented with optional agentic capabilities to unlock translation quality gains. North Small Translate is trained to perform MT-related tasks, including post-editing and quality estimation, as well as related tasks such as general instruction following. The model achieves top MT performance across 50 languages in the class of models under 1T parameters, with no need to run expensive reasoning at inference time.

AI.tldr: North Small Translate 是开放权重、基于 LLM 的机器翻译模型，采用 MoE 架构，通过难度采样与五步训练协议（SFT、DPO、在线强化学习）构建，主打高吞吐与非推理模式，并在 50 种语言上取得 1T 参数以下模型的顶尖翻译性能。
AI.motivation: 现有 LLM 机器翻译模型常依赖昂贵的推理过程，且高质量翻译与推理开销难以兼顾。作者希望在保持高吞吐的前提下提升翻译质量，并让模型同时具备翻译专用任务（后编辑、质量评估）与通用指令跟随能力。
AI.method: 模型基于与 Cohere Command A Plus 相同的基础架构，即混合专家（MoE）结构，总参数 218B、激活参数 25B。训练采用难度采样筛选困难文档，并使用五步训练协议，结合监督微调（SFT）、直接偏好优化（DPO）和在线强化学习。基础模型为非推理模式，并可选补充代理式（agentic）能力以提升翻译质量。
AI.result: 在 50 种语言的机器翻译任务上，North Small Translate 在参数量低于 1T 的模型类别中达到顶尖性能，且推理阶段无需运行昂贵的推理过程。模型还能执行后编辑、质量评估等 MT 相关任务以及通用指令跟随。
AI.conclusion: North Small Translate 表明，通过 MoE 架构与多阶段训练协议，可在非推理、高吞吐设定下实现 1T 参数以下模型中的领先多语言翻译性能，并兼顾翻译专用任务与通用指令能力。

title: Inter-Rater Reliability of LLM and Rule-Based Annotation for Inferential Narrative Features: Three Studies on a Turkish Corpus
comment: v1.0. 10 pages, 3 tables. Also archived at Zenodo: https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.21740239
summary: Datasets that ship automatically generated feature annotations invite a question rarely asked of them: would a human agree with those labels? This report answers that for the Objective Projection corpus, a Turkish narrative dataset whose scenes carry a per-scene applied_rules field from a rule-based detector over six craft features -- two prohibitions (emotion labelling, simile) and four positive techniques (materialized metaphor, micro-focus, temporal anchor, atmosphere contradiction). Three studies are reported. Study 1 ($n = 120$) scores the detector against blind labels from the scheme's own author. Study 2 ($n = 100$, a disjoint scene set) scores the detector plus Gemini 2.5 Flash and Grok against an independent non-expert rater whose labels were locked before any machine ran. Study 2b re-runs the identical protocol with Claude Fable 5 (High) and ChatGPT 5.5. The central result concerns one rule. On materialized metaphor -- closest to the methodology's theoretical core -- the five machine labellers returned positive rates of $0$, $1$, $40$, $72$ and $78$ out of $100$ scenes, against a human count of $9$. Cohen's $κ$ was at or indistinguishable from chance for five of six labellers, across both human references and both scene sets: $0.004$, $0.015$, $0.000$, $0.019$, $0.027$. Raw agreement ranged from $74.7\%$ to $84.5\%$, an artefact of class imbalance rather than a sign of competence. We deliberately do not resolve this into a single story. Two readings survive: the feature is genuinely inferential and beyond current automatic detection, or the rule's definition is not yet operational enough for any rater to apply consistently -- including the human. Distinguishing them needs a second independent human rater, which this report does not have and therefore does not claim.

AI.tldr: 对Objective Projection土耳其叙事语料库中自动生成的per-scene applied_rules标注进行人工一致性检验：三项研究（n=120、n=100及复现）显示，在materialized metaphor规则上，五个机器标注器与人类标注几乎无一致性（κ≈0），原始一致率高（74.7%–84.5%）仅为类别不平衡的假象；作者不给出单一结论，保留“该特征本质需推理、超出当前自动检测能力”与“规则定义尚不可操作”两种解释。
AI.motivation: 自动生成的feature annotations常被直接使用，却很少被追问“人类是否会同意这些标签”。该报告针对Objective Projection语料库（其场景带有规则检测器输出的per-scene applied_rules字段，覆盖六项craft features：两项禁忌emotion labelling与simile，以及四项正面技法materialized metaphor、micro-focus、temporal anchor、atmosphere contradiction），系统评估机器标注与人类判断的一致性，以检验该数据集标注的可信度。
AI.method: 采用三项盲标研究：Study 1（n=120）将检测器与方案作者本人的盲标对比；Study 2（n=100，互斥场景集）将检测器与Gemini 2.5 Flash、Grok对比，参照一位独立非专家评分者（其标签在任何机器运行前已锁定）；Study 2b以相同协议复现，替换为Claude Fable 5（High）与ChatGPT 5.5。以Cohen's κ与原始一致率衡量一致性，并关注类别不平衡的影响。核心分析聚焦materialized metaphor规则。
AI.result: 在materialized metaphor上，五个机器标注器在100个场景中的正例率分别为0、1、40、72、78，而人类计数为9。跨两个人类参照与两个场景集，六个标注器中有五个的Cohen's κ处于或与随机不可区分：0.004、0.015、0.000、0.019、0.027。原始一致率介于74.7%至84.5%，属类别不平衡造成的假象，而非能力体现。
AI.conclusion: 报告刻意不将其归结为单一解释，保留两种并存读法：其一，该特征确实具有推理性、超出当前自动检测能力；其二，规则定义尚未足够可操作，以致任何评分者（包括人类）都无法一致应用。要区分二者需第二位独立人类评分者，本报告不具备该条件，故不作此主张。

title: BLInD: Learning Driver Intent as a Distribution over Future Ego Trajectories
comment: Accepted at the 2026 IEEE International Conference on Intelligent Transportation Systems (ITSC)
summary: We present BLInD (Blind Learned Intent Distribution), a compact network that maps recent vehicle-state history (e.g. speed, curvature, indicator, and vehicle type) to a top-k distribution of future ego trajectories, with no camera, LiDAR, map, or object-track inputs. We find that vehiclestate history alone is sufficient to learn a useful multimodal distribution over near-term ego trajectories, and its low-latency nature makes it well-suited for safety-critical deployment. We investigate two distribution architectures, autoregressive (AR) and flow-matching, and train on both mixed-platform opensource and Wayve datasets. Both generalize without datasetspecific adaptation; the flow-matching model achieves best topk ADE/FDE of 0.15/0.37 m on Wayve, 0.15/0.36 m on Waymo, and 0.28/0.59 m on nuScenes, with the AR model reaching comparable coverage. Integrating the distributions into an AEB trigger task, a strict all-candidates policy reduces false positives from 1.51% to 0.11% with AR (13.7x reduction, 94.9% TP) and to 0.06% with flow-matching (25.1x reduction, 98.7% TP) compared to a 1-CTRV policy with 100% true positive score. BLInD runs in 0.87 ms with the AR head and 2.9 ms with the flow-matching head on an NVIDIA DRIVE Orin ECU making it compatible with real-time deployment on automotive ECUs. While existing learned distribution models rely on scene context and blind vehicle-state models typically collapse to a single path, BLInD is learned, blind, and cross-domain simultaneously, a combination not demonstrated by prior work. These results show that such a distribution provides a controllable and plausible intent sampling interface for downstream systems, with AEB as one instantiation.

AI.tldr: BLInD 是一个仅用车态历史（无摄像头/激光雷达/地图/目标轨迹）的轻量网络，预测未来自车轨迹的 top-k 多模态分布，并在跨数据集泛化与 AEB 误报抑制上取得显著效果，可在车载 ECU 上实时运行。
AI.motivation: 现有学习式分布模型依赖场景上下文（摄像头、LiDAR、地图、目标轨迹），而纯车态（blind）模型通常退化为单一路径，缺乏多模态不确定性建模；同时跨域泛化能力缺失。作者希望验证车态历史本身是否足以学习有用的近程自车轨迹多模态分布，并满足安全关键场景的低延迟与跨平台部署需求。
AI.method: 提出 BLInD（Blind Learned Intent Distribution）紧凑网络，输入近期车态历史（速度、曲率、转向灯、车辆类型），输出未来自车轨迹的 top-k 分布，不使用摄像头、LiDAR、地图或目标轨迹。比较两种分布架构：自回归（AR）与 flow-matching，并在混合平台开源数据集与 Wayve 数据集上训练，测试泛化到 Wayve、Waymo、nuScenes 时不做数据集特定适配。将分布接入 AEB 触发任务，对比严格全候选策略与 1-CTRV 阈值策略的误报/真阳表现，并测量在 NVIDIA DRIVE Orin ECU 上的推理时延。
AI.result: flow-matching 模型取得最佳 top-k ADE/FDE：Wayve 0.15/0.37 m、Waymo 0.15/0.36 m、nuScenes 0.28/0.59 m；AR 模型覆盖度相当。AEB 触发中，严格全候选策略相比 1-CTRV 策略（100% 真阳）将误报从 1.51% 降至 AR 的 0.11%（13.7× 降低，94.9% TP）、flow-matching 的 0.06%（25.1× 降低，98.7% TP）。推理时延 AR 头 0.87 ms、flow-matching 头 2.9 ms（DRIVE Orin ECU）。
AI.conclusion: BLInD 同时实现“学习式、盲输入、跨域”三项特性，为先前工作未展示的组合；表明车态历史足以支撑可控且合理的意图采样接口，可供下游系统使用，AEB 仅为其一种实例化，且推理时延兼容车载实时部署。

title: CRITICS - Critical Science Without Borders: Language Models to Promote Critical Thinking in Science Education
comment: 9 pages
summary: The CRITICS project addresses science accessibility and literacy by converging advanced Machine Translation (MT) based on Large Language Models (LLMs) with educational technology. By leveraging MT systems specifically optimized for scientific content, educational institutions can provide accurate, culturally relevant translations of scientific materials in students' native languages, ensuring that complex scientific concepts are comprehensible while maintaining technical accuracy. Building on these translations, the project explores the design and evaluation of innovative science teaching-learning proposals grounded in curriculum-aligned teaching-learning. Thus, CRITICS will investigate key components of scientific argumentation and critical thinking practices together with textual feedback aligned with learning objectives and assessment criteria inspired by competence-based evaluation frameworks. CRITICS aims to break down language barriers to accessing cutting-edge research and educational materials currently available only in high-resourced languages, thereby facilitating the democratization of scientific knowledge and fostering critical thinking in science education.

AI.tldr: CRITICS项目将基于大语言模型的机器翻译与教育技术融合，通过优化科学内容翻译并设计课程对齐的教学方案，打破语言壁垒，促进科学知识普及与批判性思维培养。
AI.motivation: 当前前沿研究与教育资源多以高资源语言呈现，造成语言壁垒，阻碍了科学知识的普及与科学素养的提升。项目旨在解决科学可及性与科学素养问题。
AI.method: 以面向科学内容优化的LLM机器翻译为核心，将科学材料准确、文化贴切地译为母语；在此基础上设计并评估基于课程对齐的科学教学方案，研究科学论证与批判性思维的关键要素，并结合与学习目标及评估标准一致、基于胜任力评价框架的文本反馈。
AI.result: 摘要为项目规划性描述，未报告具体实验结果或量化数据。
AI.conclusion: CRITICS有望打破语言障碍，使前沿研究与教育资源更易获取，推动科学知识民主化，并在科学教育中培养批判性思维。

title: Thought without systematicity? Evaluating reasoning models on rule induction tasks
comment: Code available at https://github.com/smonsays/systematicity-eval
summary: A central tenet of human cognition is systematicity, the principle that understanding one concept is inherently tied to understanding close variations of that concept. Do reasoning models robustly exhibit such systematicity? If so, we would expect consistent performance on structurally equivalent variants of the same task. Here, we extend established rule induction tasks from cognitive science to assess the systematicity of thought in current reasoning models. Each task family has compositional structure that we use to create structurally equivalent task variations through task isomorphisms such as recombination and substitution. We find that despite being able to correctly solve a task, models often fail on structurally equivalent variants of the same task. These findings suggest that many model behaviors lack systematicity, rendering it difficult to robustly establish the cognitive abilities of reasoning models beyond the particular contexts they were evaluated in.

AI.tldr: 该研究将认知科学中的规则归纳任务扩展为具有组合结构的任务族，通过重组、替换等任务同构生成结构等价变体，发现推理模型在能正确解决原任务时，却常在结构等价变体上失败，表明其行为缺乏系统性。
AI.motivation: 系统性是人类认知的核心原则：理解一个概念应与理解其近似变体内在关联。若推理模型具备稳健的系统性，则在同一任务的结构等价变体上应表现一致。作者据此检验当前推理模型的思维是否真正具有系统性。
AI.method: 作者沿用并扩展了认知科学中成熟的规则归纳任务，构建具有组合结构的任务族，并借助重组与替换等任务同构手段，生成结构等价但表层形式不同的任务变体，用以考察模型在原任务与各变体上的表现是否一致。
AI.result: 结果显示，推理模型即使能够正确解决某一任务，也常常在同一任务的结构等价变体上失败，即正确性无法随结构等价性稳定迁移。
AI.conclusion: 许多模型行为缺乏系统性，因此难以在特定评测语境之外稳健地确立推理模型的认知能力；对其能力的推断应谨慎限定于所评估的具体情境。

title: SGWIB:Sliced Gromov-Wasserstein Information Bottleneck for Video Highlight Detection
comment: 13 pages, 6 figures
summary: Video highlight detection aims to identify temporally important segments that capture the most informative or engaging events in a video. Reliable prediction therefore requires not only discriminative segment representations but also preservation of the temporal relationships among neighboring and distant segments. The information bottleneck principle has proven effective for learning compact and task-relevant representations, yet it has not been explored for video highlight detection, and applying conventional formulations directly would overlook inter-segment relational structure and distort highlight relevant temporal organization during compression. We therefore introduce the Sliced Gromov-Monge Gap (SGMG), a structure aware regularizer that measures the excess relational distortion induced by a prescribed source-to-bottleneck mapping relative to an optimal sliced structural correspondence. Building on SGMG, we develop SGWIB, an information-bottleneck framework for single-modal video highlight detection that learns compact bottleneck representations while preserving inter-segment temporal structure. We further introduce Home-Away-Related Contextual Pseudo-Labels and a contextual disentanglement module that reduce sports-specific contextual bias by separating highlight oriented information from contextual patterns. Experiments on MrHiSum and MoSu show that SGWIB attains the best Kendall's tau, Spearman's rho, mAP@50, and mAP@30 among the compared single-modal methods on both datasets. On MrHiSum, the visual model improves the strongest previous results by 0.031, 0.031, 0.87, and 0.75 on these four metrics, respectively. These results show that structure-aware information-bottleneck regularization combined with contextual disentanglement improves segment-level highlight prediction.

AI.tldr: 本文提出结构感知正则项 SGMG 与信息瓶颈框架 SGWIB，在压缩片段表示的同时保留片段间时序结构，并结合上下文解耦提升单模态视频高光检测性能。
AI.motivation: 视频高光检测需要判别性片段表示并保留近邻与远距离片段间的时序关系。信息瓶颈原理虽能学习紧致、任务相关的表示，但尚未用于该任务；直接套用传统形式会忽略片段间关系结构，并在压缩中破坏高光相关的时序组织，同时存在运动场景特有的上下文偏差。
AI.method: 提出 Sliced Gromov-Monge Gap（SGMG），一种结构感知正则项，度量预设 source-to-bottleneck 映射相对最优切片结构对应关系所产生的超额关系失真；基于 SGMG 构建 SGWIB 信息瓶颈框架，学习紧致瓶颈表示并保留片段间时序结构；引入 Home-Away-Related Contextual Pseudo-Labels 与上下文解耦模块，分离高光导向信息与上下文模式以降低运动场景上下文偏差。
AI.result: 在 MrHiSum 与 MoSu 数据集上，SGWIB 在所比较的单模态方法中取得最优的 Kendall's tau、Spearman's rho、mAP@50 与 mAP@30。在 MrHiSum 上，视觉模型相较此前最强结果在这四项指标分别提升 0.031、0.031、0.87 与 0.75。
AI.conclusion: 结构感知的信息瓶颈正则化结合上下文解耦可有效改进片段级高光预测，验证了在压缩表示时显式保留片段间时序关系的必要性。

title: Zero-Shot Cross-Material Ptychographic Phase Reconstruction Using Deep Learning
comment: Withdrawn by the authors to resolve overlap with related collaborative work that had been submitted for publication prior to this preprint
summary: Ptychographic phase reconstruction is commonly formulated as an iterative inverse problem, requiring repeated object-probe updates and resulting in substantial computational cost for large-scale 4D-STEM data. We present a direct local-to-global learning framework that reconstructs full-field phase maps from diffraction measurements without iterative refinement during inference. The proposed network predicts local wrapped-phase patches from individual diffraction patterns using a sine-cosine representation, and the predictions are assembled into a full-field reconstruction using calibrated scan positions and Gaussian-weighted stitching. To evaluate generalization beyond the training domain, the model is trained on one material and directly applied to another in a zero-shot setting without target-domain fine-tuning. Experiments on AuPd and MoS$_2$ demonstrate consistent cross-material transfer in both directions, with the proposed method achieving the best full-field MSE, PSNR, and MS-SSIM among the evaluated learning-based methods. Compared with the iterative ePIE approach, the proposed direct local-to-global pipeline reduces end-to-end reconstruction time by approximately 10x, demonstrating its potential for efficient and transferable ptychographic reconstruction.

AI.tldr: 提出一种从局部到全局的直接学习框架，用单张衍射图预测局部包裹相位块，拼装为全场相位图，推理阶段无需迭代，跨材料零样本迁移下性能优于学习类方法，较ePIE提速约10倍。
AI.motivation: 传统叠层相位重建（如ePIE）将问题建模为迭代反问题，需反复更新物体与探针，面对大规模4D-STEM数据时计算开销巨大，重建效率低，且学习类方法跨材料泛化能力不足。
AI.method: 构建局部到全局的直接学习框架：网络以正弦-余弦（sine-cosine）表示从单张衍射图预测局部包裹相位块；再依据标定扫描位置，采用高斯加权拼接将局部预测集成为全场相位重建。推理过程不含迭代细化。泛化评估采用零样本设置：在一个材料上训练，直接应用于另一材料，不做目标域微调。
AI.result: 在AuPd与MoS₂上实验中，双向跨材料迁移均表现一致；与所评估的基于学习的方法相比，本方法取得最佳的全场MSE、PSNR与MS-SSIM。相较迭代ePIE方法，端到端重建时间约缩短10倍。
AI.conclusion: 该直接局部到全局流水线在保证重建质量（最优MSE/PSNR/MS-SSIM）与跨材料迁移性的同时显著提升效率（约10x），显示出高效、可迁移叠层相位重建的潜力。

title: Mizan: A National Benchmark for Evaluating Large Language Models on Iraqi Arabic and the Iraqi Civic Context
comment: 11 pages, 3 figures, 1 table. Live leaderboard: https://mizan-bench.onrender.com
summary: Arabic large-language-model (LLM) evaluation has matured around Modern Standard Arabic (MSA): aggregated leaderboards such as the Open Arabic LLM Leaderboard (OALL), HELM Arabic, and BALSAM rank models across dozens of MSA tasks, and frontier systems increasingly saturate them. Dialectal Arabic, the language Iraqis actually speak, remains nearly invisible to this infrastructure. We introduce Mizan ("the balance"), Iraq's national benchmark for evaluating LLMs on Iraqi Arabic and the Iraqi civic context: an MSA baseline track paired with an Iraqi track across six axes (dialect comprehension, dialect generation, bidirectional MSA-Iraqi translation, Iraq-specific knowledge, official-document field extraction, and safety), built from 340 originally authored, dually reviewed items with statistically audited answer positions and Wilson intervals on every published score. A pilot evaluation of 27 systems, spanning closed frontier models three days after release, open weights across size tiers, and an Arabic trio of commercial, open-specialized, and sovereign systems, yields four findings. The MSA track saturates while the Iraqi track discriminates, with a consistent 14-18-point per-model gap and statistically tied leaders. Official-document extraction confines every system to 32-56. Arabic-focused specialization behaves as MSA specialization: two dedicated Arabic models score below a size-matched generalist on the Iraqi track. And the safety-hardened tier of the newest model family deterministically refuses innocuous dialect-comprehension items as policy violations, an over-refusal mode invisible to MSA benchmarks. The platform enforces an integrity protocol of immutable snapshots, verification certificates, a human publication gate, and public retraction, all exercised during this study. Code and the public development set accompany the paper.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出 Mizan——伊拉克国家阿拉伯语大模型评测基准,包含MSA基线与伊拉克方言双轨,覆盖六大维度,基于340道原创双盲评审题目,并对27个系统进行试点评测。
AI.motivation: 现有阿拉伯语大模型评测(OALL、HELM Arabic、BALSAM)几乎完全围绕现代标准阿拉伯语(MSA),前沿模型已趋于饱和;而伊拉克人日常使用的方言阿拉伯语在该评测体系中几近缺席,缺乏针对方言与本地语境的可比评测基础设施。
AI.method: 构建Mizan基准:MSA基线轨与伊拉克方言轨并列,覆盖六个维度(方言理解、方言生成、MSA-伊拉克语双向翻译、伊拉克专属知识、官方文档字段抽取、安全性);由340道原创且经双重评审的题目构成,答案位置经统计校准,所有公布分数附Wilson置信区间;对27个系统(含发布三天内的闭源前沿模型、各规模开放权重模型,以及商用、开源专用、主权三类阿拉伯语系统)进行试点评测;平台实施不可变快照、验证证书、人工发布闸门与公开撤回的完整性协议。

AI.conclusion: Mizan填补了方言阿拉伯语与本地语境评测的空白,证明MSA基准饱和会掩盖方言能力差距、专用化红利与过度拒答等问题;其完整性协议在研究中全程得到实践,代码与公开开发集随论文发布。

title: What Makes an Efficient VLA? Navigating Action-Head Design, Scaling, and Latency
summary: Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models combine a pretrained vision encoder, a language backbone, and an action head, but their relative contribution has not been established under controlled, latency-paired conditions. We fix the backbone families (SigLIP2 and Qwen2.5) and the training pipeline, sweep action-head design and module scale, and pair each configuration with measured on-device latency. The study yields three findings. First, action-head performance is governed primarily by initialization rather than decoder architecture, loss, or inference budget: copying the last transformer layers of the language backbone into the head is the single largest lever, at no latency cost, and the only axis that helps at every module scale. Alignment also explains the other axes: flow matching and a heavier decoder pay off only while the head is misaligned and reverse once it is aligned, and extra inference passes give no measurable benefit; expressiveness appears to substitute for missing alignment. We read this as representation transfer: the aligned head keeps attending to the instruction's object nouns and stays close to the backbone in weight space rather than relearning to act from scratch. Because we reach alignment only through initialization, we offer this as the account that best organizes the measurements, not a demonstrated cause, and name the control that would settle it. Second, capacity pays only after alignment: the aligned action head is the highest-return module to scale. Third, those returns diminish sharply near the size today's $π$-series VLAs already use, so further growth buys little in-domain accuracy for its latency. These specify EffVLA, a compact model matching the strongest open-source VLAs on standard LIBERO, leading on most LIBERO-Plus perturbation axes at lower latency, and transferring to a real SO-ARM101 arm with the recipe unchanged.

AI.tldr: 在固定视觉-语言骨干与训练流程、并配以实测端侧延迟的条件下，系统梳理 VLA 模型各模块贡献：动作头性能主要由初始化（是否复用语言骨干末层）而非解码器结构、损失或推理预算决定；容量只有在对齐后才带来收益，且收益在当今 π 系列规模附近急剧递减。据此提出轻量模型 EffVLA。
AI.motivation: VLA 模型通常由预训练视觉编码器、语言骨干与动作头组合而成，但三者（尤其是动作头设计）的相对贡献此前未在控制变量、延迟配对的条件下被确立，导致设计选择缺乏可比较的依据。
AI.method: 固定骨干家族（SigLIP2 与 Qwen2.5）与训练流程，对动作头设计与模块规模进行系统性扫描，并为每种配置配对实测的端侧延迟；进而分析初始化、对齐、解码器容量与推理次数等轴线的交互。
AI.result: 1）动作头性能主要由初始化而非解码器结构、损失或推理预算决定：将语言骨干末几层 Transformer 复制到动作头是最大杠杆，零延迟代价，且在所有模块规模下均有效；流匹配与更重的解码器仅在动作头未对齐时有收益，对齐后反而下降；额外推理次数无可见收益。2）容量只在实现对齐后才转化为收益，且对齐后的动作头是最高回报的可扩展模块。3）收益在当今 π 系列所用规模附近急剧递减，继续增大规模对域内精度提升有限却增加延迟。
AI.conclusion: 作者将以初始化达成对齐的机制解释为“表征迁移”——对齐的动作头持续关注指令中的物体名词，并在权重空间上保持与骨干接近，而非从零学得动作。作者强调这是对测量的最佳组织性解释而非已证因果，并指出可验证该因果的控制实验。基于上述规律给出 EffVLA：在标准 LIBERO 上匹配最强开源 VLA，在多数 LIBERO-Plus 扰动轴上领先且延迟更低，并以未修改的配方迁移到真实 SO-ARM101 机械臂。

title: Mind2Cloud: EEG-to-Point Cloud Generation with Two-Granularity Diffusion Decoding
comment: European Conference on Computer Vision -- ECCV 2026
summary: Reconstructing 3D objects from brain signals offers a promising avenue for understanding human visual cognition. While prior work has shown initial success using EEG signals for 3D reconstruction, existing methods typically employ a uniform diffusion decoder, overlooking the evolving semantic granularity of both EEG representations and the diffusion denoising process. In this paper, we propose Mind2Cloud, a novel EEG-to-point-cloud generation framework based on two-granularity diffusion decoding. The core of Mind2Cloud is a time-aware decoder that integrates a global Transformer branch and a local Point-Voxel CNN (PVCNN) branch across diffusion timesteps through a learnable fusion mask. Specifically, Transformer layers are incorporated into the early upsampling stages to capture global object structure under high uncertainty, while PVCNN modules are used in later stages to refine local geometric details. Inspired by the hierarchical nature of EEG-based visual representations, this design dynamically adapts its spatial granularity in accordance with the coarse-to-fine trajectory of diffusion denoising. We further introduce an adversarial refinement module to enhance geometric realism and semantic consistency. Extensive experiments on the EEG-3D dataset across all 12 subjects demonstrate that Mind2Cloud outperforms prior work in both geometric accuracy and semantic alignment, setting a new benchmark for EEG-to-point-cloud generation. Our source code is available at https://github.com/duasoi/Mind2Cloud.

AI.tldr: 提出Mind2Cloud，基于双粒度扩散解码的EEG到点云生成框架，在EEG-3D数据集12名受试者上实现几何精度与语义对齐的新基准。
AI.motivation: 从脑信号重建3D物体有助于理解人类视觉认知。现有EEG三维重建方法通常采用统一的扩散解码器，忽略了EEG表征与扩散去噪过程本身在语义粒度上的动态演变特性。
AI.method: 核心为时间感知解码器：在扩散各时间步上，通过可学习融合掩码集成全局Transformer分支与局部Point-Voxel CNN（PVCNN）分支。早期上采样阶段用Transformer层在高不确定性下捕获全局物体结构，后期阶段用PVCNN模块细化局部几何细节，使空间粒度随扩散由粗到细动态调整；另引入对抗式精炼模块以提升几何真实感与语义一致性。
AI.result: 在EEG-3D数据集全部12名受试者上的大量实验表明，Mind2Cloud在几何精度与语义对齐两方面均优于既有工作，刷新了EEG到点云生成任务的基准。
AI.conclusion: 双粒度、时间感知的扩散解码设计能够有效匹配EEG视觉表征的层次性，为EEG到三维点云生成建立了新的性能基准，代码已开源。

title: Unlocking the Unsolvable: Teacher-Guided Curriculum for Data-Efficient RLVR
comment: 20 pages, 9 figures. Accepted to Findings of the Association for Computational Linguistics: EMNLP 2026
summary: Reinforcement Learning with Verifiable Rewards (RLVR) has shown remarkable success in improving the mathematical reasoning of large language models. Yet problems beyond the model's current capability, where rollouts uniformly fail and no learning signal is produced, are structurally wasted despite marking the most informative training frontier. We show that these otherwise-inert problems can be unlocked via teacher-guided curriculum learning: partial reasoning traces from a stronger model create a graded difficulty landscape, and a backward-chaining curriculum progressively withdraws guidance until the model solves problems unaided. Training on only 128 unsolvable problems matches or exceeds GRPO trained on a full 2,000-problem corpus (~16x data efficiency) on the nine-benchmark average for both base models, while substantially expanding the reasoning boundary measured by pass@k at large k. Furthermore, we identify a distribution-shift cost that is particularly acute in the unsolvable-only regime and propose Monotone Frontier Curriculum (MFC), a method that monotonically drives training toward unguided solving, consistently outperforming existing curriculum methods.

AI.tldr: 该论文针对RLVR中"不可解问题"无学习信号的浪费现象，提出教师引导的课程学习：用强模型的部分推理轨迹构造分级难度，再通过反向链式课程逐步撤除引导；并提出单调前沿课程（MFC）以缓解分布偏移。仅用128道不可解问题即可在九项基准均值上追平或超越用2000道题训练的GRPO（约16倍数据效率），并显著扩展pass@k@大k的推理边界。
AI.motivation: RLVR在数学推理上成效显著，但超出模型当前能力的问题会导致rollout全部失败、产生零学习信号，成为结构性浪费。然而这些问题恰是信息量最大的训练前沿。作者希望将这类"惰性"问题转化为有效训练资源。
AI.method: 1）教师引导的课程学习：由更强模型提供部分推理轨迹，形成分级难度景观；2）反向链式（backward-chaining）课程：逐步撤除引导，直至模型能独立求解；3）针对不可解问题单独训练时尤为严重的分布偏移问题，提出单调前沿课程（MFC），单调地推动训练向无引导求解推进。
AI.result: 仅使用128道不可解问题训练，在两个基座模型的九项基准平均成绩上追平或超过用完整2000道题语料训练的GRPO（约16倍数据效率）；同时在大k下的pass@k指标上显著扩展了推理边界。MFC在多种课程方法中表现最优。
AI.conclusion: 不可解问题可通过教师引导的课程学习被有效"解锁"，成为高价值训练信号；反向链式课程与MFC能有效缓解分布偏移、持续提升无引导求解能力，为RLVR的数据效率与能力边界扩展提供了新路径。

title: CirrGuide: A Deep Cascaded Framework for Liver Cirrhosis Segmentation and Severity Classification from T2-Weighted MRI
comment: 10 pages, 2 figures. Accepted at the 17th International Workshop on Machine Learning in Medical Imaging (MLMI 2026), held in conjunction with MICCAI 2026
summary: We present CirrGuide, a deep cascaded framework for cirrhotic liver segmentation and severity classification. Cirrhosis causes progressive structural changes in the liver and can lead to serious clinical complications, making severity assessment important for disease monitoring and treatment planning. However, severity classification is challenging because imaging patterns are often subtle, spatially variable, and similar across adjacent stages. CirrGuide addresses this by explicitly linking localization with classification. A ResNet50 encoder with an Attention U-Net decoder first predicts a soft cirrhotic liver mask, which is then used as an anatomical prior in a ResNet50-based classification branch. This branch combines global multi-scale features with mask-guided attention-pooled regional features to classify Mild, Moderate, and Severe cirrhosis. On the official CirrMRI600+ T2-weighted (T2W) 2D split, CirrGuide achieves 89.83% Dice and 84.14% mIoU for segmentation, 69.58% accuracy and 61.55% macro F1-score for severity classification. Compared with segmentation-only, classification-only, and multi-task baselines, CirrGuide improves both localization and severity classification, demonstrating the benefit of using predicted cirrhotic liver masks as anatomical priors for cirrhosis analysis.

AI.tldr: CirrGuide是一个深度级联框架，先分割肝硬化肝脏掩膜，再以其为先验进行分类，在CirrMRI600+ T2W 2D数据集上同时提升分割与严重度分级性能。
AI.motivation: 肝硬化导致肝脏进行性结构改变并可引发严重并发症，因此严重度评估对疾病监测和治疗规划十分重要。但严重度分类面临挑战：影像模式往往细微、空间可变，且相邻分期之间表现相似。
AI.method: 框架显式地将定位与分类相链接：先用ResNet50编码器加Attention U-Net解码器预测软性肝硬化肝脏掩膜，再将该掩膜作为解剖先验输入基于ResNet50的分类分支；分类分支结合全局多尺度特征与掩膜引导的注意力池化区域特征，对轻度、中度、重度肝硬化进行分类。
AI.result: 在官方CirrMRI600+ T2W 2D划分上，分割达到89.83% Dice和84.14% mIoU，严重度分类达到69.58%准确率和61.55%宏F1。
AI.conclusion: 与仅分割、仅分类及多任务基线相比，CirrGuide在定位和严重度分类两方面均有提升，表明使用预测的肝硬化肝脏掩膜作为解剖先验对肝硬化分析具有益处。

title: TF-IDF and BM25 Are Exact KL Divergences
comment: 5 pages
summary: TF-IDF and BM25 are two of the most widely used methods for scoring query-document relevance, yet neither has a standard probabilistic derivation that justifies it as a statistical method within a unified framework. We address this gap by showing that both scoring methods admit an exact interpretation as Kullback-Leibler divergences between two probability models. We treat the BM25 variant that includes the plus 1 correction in the IDF term, which is the one used in practice, and also discuss the original BM25 formulation without that correction. The resulting framework provides a common theoretical basis for TF-IDF and BM25, clarifies what they measure, and allows them to be compared theoretically with other information retrieval methods rather than only experimentally.

AI.tldr: 本文证明 TF-IDF 与 BM25 均可精确解释为两个概率模型之间的 KL 散度，从而为这两种经典检索评分方法提供统一的概率论推导框架。
AI.motivation: TF-IDF 和 BM25 是查询-文档相关性打分中最常用的方法，但二者都缺乏标准的概率推导，无法在统一框架内被证明为统计方法。作者希望填补这一理论空白。
AI.method: 将 TF-IDF 与 BM25 分别解释为两个概率模型之间的 Kullback-Leibler 散度；对 BM25 采用实践中常用的、IDF 项含 "+1" 修正的变体进行推导，并同时讨论不含该修正的原始 BM25 形式。
AI.result: 两者均可获得精确的 KL 散度解释，说明 TF-IDF 与 BM25 共享同一概率论基础，并揭示了它们实际度量的对象。
AI.conclusion: 该框架为 TF-IDF 与 BM25 提供共同的理论基础，澄清其度量含义，使其能够与其他信息检索方法进行理论层面的比较，而不仅限于实验对比。

title: VeriDx: Earning the Right to Diagnose with Disease-Centric Verification
comment: accepted by EMNLP 2026, 17 pages, 3 figures, 3 tables
summary: A correct diagnosis can still be reached for the wrong reasons. In clinical reasoning, every disease hypothesis creates obligations: key evidence must be checked, alternatives must be ruled out, contradictions must be resolved, useful tests must be considered, and closure must be justified. Current evaluations of medical LLMs mostly focus on final answers, local steps, or isolated facts, and therefore miss these hypothesis-induced commitments. We introduce \textbf{VeriDx}, a disease-centric verification framework that links free-form diagnostic reasoning to structured disease profiles. VeriDx tracks whether each hypothesis is satisfied, unresolved, or violated its clinical obligations, exposing failures such as missing critical tests, unresolved differentials, ignored contradictions, unsupported claims, and premature closure. We instantiate VeriDx for complex respiratory diagnosis using guideline-derived disease profiles and expert-annotated longitudinal cases. Our results show that many diagnostic errors are not isolated mistakes, but broken commitments made earlier in the reasoning process.

AI.tldr: 提出 VeriDx 框架，将自由形式的诊断推理与结构化疾病画像关联，从"疾病假说所引发的临床义务"角度验证推理过程，揭示诊断错误多源于推理早期未履行的义务。
AI.motivation: 正确的诊断结论可能建立在错误的推理之上。当前医学大模型评测多聚焦最终答案、局部步骤或孤立事实，忽视了每个疾病假说所隐含的临床义务（如核查关键证据、排除鉴别诊断、化解矛盾、考虑必要检查、合理论证收束），因而无法捕捉这类假说驱动的推理缺陷。
AI.method: 提出以疾病为中心的验证框架 VeriDx，将自由形式的诊断推理链接到结构化疾病画像；对每个疾病假说判定其临床义务是"已满足""未解决"还是"被违背"，从而暴露遗漏关键检查、未解决的鉴别诊断、被忽视的矛盾、无依据断言及过早收束等失败模式。该框架基于指南衍生的疾病画像与专家标注的纵向病例，在复杂呼吸系统诊断场景中实例化。
AI.result: 实例化结果显示，许多诊断错误并非孤立的单点失误，而是推理过程中更早期就已出现的"未履行义务"所导致。
AI.conclusion: 诊断推理评价应从结果导向转向对假说所引发临床义务履行情况的追踪，VeriDx 提供了此类验证的可操作路径。

title: Quantum-Gated LiteSSD: A Parameter-Efficient Lightweight Hybrid Quantum-Classical Framework for Forward-Looking Sonar Object Detection
comment: Accepted to ECCV 2026 Marine Vision as short paper
summary: Forward-looking sonar object detection is essential for underwater perception, yet deployment on embedded platforms requires highly compact models. To address this challenge, we explore quantum computing and introduce Quantum-Gated LiteSSD, a parameter-efficient hybrid quantum--classical detector that reformulates QuCNet-style multi-circuit quantum processing as an identity-centered channel-gating mechanism for spatial feature modulation. Experiments on the Marine Debris Watertank dataset and UATD forward-looking sonar benchmarks demonstrate an effective parameter--accuracy trade-off. The proposed detector achieves 90.84% $\mathrm{mAP}_{50}$ on Watertank with approximately $62\times$ fewer parameters than YOLO26s and $164.3\times$ fewer parameters than SSD-VGG16. On UATD, the model achieves 70.37% $\mathrm{mAP}_{50}$ with only 0.150M parameters, making it approximately $4.1\times$ smaller than SSGA-YOLO while retaining meaningful multi-class detection capability.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出 Quantum-Gated LiteSSD，一种参数高效的混合量子-经典前视声纳目标检测器，通过将多电路量子处理重构为以恒等映射为中心的通道门控机制进行空间特征调制，在极小参数量下实现有效检测精度。
AI.motivation: 前视声纳目标检测对水下感知至关重要，但嵌入式平台部署要求模型高度紧凑。现有检测模型参数量大，难以在资源受限平台运行，因此需要探索量子计算等新途径以实现参数-精度平衡。
AI.method: 提出 Quantum-Gated LiteSSD：混合量子-经典检测器，将 QuCNet 风格的多电路量子处理重构为以恒等映射为中心的通道门控机制，用于空间特征调制。在 Marine Debris Watertank 数据集和 UATD 前视声纳基准上验证。
AI.result: 在 Watertank 上达到 90.84% mAP50，参数量比 YOLO26s 少约 62 倍、比 SSD-VGG16 少约 164.3 倍；在 UATD 上以仅 0.150M 参数达到 70.37% mAP50，比 SSGA-YOLO 小约 4.1 倍，并保持有意义的多类别检测能力。
AI.conclusion: 该方法在参数量与精度之间实现了有效权衡，表明身份中心通道门控式量子-经典混合设计适用于嵌入式前视声纳目标检测，兼顾紧凑性与多类检测性能。

title: Measuring the Creativity of Frontier LLMs in Automated Research
comment: After discussion with our advisor, we concluded that the manuscript requires substantial further improvement before being made publicly available. As these revisions are expected to take a considerable amount of time, we would like to withdraw the current version for now and resubmit a more complete and robust version once the work has been substantially improved
summary: Frontier LLMs are increasingly capable of conducting automated research, yet their creativity in this setting has not been systematically evaluated. We propose a set of metrics to evaluate creativity along the two dimensions of valueness and novelty. Valueness assesses whether each proposed idea is useful, while novelty is evaluated from three perspectives: whether the same idea has appeared before (Exact-Match P-Novelty), whether the modified variable or variable combination has been explored before (Variable-level P-Novelty), which reflects the breadth of research-space exploration, and whether the proposed idea is explicitly attributed to external knowledge in the model's reasoning (H-Novelty). Our evaluation shows that the models achieve relatively similar Valueness and Exact-Match P-Novelty scores, while differing substantially in Variable-level P-Novelty. H-Novelty is also consistently high among the models for which it can be evaluated. Notably, further correlation and idea-level performance analyses reveal a strong positive correlation between Variable-level P-Novelty and research performance.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一套从"价值性"与"新颖性"两维度评估前沿大模型自动化研究创造力的指标，其中新颖性细分为精确匹配P-新颖性、变量级P-新颖性和H-新颖性三个视角。
AI.motivation: 前沿大模型已逐步具备开展自动化研究的能力，但其在此情境下的创造力尚未得到系统性评估，缺乏可量化的评价框架。
AI.method: 提出多维度创造力评估指标：价值性衡量所提想法是否有用；新颖性从三方面刻画——是否曾出现相同想法（Exact-Match P-Novelty）、所修改变量或变量组合是否已被探索（Variable-level P-Novelty，反映研究空间探索广度）、想法是否在模型推理中明确归因于外部知识（H-Novelty）。基于该指标对模型进行评测，并开展相关性与想法级表现分析。
AI.result: 各模型在价值性与Exact-Match P-Novelty上得分较为接近，而在Variable-level P-Novelty上差异显著；在可评估的模型中H-Novelty普遍较高。相关性与想法级分析显示，Variable-level P-Novelty与研究表现呈强正相关。
AI.conclusion: 可变性层面的新颖性是区分模型研究创造力的关键指标，且与最终研究表现密切相关，可作为评估与改进自动化研究系统的重要依据。

title: GraMRAG: Orchestrating Multi-Agent Multi-Step Reasoning via Graph Memory with Reinforcement Learning
summary: Although existing multi-agent Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) systems have demonstrated promise on complex multimodal reasoning tasks, they remain fundamentally limited in reasoning depth and memory structure, suffering from inadequate retrieval and state blindness when answering knowledge-intensive questions. To address these limitations, we propose GraMRAG, a graph memory-guided multi-agent RAG framework that integrates a dynamic multimodal memory graph to enable stable, multi-step multimodal reasoning. We introduce a vision-text bridged reasoning paradigm that unifies multi-scale entity cropping with a ReAct-style visual toolchain, enhancing the long-horizon cross-modal reasoning capability. We further construct a multimodal memory graph that formalizes agent reasoning as a dynamic directed acyclic graph (DAG), explicitly modeling action-observation dependencies to mitigate state blindness and suppress redundant retrieval. Moreover, we propose Topology-Aware Policy Optimization (TAPO) that leverages graph topology for critical path identification and targeted node pruning, enabling fine-grained credit assignment across multi-step reasoning trajectories. Extensive experiments on challenging multimodal benchmarks demonstrate that our approach consistently outperforms existing baselines and achieves state-of-the-art performance on complex long-horizon reasoning tasks.

AI.tldr: 提出 GraMRAG，一种由图记忆引导的多智能体 RAG 框架，通过动态多模态记忆图、视觉-文本桥接推理范式与拓扑感知策略优化（TAPO），实现稳定的多步跨模态推理，在复杂长程多模态基准上达到 SOTA。
AI.motivation: 现有多智能体 RAG 系统在复杂多模态推理任务上虽具潜力，但推理深度与记忆结构存在根本局限：面对知识密集型问题时检索不充分，且存在“状态盲区”（state blindness），导致多步推理不稳定。
AI.method: 1）构建动态多模态记忆图，将智能体推理形式化为动态有向无环图（DAG），显式建模“动作—观察”依赖，缓解状态盲区并抑制冗余检索；2）提出视觉-文本桥接推理范式，融合多尺度实体裁剪与 ReAct 风格视觉工具链，增强长程跨模态推理能力；3）提出拓扑感知策略优化（TAPO），利用图拓扑进行关键路径识别与节点剪枝，实现多步推理轨迹上的细粒度信用分配。
AI.result: 在具有挑战性的多模态基准上，该方法持续优于现有基线，并在复杂长程推理任务上取得最先进（SOTA）性能。
AI.conclusion: 图结构记忆与拓扑感知优化相结合，可有效提升多智能体多模态 RAG 的推理深度、跨模态一致性与轨迹级信用分配效率，为长程多模态知识推理提供了可行路径。

title: LPA-CWM: A Learned Physical Adjudicator for Motion Reasoning with Counterfactual World Models
comment: A quick overview is available at https://LPA-CWM.github.io
summary: Counterfactual world models (CWM) extract motion from pretrained video predictors by comparing factual and intervened predictions, but uniform aggregation weights responses equally without explicitly incorporating physical priors. Our key insight is to incorporate physical priors into candidate reliability learning, motivating LPA-CWM with a lightweight Learned Physical Adjudicator (LPA). Trained on dense MOVi-F trajectories, the 3.0M-parameter LPA compares visual context and response structure across an unordered candidate set to predict relative weights; windowed localization and one paired re-evaluation recover motion with the CWM frozen. Existing video-level benchmarks do not directly assess motion correspondence, where low localization error can conceal missing trajectory segments. We introduce Completeness-aware Motion Correspondence (CMC), a ground-truth-anchored protocol jointly measuring localization, completeness, visibility, and continuity, counting missing predictions as failures on visible dynamic points. Across DAVIS, Kinetics, and RoboTAP, LPA-CWM improves all main CMC measures over Uniform CWM, with relative gains of 18.1%--60.0% in average Dynamic Correspondence Accuracy ($\mathrm{DCA}_{\mathrm{avg}}$), and improves TAP-Vid First tracking accuracy (overview: https://LPA-CWM.github.io).

AI.tldr: 该论文提出LPA-CWM，将物理先验引入候选可靠性学习，用轻量级学习物理裁决器（LPA）对反事实世界模型的候选响应加权，并引入完整性感知运动对应（CMC）评测协议。
AI.motivation: 反事实世界模型（CWM）通过比较事实与干预预测来从预训练视频预测器中提取运动，但现有方法对候选响应采用均匀聚合权重，未显式融合物理先验。同时，现有视频级基准无法直接评估运动对应关系，低定位误差可能掩盖轨迹片段的缺失。
AI.method: 提出LPA-CWM，包含轻量级学习物理裁决器（LPA）。LPA仅3.0M参数，在密集MOVi-F轨迹上训练，对无序候选集合比较视觉上下文与响应结构以预测相对权重；在CWM冻结条件下，通过窗口化定位与一次成对重评估恢复运动。另提出CMC（Completeness-aware Motion Correspondence）协议，以真值为锚，联合度量定位、完整性、可见性与连续性，将可见动态点上的缺失预测计为失败。
AI.result: 在DAVIS、Kinetics与RoboTAP上，LPA-CWM在主要CMC指标上均优于Uniform CWM，平均动态对应精度（DCA_avg）相对提升18.1%–60.0%，并提升了TAP-Vid First跟踪精度。
AI.conclusion: 将物理先验显式引入候选可靠性学习可有效提升反事实世界模型的运动提取质量；CMC协议能更全面地评估运动对应，避免仅凭定位误差造成的误导性结论。项目页面：https://LPA-CWM.github.io。

title: Adapting Open-Weight MLLMs to Generate Point Prompts for Electron Microscopy Segmentation
comment: Accepted at the BioImage Computing (BIC) Workshop at ECCV 2026
summary: Promptable models such as microSAM segment electron microscopy (EM) images from point prompts, but automation requires generating prompts without user input. We ask whether open-weight multimodal large language models (MLLMs) can generate them from natural-language requests by returning coordinates to a frozen segmenter. To that end, we convert masks from three mitochondria datasets into training examples, pairing images and instructions with centroid coordinates, then train LoRA adapters while freezing the MLLM backbone and microSAM. We find that Qwen3-VL reaches segmentation AP$_{50}$ $0.736$ after supervised fine-tuning and reward optimization, up from $0.247$ without adaptation, while automatic prompt generation (APG) achieves $0.773$. In addition, two other MLLMs improve, reaching or exceeding APG. When compared with a supervised centroid-heatmap detector that reaches AP$_{50}$ $0.904$ for this mitochondria task, Qwen3-VL more closely matches the annotated point set and instance counts. Moreover, training on two public datasets transfers to an unseen third, while training on all three transfers to an independent EM volume. Robustness tests show stable performance under unseen formulations of the natural-language request, while the coordinates can be reused by a second segmenter. To our knowledge, this is the first feasibility study of open-weight MLLMs as EM point generators, providing an inspectable, language-directed link between localization and mask decoding.

AI.tldr: 该研究首次验证了开源多模态大模型可作为电镜图像中的自动点提示生成器：通过LoRA微调冻结的MLLM主干，依据自然语言指令输出质心坐标驱动冻结的microSAM分割，在三个线粒体数据集上取得媲美或超过自动提示生成的性能，并展现跨数据集与跨体积的迁移能力。
AI.motivation: 可提示分割模型（如microSAM）依赖点提示，但实际自动化流程无法依赖人工交互输入提示。现有自动提示生成（APG）方法缺乏语言可控性与可解释性，因此作者探索开源多模态大模型能否直接从自然语言请求生成点坐标，从而在定位与掩码解码之间建立可检查、语言驱动的连接。
AI.method: 将三个线粒体数据集的掩码转换为"图像-自然语言指令-质心坐标"训练样本；冻结MLLM主干与microSAM，仅训练LoRA适配器；结合监督微调与奖励优化；以分割AP50评估，并与监督式质心热力图检测器及自动提示生成基线对比，另做跨数据集/跨体积迁移与指令改写鲁棒性测试。
AI.result: Qwen3-VL经监督微调与奖励优化后AP50达0.736，未适配时仅0.247，APG为0.773；另外两个MLLM亦有提升，达到或超过APG。监督式热力图检测器AP50达0.904，但Qwen3-VL预测点集与实例数更贴近人工标注。两个公开数据集训练可迁移到未见第三数据集，三个数据集训练可迁移到独立EM体积；在未见自然语言表述下性能稳定，且生成坐标可被第二个分割器复用。
AI.conclusion: 这是首个将开源权重MLLM作为电镜点提示生成器的可行性研究，证明语言指令可直接驱动MLLM输出可复用的定位点，为冻结分割器提供可解释的自动化接口，尽管在绝对精度上仍低于专用监督检测器。

title: Bridging the Synthetic-to-Real Gap for Few-Shot Cryo-ET Classification
summary: Subtomogram classification in cryo-electron tomography (cryo-ET) is a challenging problem due to the scarcity of labeled examples. While cryo-ET simulators can be adopted to generate unlimited synthetic data, the substantial domain gap between synthetic and real subtomograms hinders its practical utilization. In this work, we propose a novel synthetic-to-real adaptation framework with a learnable transformation module, bridging this gap at both the input and feature levels. Extensive experiments demonstrate that our method consistently outperforms existing transfer learning baselines in few-shot settings.

AI.tldr: 提出一种带可学习变换模块的合成到真实域适应框架，在输入层与特征层弥合合成与真实子断层图像的域差异，在小样本子断层图像分类上优于现有迁移学习基线。
AI.motivation: 冷冻电子断层扫描（cryo-ET）中的子断层图像分类受限于标注样本稀缺；虽然模拟器可生成无限合成数据，但合成域与真实域之间存在显著域差异（domain gap），直接使用合成数据难以实用。
AI.method: 构建合成到真实（synthetic-to-real）的域适应框架，引入一个可学习变换模块（learnable transformation module），在输入端与特征端两个层级同时对齐并弥合域间差异。
AI.result: 大量实验表明，在小样本（few-shot）设定下，该方法持续优于现有的迁移学习基线。
AI.conclusion: 通过在输入层与特征层联合进行可学习的域适应，可有效利用合成数据缓解真实cryo-ET子断层图像标注稀缺问题，为小样本子断层图像分类提供了更优方案。

title: RA-CoA: Training-free Fashion Image Captioning via Retrieval-Augmented Chain-of-Attributes
comment: Accepted in TMLR
summary: Fashion Image Captioning (FIC) plays a vital role in enhancing user experience and product search in e-commerce platforms. Unlike natural scene image captioning, FIC requires fine-grained visual reasoning and knowledge of domain-specific terminology to capture subtle attributes such as neckline and closure types, graphic patterns, and dress silhouettes. Moreover, as fashion inventories evolve rapidly with new trends, styles, and frequently emerging vocabulary, developing training-free captioning solution becomes essential for scalability and real-world adaptability. Instruction-tuned vision-language models (VLMs) offer a promising solution to fashion image captioning dueto their strong zero-shot capabilities and natural language fluency. However, these general-purpose models often lack attribute-level coverage and precision, and tend to hallucinate or misidentify fine-grained fashion details, making them less suitable for high-fidelity applications like product cataloging or personalized recommendations. To address this, we propose RA-CoA (Retrieval-Augmented Chain-of-Attributes), a novel, training-free framework that disentangles fashion image captioning into two interpretable stages: (i) retrieval of relevant attribute sets from a product knowledge base, and (ii) attribute-level reasoning to generate the final caption. RA-CoA is a model-agnostic approach that works with frozen VLMs to improve fine-grained attribute precision in product captions without the need for fine-tuning. Extensive evaluations across diverse VLM model families under different prompting paradigms demonstrate that RA-CoA significantly improves caption quality, achieving an average gain of 26.3% METEOR score over zero-shot captioning. We make our code publicly available.

AI.tldr: 提出无需训练的时尚图像描述框架RA-CoA，将任务解耦为属性集检索与属性级链式推理两阶段，在冻结的VLM上显著提升细粒度属性精度，METEOR平均提升26.3%。
AI.motivation: 时尚图像描述（FIC）对电商体验与商品检索至关重要，但它比自然场景描述更依赖细粒度视觉推理与领域术语（如领型、闭合方式、图案、裙型）。同时时尚库存更新快、新词汇频出，因此需要可扩展、可适应真实场景的免训练方案。指令微调的通用VLM虽具零样本能力与语言流畅性，却存在属性覆盖与精度不足、易幻觉或误判细粒度时尚细节的问题，难以胜任商品编目与个性化推荐等高保真应用。
AI.method: RA-CoA是一种模型无关、免训练的框架，将时尚图像描述解耦为两个可解释阶段：(i) 从商品知识库中检索相关属性集；(ii) 进行属性级推理以生成最终描述。该方法与冻结的VLM配合使用，无需微调即可提升商品描述的细粒度属性精度。
AI.result: 在多种VLM模型家族与不同提示范式下的广泛评估表明，RA-CoA显著提升描述质量，相较零样本描述平均获得26.3%的METEOR分数提升。代码已公开。
AI.conclusion: RA-CoA以检索增强的属性链式推理方式，在免训练前提下有效缓解通用VLM在时尚细粒度属性上的覆盖不足与幻觉问题，为可扩展、可适应的时尚图像描述提供了通用且高效的解决方案。

title: A Voxel-Spacing-Aware Extension of PyRadiomics for Anisotropic Texture Analysis
summary: Radiomic texture features are commonly extracted from anisotropic CT and MRI acquisitions, where identical voxel offsets may represent different physical distances. We implemented and validated a voxel-spacing-aware extension of PyRadiomics that incorporates spacing information without generating interpolated gray levels. The framework operates across the Python frontend, C wrapper, and computational backend. GLCM uses anisotropy-relative feature-level angular aggregation, NGTDM uses anisotropy-relative weighted neighborhood averaging, and GLRLM, GLDM, and GLSZM are computed on a finite-volume zero-order-hold representation derived from the native anisotropic grid. Synthetic 3D phantoms were used for software validation. The modified implementation reproduced standard PyRadiomics exactly when spacing-aware mode was disabled and remained equivalent under isotropic spacing across 75 texture features. Under anisotropic spacing, the method selectively modified texture families and was numerically distinct from nearest-neighbor, linear, and B-spline resampling. Computational profiling showed moderate runtime and memory increases, while sensitivity analyses quantified finite-volume rounding effects and confirmed that spacing-aware differences persisted across binWidth settings. The framework provides a backward-compatible technical basis for future evaluation of spacing-aware radiomics in heterogeneous medical imaging datasets.

AI.tldr: 提出并验证了 PyRadiomics 的体素间距感知扩展，在不生成插值灰度级的前提下将间距信息纳入纹理特征计算，兼容原有实现。
AI.motivation: 各向异性 CT/MRI 采集中，相同体素偏移在不同方向上对应不同物理距离，传统纹理特征提取忽略该差异，导致特征物理含义失真。作者希望在避免灰度插值的前提下，使纹理计算具备间距感知能力。
AI.method: 在 PyRadiomics 中实现贯穿 Python 前端、C 封装与计算后端的间距感知框架。GLCM 采用各向异性相关的特征级角度聚合；NGTDM 采用各向异性相关的加权邻域平均；GLRLM、GLDM、GLSZM 在由原始各向异性网格导出的有限体积零阶保持表示上计算。使用合成三维模体进行软件验证，并与最近邻、线性和 B 样条重采样对比，同时开展计算性能剖析与敏感度分析（含 binWidth 设置）。
AI.result: 关闭间距感知模式时，修改版实现与标准 PyRadiomics 完全一致；在各向同性间距下，75 个纹理特征保持等价。各向异性间距下，该方法仅选择性地改变特定纹理家族，且与最近邻、线性、B 样条重采样在数值上存在显著差异。运行时间与内存占用呈中等程度增加；敏感度分析量化了有限体积舍入效应，并确认间距感知差异在不同 binWidth 设置下持续存在。
AI.conclusion: 该框架为在异构医学影像数据集上进一步评估间距感知放射组学提供了向后兼容的技术基础。

title: Accelerating HKTex without Mesh Eigensystems: Local Unfolding and Randomized Thermal Features
comment: 14 pages, 7 figures, 10 tables
summary: Heat Kernel Textures (HKTex) represent surface appearance with intrinsic anisotropic kernels, but evaluate them using 50 global Laplace-Beltrami eigendecompositions and a resident basis of shape [50,V,256]. We study two complementary ways to remove this bottleneck while leaving the trainer, GeodesicOpt, density control, and compositing unchanged. LocalHK exploits the measured locality of trained kernels and replaces spectral evaluation by radius-bounded hinge unfolding and an analytic log-map kernel. On 10 Objaverse meshes and an 8-mesh low-poly holdout, it changes mean view PSNR from 31.35 to 32.00 and from 29.82 to 30.76 dB, respectively, while reducing initialization by 40.5 times and enabling a 749,570-vertex proxy-backed run where the spectral baseline fails. ThermalRF instead preserves the discrete anisotropic heat semigroup: GPU sparse Chebyshev actions and randomized range finding construct global low-rank heat factors without mesh-sized eigenvectors, and a compiled evaluator mixes four neighboring thermal responses. On spot and a thin-stem challenge, ThermalRF reduces end-to-end preprocessing, initialization, and 5,000-step optimization by 29.3% and 24.4%, with every surface, atlas, or view PSNR change within 0.12 dB and training allocation reduced by about 90%. The two routes expose a useful design choice: maximal locality and scale versus fidelity to the thermal PDE. Broader thermal-feature evaluation and real large scenes remain future work.

AI.tldr: 该论文针对 Heat Kernel Textures（HKTex）依赖 50 次全局 Laplace-Beltrami 特征分解及 [50,V,256] 常驻基导致的瓶颈，提出两种互补方案：LocalHK 与 ThermalRF，在不改动 GeodesicOpt、密度控制与合成流程的前提下实现高效热核纹理评估。
AI.motivation: HKTex 以内在各向异性核表示表面外观，但需进行 50 次全局 Laplace-Beltrami 特征分解，并常驻 [50,V,256] 大小的基，计算与存储开销大，构成性能瓶颈。
AI.method: LocalHK：利用训练核的局部性，以半径受限 hinge 展开与解析 log-map 核替代谱评估；ThermalRF：保留离散各向异性热半群，用 GPU 稀疏 Chebyshev 作用与随机范围查找构建全局低秩热因子，避免网格规模特征向量，并由编译评估器混合四个相邻热响应。

AI.conclusion: 两种路径揭示了关键设计权衡：最大局部性与规模 vs. 对热 PDE 的保真度；更广泛的热特征评估与真实大场景仍为未来工作。

title: Parameter-Efficient Fine-Tuning of Foundation Models for Liver Tumor Segmentation in CT
comment: 9 pages, 2 figures, 1 table. Author manuscript of the published SPIE 2026 proceedings paper; LaTeX reconstructed from the author PDF
summary: We evaluated parameter-efficient fine-tuning (PEFT) of the Segment Anything Model (SAM) for liver tumor segmentation in abdominal CT of colorectal liver metastases. We compared Low-Rank Adaptation (LoRA), 4-bit Quantized LoRA (QLoRA), a convolutional adapter (Conv-Adapter), and our Directional Spectral Top-K adapter (DiSCo), training only adapters while freezing the SAM backbone. DiSCo derives spectral bases from singular value decomposition of row-normalized weights and learns rank-gated spectral coefficients, per-output magnitude offsets, and a spectral gain, with optional Top-K rank selection at inference and 0.14 M trainable parameters. We benchmarked five prompting regimes: no prompt, single-point, multi-point, and bounding boxes at intersection over union 0.50 and 0.75. Conv-Adapter and LoRA achieved the highest accuracy (overall Dice 0.793 and 0.792; single-point Dice 0.795 and 0.792; 95th-percentile Hausdorff distance (HD95) 32 mm). QLoRA was close (overall Dice 0.766; single-point Dice 0.768; HD95 36.41 mm), with 0.91 M trainable parameters, 120 ms latency, and 4.9 GB peak memory. DiSCo achieved the highest Dice per million trainable parameters (4.66), with overall Dice 0.653, single-point Dice 0.698, and HD95 49.53 mm. These results show an accuracy-efficiency trade-off and support PEFT for liver tumor segmentation with reduced adaptation costs when compute and labeled data are limited. Code: https://github.com/Ramtin-Mojtahedi/PEFT-SAM-Liver-CT

AI.tldr: 本文评估了在腹部CT结直肠癌肝转移瘤分割任务中，对Segment Anything Model (SAM) 进行参数高效微调（PEFT），比较了LoRA、QLoRA、Conv-Adapter以及提出的DiSCo，并在五种提示模式下进行基准测试，揭示了精度与效率的权衡。
AI.motivation: 在计算资源和标注数据有限的情况下，全量微调SAM进行医学图像分割成本高昂，因此需要探索参数高效的微调方法来降低适配成本，同时保持合理的分割精度。
AI.method: 冻结SAM主干，仅训练适配器。对比LoRA、4-bit QLoRA、卷积适配器Conv-Adapter及提出的DiSCo。DiSCo基于行归一化权重的奇异值分解导出谱基，学习秩门控谱系数、逐输出幅度偏移和谱增益，并可选用Top-K秩选择，仅0.14M可训练参数。在五种提示模式（无提示、单点、多点、IoU 0.50和0.75的边界框）下评估。
AI.result: Conv-Adapter和LoRA精度最高（整体Dice 0.793和0.792；单点Dice 0.795和0.792；HD95 32mm）。QLoRA接近（整体Dice 0.766；单点Dice 0.768；HD95 36.41mm），0.91M可训练参数、120ms延迟、4.9GB峰值内存。DiSCo每百万可训练参数Dice最高（4.66），整体Dice 0.653、单点Dice 0.698、HD95 49.53mm。
AI.conclusion: 结果表明存在精度-效率权衡，支持在计算和标注数据有限时使用PEFT进行肝肿瘤分割，以降低适配成本。

title: Talking to Me or Someone Else? Rethinking Talk-to-Me Detection in Egocentric Videos
comment: 10 pages, 4 figures, 4 tables. Accepted to the 34th ACM International Conference on Multimedia (MM '26)
summary: Online understanding of who is talking to the camera wearer is a key capability for egocentric social interaction. However, existing talk-to-me (TTM) studies are commonly formulated as offline clip-level recognition, which is poorly aligned with online interaction and overlooks the diverse non-TTM speaking states that naturally arise in egocentric videos. In this paper, we revisit this problem by reformulating it as an online, frame-level prediction task. Instead of treating TTM as a binary problem against a single negative class, we model it in the presence of diverse and previously underexplored non-TTM states, such as talking-to-others, self-talking, and background conditions. To support this new formulation, we construct an Online TTM Dataset consisting of 406 egocentric video clips with approximately 900K annotated frames, each labeled with frame-level social interaction categories (e.g., background, TTM, talking-to-others, self-talking), by extending the Ego4D social interaction benchmark. In this benchmark, we evaluate five adapted baselines and develop a new model that integrates social cues across modalities. Experimental results show that our multimodal model, which jointly leverages audio, visual, and speech-semantic cues, achieves 75.5% frame-level F1 on TTM, outperforming strong baselines and enabling a systematic analysis of how different speaking states affect TTM recognition.

AI.tldr: 本文将"与我交谈"（TTM）识别从离线片段级二分类重构为在线帧级预测任务，构建了约90万帧标注的Online TTM数据集，并提出融合音、视、语音语义的多模态模型，取得75.5%的帧级F1。
AI.motivation: 现有TTM研究多被设定为离线片段级识别，与在线交互场景不对齐，且忽略了第一视角视频中自然出现的多种非TTM说话状态（如与他人交谈、自言自语、背景状态）。
AI.method: 将TTM重新定义为在线帧级预测任务，从单一负类的二分类扩展为包含多种非TTM状态的多类别建模；基于Ego4D社交交互基准扩展构建Online TTM数据集（406个第一视角视频片段，约90万帧，逐帧标注背景、TTM、与他人交谈、自言自语等类别）；评估五种适配基线，并提出跨模态整合社交线索的新模型，联合利用音频、视觉和语音语义线索。
AI.result: 所提多模态模型在TTM上达到75.5%的帧级F1，优于强基线，并支持系统分析不同说话状态对TTM识别的影响。
AI.conclusion: 在线帧级、多状态建模能够更贴合真实的第一视角社交交互，多模态社交线索融合可显著提升TTM识别性能。

title: SignMimic: Robust High-Quality Sign Language Motion Generation via Human-Shape-Oblivious Pose Transfer Guidance
summary: We study the challenge of sign language video mimicking: given a driving video and a single reference frame, synthesize a video where the target signer reproduces the source motion while preserving identity and linguistic form. Prior pipelines entangle rigid motion, non-rigid deformation, and view-dependent completion in a monolithic generator, causing handshape drift and spatio-temporal instability. We present SignMimic, which (i) applies a TNet-based model to study SE(3) rigid canonicalization to stabilize global pose, (ii) performs non-rigid adaptation in a canonical space to preserve fine-grained articulators (hands/face) and coarticulation via NIF2D, and (iii) uses Pose-MAE-style completion before conditional video diffusion. This factorization injects geometric and linguistic priors, yielding shape and spatio-temporal consistency. On several large-scale datasets (ASL 50K, How2Sign, CSL News), SignMimic achieves state-of-the-art-level performance on video quality, identity similarity, and frame continuity while also achieving minimal loss when performing back translation (SLT) on generated videos. Ablations confirm the role of rigid canonicalization, non-rigid adaptation, and completion. Code is available at https://anonymous.4open.science/r/UniSignMimicTurbo-6088; model checkpoints and video examples will be released.

AI.tldr: 提出SignMimic，通过刚性规范化、非刚性适配与姿态补全的因子化流程实现手语视频模仿，在多个大规模数据集上达到领先水平。
AI.motivation: 手语视频模仿任务需在保留目标签名者身份与语言形式的同时复现源动作。已有流程将刚性运动、非刚性形变与视角相关补全纠缠在单一生成器中，导致手型漂移与时空不稳定。
AI.method: SignMimic采用三步因子化：1）基于TNet的SE(3)刚性规范化以稳定全局姿态；2）在规范空间中通过NIF2D进行非刚性适配，保留手部/面部细粒度关节与协同发音；3）在条件视频扩散前使用Pose-MAE式补全。该分解注入几何与语言先验。
AI.result: 在ASL 50K、How2Sign、CSL News等大规模数据集上，视频质量、身份相似度与帧连续性达到SOTA级水平；生成视频的手语翻译（SLT）损失最小。消融验证了刚性规范化、非刚性适配与补全的作用。
AI.conclusion: 因子化设计有效提升手语视频模仿的形状与时空一致性；代码已开源，模型检查点与视频示例将发布。

title: Deformable 2D Gaussian Splatting for Efficient 4K Video Compression
summary: Ultra-High-Definition (UHD) video presents significant challenges for efficient storage and real-time decoding. Learning-based methods, such as Neural Video Compression (NVC) and Implicit Neural Representations (INR), achieve competitive rate-distortion performance but suffer from high decoding latency and excessive memory usage. Meanwhile, Gaussian Splatting has recently attracted attention in the computer graphics community due to its ultra-fast rendering and high-fidelity visual quality. Despite these advantages, its application in video compression remains largely unexplored. To bridge this gap, we propose a real-time video compression framework that represents and compresses a Group of Pictures (GOP) using a coarse-to-fine multi-scale 2D Gaussian Splatting (2DGS) structure coupled with a lightweight deformation network. Experiments demonstrate that our method delivers rate-distortion performance in LPIPS that surpasses H.265 and other state-of-the-art learning-based video compression methods. Our work demonstrates the potential of Gaussian Splatting as a practical solution for efficient high-resolution video compression.

AI.tldr: 提出基于多尺度2D高斯泼溅与轻量形变网络的实时视频压缩框架，实现超越H.265及SOTA学习方法的LPIPS率失真性能。
AI.motivation: 超高清视频的高效存储与实时解码面临挑战。基于学习的神经视频压缩与隐式神经表示虽在率失真性能上有竞争力，但解码延迟高、内存占用大；高斯泼溅具备超快渲染与高保真画质，但在视频压缩中的应用尚未被充分探索。
AI.method: 使用由粗到细的多尺度2D高斯泼溅（2DGS）结构对图像组（GOP）进行表示与压缩，并耦合一个轻量级形变网络来建模帧间运动。
AI.result: 在LPIPS指标上的率失真性能超过H.265及多种最先进的基于学习的视频压缩方法。
AI.conclusion: 该工作证明了高斯泼溅可作为高效高分辨率视频压缩的实用方案。

title: One Size Does Not Fit All: Setting Inference Depth from the Questions a Deployment Actually Asks
comment: 20 pages, 5 tables in main text, 9 tables in appendices. Code, prompts, and result files at https://github.com/jerrykaplan/question-conditioned-early-exit
summary: A transformer language model is trained to respond to any prompt, but each deployment asks only a narrow range of questions: a support assistant sees delivery complaints, a coding tool sees Python. Every deployment nonetheless pays the same computation per token. This paper measures how much of that cost is avoidable when the range of prompts is known in advance. The mechanism examined is early exit: a small, trained component - called a readout - is attached to an intermediate layer and proposes a token, and a confidence test decides whether to emit it or to run the remaining layers. The models are frozen, and the only supervision used is the model's own output on ordinary traffic. Three findings are reported. First, achievable savings depend strongly on the kind of traffic: at half depth on a 1.5-billion-parameter model, 96 percent of tokens could be emitted early for arithmetic word problems and 8 percent for Chinese-language explanations, at matched token-level fidelity to the full model (a measure whose limits the third finding exposes). Second, of three ways a deployment might use knowledge of its traffic, only customizing the threshold for exiting early is worthwhile: calibrating it per deployment raised exit rates by up to 59 percentage points across three models, and by more than 10 points on most corpora tested. Third, token-level fidelity - the standard evaluation measure in the early-exit literature - fails in domains where tokens can be checked against ground truth: on arithmetic word problems, three models each answered sixty questions correctly when run in full, and between 10 and 28 correctly under early exit, in the configuration that scored highest on fidelity. The intended setting is small models on personal devices, where generation is limited by memory bandwidth rather than computation.

AI.tldr: 该论文研究在部署场景中已知提示分布时，早退（early exit）机制能节省多少推理计算，并提出仅按部署校准置信阈值是有价值的做法。
AI.motivation: 通用Transformer模型对任意提示都付出相同的逐token计算成本，但实际部署往往只面对狭窄的提示范围（如客服只处理配送投诉、编码工具只处理Python），因此存在可观的可避免计算浪费，论文旨在量化这种可节省比例并检验利用流量先验知识的有效方式。
AI.method: 在冻结模型上附加小型可训练读出模块（readout）到中间层，由读出模块提出token，再用置信度检验决定是提前输出还是继续运行剩余层；监督信号仅来自模型自身在普通流量上的输出。比较三种利用部署流量知识的方式。
AI.result: 节省比例与流量类型强相关：在15亿参数模型半深度处，算术应用题96%的token可早退，中文解释仅8%，且token级保真度与全模型匹配；三种方式中只有按部署定制退出阈值有收益，可使退出率最多提升59个百分点，多数语料提升超10点；token级保真度在有真值可核验的领域失效——算术题上三个模型全量运行均答对60题，早退下仅答对10至28题，而这恰是保真度最高的配置。
AI.conclusion: 早退的可行收益高度依赖流量类型，按部署校准阈值是唯一值得的流量知识利用方式，且token级保真度作为标准评估指标在可核验领域不可靠；该工作面向个人设备上的小模型，其生成受内存带宽而非算力限制。

title: When Tools Get in the Way: The Effect of Unnecessary Tool Availability on LLM Answering
comment: 10 pages, 2 figures, 4 tables
summary: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly deployed with external tools that extend what they can do beyond their own knowledge. Tools help on tasks that need external information, but their availability may also change how a model handles questions that do not need them. Prior work has mostly asked whether models select and use tools appropriately; whether an unnecessary tool changes the correctness of answers has received less attention. We ask whether making a related but unnecessary tool available affects a model's ability to answer from its own knowledge, and whether a preceding tool interaction changes this behaviour. We construct 500 query pairs across 10 knowledge domains. Each pair consists of a tool query, which needs the domain's tool, and a closed-domain query, which does not. Six LLMs are evaluated with the tool unavailable, available, and available after a prior tool call. Across 3,000 baseline trials the pooled answer rate is 98.2%. When an unnecessary tool is available it falls to 63.5%, with large differences between models. The decrease occurs even when the tool is rarely called, so it cannot be explained by unnecessary tool invocation alone. A one-sentence scope-aware system instruction recovers most of the lost answers.

AI.tldr: 研究构建500个查询对（工具查询/闭域查询），在6个LLM上测试工具不可用、可用及可用且有前置调用三种条件下对自身知识问答的影响，发现无关工具可用会使答题率从98.2%降至63.5%，且一句范围感知系统指令可大部分恢复。
AI.motivation: LLM日益与外部工具结合部署。现有研究多关注模型是否正确选择与使用工具，而"非必要工具的存在是否改变答案正确性"这一问题关注不足。本文旨在探究：提供一个相关但非必需的工具，是否会影响模型基于自身知识作答的能力，以及前置的工具交互是否会改变这一行为。
AI.method: 构建跨10个知识领域的500个查询对，每对包含需要该领域工具的工具查询与不需要工具的闭域查询。评估6个LLM在三种条件下的表现：工具不可用、工具可用、工具可用且此前有一次工具调用。共进行3000次基线试验。
AI.result: 基线条件下汇总答题率为98.2%；当无关工具可用时降至63.5%，且模型间差异显著。即使工具很少被调用，下降仍会发生，说明不能仅用"非必要工具调用"来解释。加入一句范围感知（scope-aware）的系统指令可恢复大部分丢失的答案。
AI.conclusion: 无关但相关的工具可用会显著削弱LLM基于自身知识作答的能力，且该效应不依赖于实际调用工具；通过简单的范围感知系统指令可大幅缓解这一问题。

title: 3D Gait-Based Autism Classification Using Attention-Enhanced Deep Learning with Cross-Fold Statistical Stability Analysis
comment: Withdrawn by the authors because the manuscript requires substantial correction of the provenance, attribution, authorization, ethics reporting, and contributor recognition associated with the UiTM force-plate gait dataset. The authors will address these matters before any future dissemination of the work

AI.result: 公开Kinect基准上：准确率99.00%、精确率99.02%、召回率99.00%、F1值99.00%、特异度99.00%，优于所比较的最先进方法；独立私有测力台数据集上：准确率95.00%、精确率93.81%、召回率96.67%、F1值95.13%、特异度93.33%。
