title: Towards Evolving Context Parameterization for Large Language Models
summary: Context parameterization enables large language models (LLMs) to internalize contexts into reusable model parameters, avoiding repeated processing across subsequent queries. However, existing methods typically assume static contexts and lack explicit mechanisms for distinguishing validity states under continual updates. To study this real-world scenario, we formalized the Memory Updating with Sequential Evolution (MUSE) task and constructed MUSE-bench to evaluate update incorporation and unaffected-information preservation. The resulting challenge requires preserving the global state while adjusting the contribution of memory evidence. Motivated by this, we proposed PLUME, a training-free method that constructs a global update representation, activates memory evidence to form a local parameter view, and adaptively integrates their predictions during decoding. Comprehensive evaluation on MUSE-bench demonstrated PLUME's effectiveness in sequential evolution settings, yielding relative improvements of 29.9% in average ROUGE-L Recall and 54.9% in LLM-as-a-Judge. Our codes are available at: https://github.com/xiaobingshi-LLM/PLUME.

AI.tldr: 本文提出MUSE任务与MUSE-bench基准，并给出免训练方法PLUME，用于解决上下文参数化在持续更新场景下的记忆更新问题。
AI.motivation: 现有上下文参数化方法假设上下文静态，缺乏在持续更新下区分有效性状态的显式机制，难以应对真实世界的顺序演化场景。
AI.method: 形式化Memory Updating with Sequential Evolution (MUSE)任务并构建MUSE-bench；提出免训练方法PLUME：构建全局更新表示，激活记忆证据形成局部参数视图，并在解码时自适应融合二者预测。
AI.result: 在MUSE-bench上验证了PLUME在顺序演化设置中的有效性，平均ROUGE-L Recall相对提升29.9%，LLM-as-a-Judge相对提升54.9%。
AI.conclusion: PLUME为上下文参数化下的顺序记忆更新提供了有效的免训练解决方案，代码已开源。

title: Inherited Heads: Audio language models track speakers with their text backbone's attention, and an attention-mass ranking retrieves a different set
comment: 20 pages, 6 figures
summary: Asked to describe what one of six speakers in a recording talks about, audio language models describe the right one on 6 to 16% of trials, below the 16.7% a guess would give. Adding a fixed bias to the attention logits of a hundred heads, under a tenth of the model's and with no training, redirects the description to whichever speaker we choose, on 90.7% to 99.0% of trials. Those heads are largely not specific to audio. Rank the text-only language model an audio model was built from, or a released model of the same family, on a written version of the task, take its top hundred heads, and carry them over unchanged: they redirect the audio model on 80.8% to 95.0% of trials, with nothing about audio entering the selection. The audio and text head sets share 66 to 74 of 100 where chance would give about 20, and the shared part alone reproduces almost all of the steering. What that does not show is that sharing is what makes the heads work: an equal-sized draw from the same discovered hundred does nearly as well, and none of our three models separates the two explanations. A second finding concerns how such heads are found. Ranking heads by how much attention they place on the segment asked about, as an established score does, or by how much of their attention moves with the question, as a per-head normalised variant does, gives top hundreds that share 69, 37 and 4 heads across our three models. In Ultravox, where they share 4, the established score's heads leave output the judge cannot place on any segment on 69.7% of trials, against 40.0% with no intervention and 1.0% for the normalised variant. That is one arm of six; on the other five the established score steers above a random draw.

AI.tldr: 通过对少量注意力头（<10%）施加固定偏置，无需训练即可将音频语言模型对多说话人录音的描述导向指定说话人（90.7%–99.0%）；这些头可从纯文本模型迁移而来（80.8%–95.0%），且与音频模型自身发现的头高度重合。
AI.motivation: 音频语言模型在多说话人录音中识别并描述被询问说话人的能力接近随机猜测（6%–16%，低于16.7%的随机基线），作者希望找到一种无需训练、可解释且可迁移的干预手段来定向控制模型关注哪一位说话人。
AI.method: 在注意力logits上加入固定偏置（不训练），作用于不足模型十分之一的约100个注意力头；将这些头的选择迁移自同族纯文本语言模型在书面版本任务上的排序；并对比两种"头部打分"方式——既有的"注意力落在被问及片段上的量"与逐个头归一化的注意力随问题变化量的变体。
AI.result: 加入偏置后可定向描述指定说话人，成功率90.7%–99.0%；被选头大多非音频专属，文本模型迁移的头使音频模型成功率达80.8%–95.0%，两者头集重合66–74/100（随机约20），且仅用重合部分即可复现几乎全部的转向效果。但同等规模的随机抽取自同一百个头也近乎同样有效，三种模型均无法区分两种解释。两种打分法的top-100头重合度分别为69、37、4；在Ultravox（仅重合4）中，既有打分法的头使输出无法被评判者归位到任何片段的比率达69.7%，而基线为40.0%，归一化变体仅1.0%。
AI.conclusion: 少量可迁移的注意力头足以在无训练条件下定向控制音频语言模型的说话人描述，其有效性可能不依赖音频专属机制；同时，不同头部打分标准筛选出的头差异显著，既有评分在个别模型上会导致输出失效，提示头选择方法本身需谨慎评估。

title: A Multi-Stage Agentic Framework for Effective Counter-Narrative Generation and Refinement
summary: The rapid diffusion of hate speech and misinformation on social networks challenges democratic societies, since direct suppression efforts may deepen polarization, fuel public distrusts, and strengthen extremist narratives. LLM-driven counter-narratives (CNs) offer a promising way to reduce those risks, yet their effectiveness depends on rhetorical and stylistic choices that remain poorly understood. We present a multi-stage agent-based framework for generating, refining, and evaluating CNs, applied to pro-Russian hate and misinformation narratives on the war with Ukraine and adaptable to other domains. A pilot experiment with human evaluators identifies effective technique style pairings, such as repetition with emotional framing enhancing persuasiveness. Building on these insights, we introduce a multi-agent refinement process that iteratively improves CNs for persuasiveness, emotional engagement, and shareability. After human validation confirmed improvement, an automated safety analysis shows that our refined CNs match or improve on expert-written counterspeech. A simulated experiment then shows that they reduce the perceived strength of pro-Russian narratives and consistently outperform a vanilla LLM baseline, highlighting a pathway toward scalable, narrative-specific interventions against hate speech and misinformation. Code and data accompanying this work are publicly available at https://github.com/carmelkron/inlg2026-counter-narratives.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一个多阶段智能体框架，用于生成、迭代优化与评估反叙事（CNs），以减少社交网络上的仇恨言论与虚假信息。人类评估确定有效技巧—风格组合，多智能体迭代优化提升说服力、情感投入与可传播性，经人类验证与自动安全分析后，实验显示其优于专家反言与朴素LLM基线。
AI.motivation: 社交网络上仇恨言论与虚假信息快速扩散，直接压制可能加剧极化、引发公众不信任并强化极端叙事；LLM驱动的反叙事虽有潜力，但其有效性的修辞与风格机制尚不清晰。
AI.method: 构建多阶段智能体框架：先通过人类评估者试点实验识别有效的技巧—风格配对（如重复+情感框架提升说服力）；再以多智能体迭代优化流程提升说服力、情感共鸣与可分享性；随后进行人类验证与自动化安全分析；最后开展模拟实验。
AI.result: 试点实验识别出有效技巧—风格组合；优化后的CNs经人类验证确有提升，安全分析显示其匹配或优于专家撰写的反言；模拟实验显示其能降低亲俄叙事的感知强度，并持续优于朴素LLM基线。
AI.conclusion: 该框架为针对特定叙事、可扩展地干预仇恨言论与虚假信息提供了可行路径，且可迁移至其他领域；代码与数据已公开。

title: Bi-Level Routing and Sparse Spatial Attention based Multi-View BEV 3D Object Detection for Autonomous Driving
comment: Accepted to 2026 9th International Conference on Computer Information Science and Application Technology (CISAT). 4 pages, 1 figure
summary: Bird's Eye View (BEV)-based multi-view 3D object detection suffers from challenges of computational complexity, multi-scale feature extraction, and efficiency of dense 2D-to-BEV view transformation. To address these problems, this paper proposes an improved BEV 3D object detection algorithm Sparse-BEVNet. Firstly, a Bi-Level Routing Attention (BRA) mechanism is introduced into the image feature extraction network to reduce the computational burden of the backbone. Second, Cascaded Group Attention (CGA) is employed in the feature fusion module, which enhances deep interaction across features of different hierarchical levels without introducing additional computational overhead. Furthermore, a Sparse Spatial Cross-Attention mechanism is adopted to replace the conventional dense view projection pipeline. Experimental results on the public nuScenes dataset demonstrate that the proposed method achieves a mean Average Precision (mAP) of 45.2% and a nuScenes Detection Score (NDS) of 54.5%, corresponding to 3.6% and 2.8% improvements relative to the baseline model, respectively.

AI.tldr: 本文提出改进的BEV多视角3D检测算法Sparse-BEVNet，通过引入BRA、CGA和稀疏空间交叉注意力机制，在nuScenes数据集上取得45.2% mAP和54.5% NDS。
AI.motivation: BEV多视角3D目标检测面临计算复杂度高、多尺度特征提取困难以及密集2D到BEV视图变换效率低等问题，亟需在保证检测精度的同时提升计算效率。
AI.method: 在图像特征提取网络中引入双层路由注意力(BRA)机制以减轻主干网络计算负担；在特征融合模块中采用级联组注意力(CGA)增强不同层级特征的深度交互且不增加额外计算开销；采用稀疏空间交叉注意力机制替代传统密集视图投影流程。
AI.result: 在公开nuScenes数据集上，所提方法达到45.2% mAP和54.5% NDS，相较基线模型分别提升3.6%和2.8%。
AI.conclusion: Sparse-BEVNet有效缓解了BEV 3D检测中的计算复杂度和视图变换效率问题，在nuScenes数据集上实现了优于基线的检测性能。

title: MorphoStyle: Motion Style Transfer with Morphology Control
comment: Accepted by BMVC2026
summary: Human motion may be viewed as a combination of action content, style, and body morphology. Existing motion style transfer methods transfer a reference style onto a content motion while assuming a canonical body, whereas shape-aware motion generators adapt motion to a target shape without explicit style control. This separation of motion style and shape (morphology) makes it difficult to generate stylized motions for non-canonical bodies; naively combining a style transfer module with a shape-aware generator often leaks action content from the style reference and disrupts shape-consistent kinematics. We present MorphoStyle, a framework for shape-aware motion style transfer that is built on a shape-conditioned Finite-Scalar-Quantization Variational Auto-Encoder (FSQ-VAE). The key contribution is to pose the desired style transfer as modular latent disentanglement comprising: (i) a contrastive style encoder that extracts content-decoupled style embeddings; (ii) a text-guided style-routing mechanism that locates style-relevant joints in a text-motion feature space; and (iii) a manifold preserving style modulator that injects discriminative style embeddings in content features as a temporally-gated low-rank offset. Extensive experiments on benchmark datasets demonstrate that MorphoStyle outperforms competing baselines in terms of both shape control and motion style transfer, while simultaneously providing quantitative shape control. For more details, please see project website: https://github.com/funkdub/MorphoStyle.

AI.tldr: 提出MorphoStyle，基于形状条件FSQ-VAE实现形状感知的动作风格迁移，通过潜空间解耦分离风格与内容，兼顾非标准体型的风格化动作生成与形状控制。
AI.motivation: 现有动作风格迁移方法假设标准（canonical）体型，只迁移参考风格；而形状感知生成器虽能适配目标体型，却缺乏显式风格控制。二者割裂导致难以为非标准体型生成风格化动作；简单拼接风格迁移模块与形状感知生成器还会引入风格参考中的动作内容泄露，并破坏与形状一致的动力学特性。
AI.method: 以形状条件化FSQ-VAE（Finite Scalar Quantization VAE）为骨干，将风格迁移建模为模块化潜空间解耦，包含三部分：(i) 对比式风格编码器，提取与内容解耦的风格嵌入；(ii) 文本引导的风格路由机制，在文本-动作特征空间中定位与风格相关的关节；(iii) 流形保持的风格调制器，以时间门控的低秩偏移形式将判别性风格嵌入注入内容特征。
AI.result: 在基准数据集上的大量实验表明，MorphoStyle在形状控制与动作风格迁移两方面均优于对比基线，同时提供可量化的形状控制能力。
AI.conclusion: MorphoStyle通过潜空间解耦统一了风格迁移与形状感知生成，实现面向非标准体型的风格化动作生成，并兼具显式风格控制与形状控制，代码已开源。
